description_plain:
Our Mission

Prose is truly custom hair and skin care made-to-order—just for you. Our line of custom products are made by an in-house, Paris-based R&D team of gifted chemists who combine natural ingredients in innovative ways alongside dermatologists, giving consumers clean skin care, hair care and impeccable results.

At the heart of Prose’s success is Singular, its proprietary AI-powered beauty-tech platform, which has revolutionized personalized beauty at scale. Marrying a technology-driven approach with an apothecary-style concept, all Prose hair and skin care products are personalized to your one-of-a-kind hair, skin, goals and environment.

We’re a company that wants to change beauty practices, so we’re changing the way beauty companies practice. As a certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation and Climate Neutral, we’re proving that good business is always sustainable. With Prose, there’s nothing sacrificed to bring you great products—not trees, materials, wages, or performance.


PROSE & SINGULAR IN NUMBERS

 - Founded in 2017, with hubs in Paris, New York, and Los Angeles

 - 10M+ consultations completed

 - 2M customers and 350K active subscribers

 - 21M custom products made, with 1M+ unique formulas

 - 350+ team members across disciplines

 - $600M+ in lifetime sales, with $165M+ revenue in 2024

 - Profitable since 2024

Discover our Company Culture on Welcome to the Jungle here https://www.welcometothejungle.com/en/companies/prose

Discover our Company Mission & Vision in video here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TwLYulX9wBU


POSITION SUMMARY

Prose is looking for a Paid Acquisition Manager to join our Growth Marketing team, reporting to the Senior Director of Acquisition Marketing. You'll own the paid acquisition strategy across Meta and AppLovin — setting direction, account structure, and measurement for both — and build Pinterest and TikTok into meaningful channels alongside them, growing new customers for both the haircare and skincare business lines. It's a chance to acquire customers for a product that's genuinely made-to-order, not one-size-fits-all.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own Meta acquisition performance across the haircare and skincare business lines — direction, account structure, and measurement — staying hands-on in Ads Manager on the highest-leverage work to keep CPA at or below goal while scaling volume.

 - Own AppLovin's growth — structure, measurement, and the path to more efficient spend — with enough hands-on involvement to steer it directly when needed.

 - Build Pinterest and TikTok into a reliable acquisition channel, establishing structure, measurement, and a path to efficient scale.

 - Develop and evolve the paid acquisition strategy and audience growth plan across all platforms, evaluate new channels for where to test next, and align campaigns with the broader marketing calendar and business goals across acquisition, creative, brand, and lifecycle teams.

 - Own the analytical tools and methodologies used to evaluate campaign effectiveness; interpret performance data to guide spend, and produce clear weekly and monthly reporting on results and learnings.

 - Design and execute an A/B testing roadmap across the conversion funnel — creative, audiences, landing pages, consultation completion, and checkout — and turn results into clear recommendations.

 - Partner with Creative Strategy to brief, produce, and iterate on high-performing ad creative — using audience segmentation, targeting, and creative testing to find winners across both categories, and surfacing insights with brand and analytics partners that fuel new creative and channel ideas.

 - Manage relationships with media partners, holding them accountable to acquisition results and efficiency.

 - Manage and develop the Paid Social Associate — set clear priorities, run consistent 1:1s, and provide the coaching and feedback that helps them grow into greater ownership.





KEY QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years of hands-on experience in paid acquisition or growth marketing, ideally at a DTC or subscription brand.

 - Deep, hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience — enough to set strategy and account structure with authority and to get into the platform yourself when it matters. Experience with purchase- and value-optimized campaigns is required.

 - Demonstrated experience owning acquisition strategy for an app or programmatic channel (AppLovin or a similar DSP) is required. Direct hands-on experience operating AppLovin specifically is a strong plus.

 - Pinterest and TikTok experience is a plus.

 - Strong analytical skills — comfortable owning measurement, interpreting performance data, and translating it into spend decisions and clear reporting. Experience with analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Looker, or similar) is a plus.

 - A testing mindset and a bias toward action: you form hypotheses, run disciplined experiments, and act on what you learn. Experience with Haus and Northbeam is a plus.

 - Strong cross-functional collaborator, comfortable partnering with Creative, Brand, Analytics, and Lifecycle teams.

 - Active, daily use of AI tools in your current workflow — for analysis, reporting, research, or creative thinking. We're looking for someone who already treats AI as a work tool, not someone willing to learn it someday.




PERKS & BENEFITS

Prose fosters inclusivity, learning, and diversity within our teams and workplace. Just as we celebrate unique beauty, every team member is encouraged to show up as their full self. In addition to creating an environment where all individuals feel welcome, we offer benefits that include:

 - A competitive and flexible PTO policy

 - Competitive compensation package

 - Company sponsored health care plan (medical, dental and vision plans)

 - 401k + matching

 - FSA and commuter benefits

 - Snacks and vending machine available on site



In the New York area, the anticipated base salary range for this role is $120,000 to $130,000 annually (discretionary bonus and equity). Actual compensation will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skills. This role will be a hybrid position based out of our Williamsburg office and the expectation is that this person will be in the office 3 days per week.

Prose Values

Intentional Inclusivity

 - We know the best ideas come from open minds and willingness to listen. While our products cater to the individual, an invitation into our process is always open to our community.

 - We value our differences and diverse backgrounds by communicating openly, managing with transparency and striving to understand one another’s perspective. It’s a key ingredient to our innovation.

Connected Collaboration

 - Our strength as a group will outlast our efforts as individual contributors. With offices across countries, staying inventive and agile deepens our clear vision and consistent communication.

 - We stay in a spirit of entrepreneurial collaboration: We do not have consensus at all times, but we trust one another to work toward our common goals. Our success is an expression and result of our progressive and gratifying teamwork.

Driven, Together

 - We value ownership and coaching that encourages employees to think constructively and creatively about the business. We view employees as leaders and individuals who are accountable, resourceful and responsible. Anyone and everyone is encouraged to lead.

 - We recognize that in order to continue thinking one step ahead, we will need to try new things. We strive to provide an open environment that accepts this truth, making space for new ideas to emerge.

Humanity Always

 - We assume good intentions in every interaction, keeping ourselves accountable for the climate we create. We seek to understand our co-workers through this lens of conscious benevolence, authenticity and fellowship.

 - We operate with the intention of preserving resources, creating an environment we can all live in – for our business and the world. Sustainable care is essential to our ethos as an organization. We take a mindful approach to how we think about our people (employees) and our planet.

description_plain:
Javvy is on a mission to set a new standard for café favorites with better-for-you beverages that are craveable, convenient, and without compromise. Positioned at the intersection of café culture, convenience, and functional nutrition, we’re reimagining the drinks people buy every day — proving you don’t have to compromise between great taste and quality ingredients. What began as a cult-favorite DTC brand has rapidly scaled into an omnichannel business, now expanding into major retail while building a loyal community around better-for-you café favorites.


THE OPPORTUNITY:

Javvy is looking for a highly capable Head of E-Commerce to own and continuously improve our

direct-to-consumer ecommerce experience.



Your primary mandate will be improving conversion (CRO), web design, and UI/UX across

Javvy's website, landing pages, funnels, and other digital touchpoints.



This is an ecommerce product, CRO, operations, and execution leadership role - not primarily a paid media or brand marketing position.



You will directly manage Javvy's web team across development, design, CRO, and QA. You will own the ecommerce roadmap, turn company priorities and customer insights into well-executed initiatives, and ensure projects are properly designed, launched, measured, and improved.



You will also partner closely with Marketing, Retention, Retail, Analytics, and other teams that own their respective channels.



Initially, you will work closely with our CTO to learn Javvy's customers, products, systems, and decision-making principles. As you build context and demonstrate sound judgment, you will take ownership of an increasing number of day-to-day ecommerce decisions.



The right person is more than a project manager. You are a hands-on ecommerce operator with strong CRO instincts, excellent UX judgment, and the ability to turn an objective into a high-quality, measurable customer

experience.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN:



CRO, Web Design, and UI/UX

Your first priority will be improving the performance and quality of Javvy's ecommerce experience.

 - Own the CRO roadmap across landing pages, product pages, offers, funnels, navigation, cart, checkout, upsells, and other key customer touchpoints.

 - Identify conversion opportunities using customer behavior, funnel data, analytics, user feedback, and qualitative insights.

 - Turn opportunities into clear hypotheses, designs, tests, and implementation plans.

 - Lead the continuous improvement of intuitive, persuasive, mobile-first ecommerce experiences.

 - Establish a high standard for web design, UI consistency, usability, messaging hierarchy, and customer clarity.

 - Manage A/B tests from prioritization and implementation through QA, analysis, and decision-making.

 - Bring recommendations and proposed decisions - not just dashboards or raw data - to leadership.

You do not need to personally design every page, but you must have strong visual and UX judgment. You should be able to recognize weak design, unclear messaging, unnecessary friction, and missed conversion opportunities - and lead the team toward a better solution.



Lead the Web Team and Own Execution

You will be responsible for turning business priorities and CRO opportunities into organized, high-quality execution.

 - Directly manage the web team's priorities, workload, performance, and operating cadence.

 - Translate ideas, data, and cross-functional requests into well-scoped projects with clear requirements, owners, dependencies, timelines, and acceptance criteria.

 - Determine what should be prioritized, what should wait, and what additional information is needed.

 - Identify missing requirements and downstream implications before work is already underway.

 - Remove blockers, adapt plans as priorities change, and hold the team accountable for communication, quality, and follow-through.

 - Ensure projects move from idea through design, development, QA, launch, and post-launch validation.

 - Improve the team's processes, documentation, templates, and quality standards over time.



Own E-Commerce Launches, Systems, and Operations

You will own the operational complexity behind ecommerce launches and the systems supporting them.

 - Coordinate new products, flavors, offers, formula changes, and product-version transitions from planning through post-launch monitoring.

 - Maintain launch playbooks covering Shopify, landing pages, product assets, pricing, subscriptions, shipping,international experiences, upsells, tracking, and other dependencies.

 - Ensure product IDs, SKUs, UPCs, GTINs, product mappings, audiences, and versions are accurate across relevant systems.

 - Coordinate QA, test orders, launch readiness, go-live sequencing, and post-launch verification.

 - Own routine configuration, audits, data hygiene, and vendor follow-up across platforms such as Shopify, Recharge, Webflow, KnoCommerce, Bazaarvoice, Amplitude, and PostHog.

 - Become independently proficient in unfamiliar systems and take operational ownership of them.

 - Turn recurring issues into better documentation, checklists, processes, or automated safeguards.





YOU’RE A FIT IF…

 - 5+ years of relevant experience in ecommerce, CRO, digital product, ecommerce operations, or a related field.

 - Meaningful experience at a high-growth DTC or ecommerce company.

 - A demonstrated record of improving ecommerce conversion rates and customer experiences.

 - Strong visual, web-design, and UI/UX judgment.

 - Experience identifying conversion opportunities and managing A/B tests from hypothesis through implementation and analysis.

 - Strong Shopify experience and an understanding of products, variants, offers, discounts, collections, checkout and third-party integrations.

 - Experience directly managing or leading developers, designers, CRO specialists, and QA contributors.

 - Strong project-management skills, including scoping, prioritization, dependency management, risk management, and follow-through.

 - Ability to use ecommerce and product analytics to investigate questions and make recommendations.

 - Enough technical fluency to work effectively with engineers and understand how ecommerce systems interact.

 - Excellent written communication, sound judgment, and the ability to turn ambiguity into clear plans.

 - Based in the United States and able to work Eastern Time hours.

 - Strongly Preferred:
   
   - Experience with subscription commerce and platforms such as Recharge, Skio, Stay.ai http://Stay.ai, Loop, or Smartrr.
   
   - Experience with Webflow or another high-volume ecommerce CMS.
   
   - Experience with Amplitude, PostHog, Mixpanel, or similar product-analytics tools.
   
   - Familiarity with ecommerce tracking, pixels, event properties, and order-level validation.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

Within your first 90 days:

 - You have developed a strong understanding of Javvy's customers, products, offers, funnels, and ecommerce performance.

 - You have audited the customer journey and established a prioritized roadmap of CRO, UX, and web-design opportunities.

 - You have become the web team's primary manager for day-to-day priorities, performance, and delivery.

 - The team has a clear operating cadence and reliable visibility into active, upcoming, blocked, and completed work.

 - Product and offer launches follow complete, repeatable processes with clear QA and post-launch validation.

 - You can independently operate core ecommerce systems and answer common questions using platform and analytics data.

 - Leadership receives concise updates focused on insights, recommendations, decisions, risks, and exceptions.


YOU’LL THRIVE IF YOU:

 - Naturally notice weak design, confusing UX, unnecessary friction, and missed conversion opportunities

 - Combine quantitative data with strong customer and design judgment;

 - Quickly understand the reasoning behind an existing process, take ownership of it, and improve it where appropriate

 - Ask important questions early and naturally notice missing details and downstream implications

 - Move with urgency while maintaining accuracy and quality

 - Are willing to get into the systems and do the work - not merely manage from a spreadsheet

 - Want increasing autonomy and are prepared to earn it through judgment and consistency



Over time, you will become the trusted operating owner of Javvy's ecommerce function and independently make many of the routine decisions currently handled by the CTO.




WHY THIS ROLE ROCKS:

 - Competitive Salary

 - 100% Company-Paid Health, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance for employees
   (Family coverage available at employee cost)

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan

 - Parental Leave

 - Free Access to Javvy Products

 - Career Growth Opportunities

 - Collaborative, Fast-Paced Start-Up Environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

Javvy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and applicable laws.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications and may be modified as business needs evolve.

description_plain:
ABOUT YEPODA

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

The Opportunity

Yepoda is growing fast across Europe and expanding internationally, and we're building our first field team. This is your chance to be part of it from day one.

You'll be Yepoda's representative inside Sephora UK, not a Beauty Advisor, but a field based commercial role. You'll drive sell-out in your doors, train and coach Sephora's Beauty Advisor teams, own the store relationships, and keep our brand presentation flawless in store. Part account executive, part field trainer, part retail sales lead. You'll be responsible for the relationship, education, and sell-out across five Sephora doors in London.

The Details

 - Contract: Fixed-term 6-month contract, starting in October. Renewable by mutual agreement, with the possibility of becoming a permanent role based on performance.

 - Hours: Full-time, 5 days a week, including weekend coverage. Schedule is confirmed upon employment start, and seasonal adjustments will be mutually agreed.

 - Travel: Up to 20% of your time, subject to change by season and business needs. Covers your doors plus occasional support at Yepoda events. Yepoda will cover travel expenses (accommodation, transportation, and meal allowance).

 - Reports to: EU Sales & Education Manager

 - Location: London, UK. Field-based retail role (in-store at assigned Sephora location, mobile as needed)

 


YOUR TASKS

 - Own sell-out across your doors and deliver against monthly and quarterly targets

 - Sell side by side with Sephora Beauty Advisors to lift conversion and basket size

 - Negotiate and run dedicated brand moments including sales challenges, Beauty Hub takeovers, and fun days

 - Train Sephora Beauty Advisor teams on our products, routines, and brand story, from quick floor briefings to full breakfast sessions

 - Coach Sephora staff on selling technique, routine building, and cross-selling

 - Deliver launch education so every new product lands with a confident floor team behind it

 - Assist the EU Retail & Education Manager in large scale education events and press days

 - Be the face of Yepoda in store and own the relationship with Store Managers and BA teams

 - Keep gondolas and displays impeccable, testers stocked, and stock levels healthy on every visit

 - Provide weekly field reports covering sell-out by door, merchandising, and tester photos

 - Relay competitor activity and customer insight that shapes our commercial plans

 


YOUR PROFILE

 - 2 to 5 years in prestige cosmetic sales and education, or a senior Beauty Advisor ready to take their career to the next level, Sephora experience strongly preferred

 - A track record of driving sell-out in a retail environment

 - Confident delivering training, in-store events, and product demonstrations to a floor team

 - Commercially minded and customer centric with excellent interpersonal and communication skills

 - Genuinely self directed and highly organised, you run your doors and own your reporting

 - Passionate about skincare with real energy for the floor, K-Beauty knowledge is a big plus

 - Fluent English

 - Based in London with the right to work in the UK

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Join a top, rapidly growing, K-Beauty brand. Fast growth across Europe, international expansion, and a brand people are excited to see in store.

 - The original field team. Be part of the original field team, with potential transition to permanent opportunity.

 - Real autonomy and opportunity to own your role. You own your market, run your doors and are trusted to make decisions in your scope.

 - Education & Development: Comprehensive onboarding, ongoing product and sales training, and direct mentorship from our EU Sales & Education Manager to develop advanced education techniques, presentation skills, and retail expertise.

 - The practical perks. Quarterly product gratis plus a generous employee discount; a performance linked bonus tied to your stores' sell-out (structure agreed separately).

 

Compensation range: Salary determined upon interview.

 

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

At Yepoda we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.

description_plain:
Our Mission

Prose is truly custom hair and skin care made-to-order—just for you. Our line of custom products are made by an in-house, Paris-based R&D team of gifted chemists who combine natural ingredients in innovative ways alongside dermatologists, giving consumers clean skin care, hair care and impeccable results.

At the heart of Prose’s success is Singular, its proprietary AI-powered beauty-tech platform, which has revolutionized personalized beauty at scale. Marrying a technology-driven approach with an apothecary-style concept, all Prose hair and skin care products are personalized to your one-of-a-kind hair, skin, goals and environment.

We’re a company that wants to change beauty practices, so we’re changing the way beauty companies practice. As a certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation and Climate Neutral, we’re proving that good business is always sustainable. With Prose, there’s nothing sacrificed to bring you great products—not trees, materials, wages, or performance.


PROSE & SINGULAR IN NUMBERS

 - Founded in 2017, with hubs in Paris, New York, and Los Angeles

 - 10M+ consultations completed

 - 2M customers and 350K active subscribers

 - 21M custom products made, with 1M+ unique formulas

 - 350+ team members across disciplines

 - $600M+ in lifetime sales, with $165M+ revenue in 2024

 - Profitable since 2024

Discover our Company Culture on Welcome to the Jungle here https://www.welcometothejungle.com/en/companies/prose

Discover our Company Mission & Vision in video here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TwLYulX9wBU

ABOUT THE ROLE

Prose is looking for a Scientific Communication Manager to shape the brand's scientific storytelling and claims strategy. Sitting at the intersection of R&D, Brand, Innovation and Digital Product, this person will be the driving force behind a stronger, sharper scientific culture at Prose - translating complex research into compelling, credible, and differentiating content, while ensuring every claim we make is substantiated.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role for someone who is equal parts scientist, storyteller, and strategist. The role reports to the Director of Scientific Affairs & Sustainability within the Prose Science Team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SCIENTIFIC COMMUNICATION STRATEGY

 - Shape Prose's global scientific communication strategy, aligned with brand positioning and priorities.

 - Establish the narrative structure and tone of voice that define our scientific authority across the key communication territories and ingredients that set us apart

 - Translate ingredient information and product testing data into clear, engaging narratives and claims

 - Act as a creative catalyst on new ingredients, technology, and testing communication opportunities.

TECHNICAL & CLAIMS DOSSIERS

 - Review and approve final test results, providing technical interpretation in collaboration with partner teams.

 - Build and maintain robust technical and scientific dossiers for new product launches and renovations (literature reviews, scientific territories, active ingredients, performance test results).

 - Support the preparation of oral presentations, posters, and peer-reviewed articles when relevant.

SCIENTIFIC & COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE

 - Maintain active scientific and competitive watch to identify new technology, ingredients, communication territories (longevity, exposome, microbiome…) and claims opportunities.

 - Prospect new raw materials, biological targets, and technologies through supplier relationships (in partnership with the R&D team) and competitive/technical intelligence.

 - Stay at the forefront of cosmetic trends, both from a marketing and a scientific standpoint, to provide marketing teams with structuring and differentiating strategic input.

SCIENTIFIC CULTURE & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

 - Infuse a strong scientific culture across the organization - building dialogue and proximity between science and non-scientific teams.

 - Partner closely with R&D, Marketing, CX and Digital Product to ensure product claims and launch concepts are scientifically accurate and consistent, review all the communications assets and supports and answer ad hoc scientific and technical questions to support their day-to-day work

 - Work closely with the Evaluation team to coordinate clinical, instrumental, and consumer testing, and help design differentiating, creative claims approaches.

 - Partner with regulatory affairs  to ensure substantiation needs are met and test platforms address all product claims.

 - Effectively articulate highly technical or complex scientific concepts to audiences with varying levels of scientific literacy.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Strong scientific/technical background (cosmetic science, dermatology, biology, or related field), with the ability to move fluidly between deep science and brand storytelling.

 - 5 to 10 years of experience in scientific communication, claims substantiation, or R&D-marketing liaison roles, ideally in beauty/cosmetics or a related regulated industry.

 - Strong appetite for AI tools and agentic AI, with a genuine curiosity for experimenting with several AI-amplified projects

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French a plus, given cross-team collaboration).

 - A creative thinker who challenges the status quo and looks for differentiating angles, not just correct ones.

 - Solution- and business-oriented mindset - resourceful in finding answers when data isn't readily available.

 - Comfortable as both a strategic thinker and a hands-on doer; flexible and able to adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - A natural team player and cross-functional leader, able to build trust with scientific and non-scientific stakeholders alike.

 - Rigorous, tenacious, results-oriented, with strong project management skills.

Prose Values

Intentional Inclusivity

 - We know the best ideas come from open minds and willingness to listen. While our products cater to the individual, an invitation into our process is always open to our community.

 - We value our differences and diverse backgrounds by communicating openly, managing with transparency and striving to understand one another’s perspective. It’s a key ingredient to our innovation.

Connected Collaboration

 - Our strength as a group will outlast our efforts as individual contributors. With offices across countries, staying inventive and agile deepens our clear vision and consistent communication.

 - We stay in a spirit of entrepreneurial collaboration: We do not have consensus at all times, but we trust one another to work toward our common goals. Our success is an expression and result of our progressive and gratifying teamwork.

Driven, Together

 - We value ownership and coaching that encourages employees to think constructively and creatively about the business. We view employees as leaders and individuals who are accountable, resourceful and responsible. Anyone and everyone is encouraged to lead.

 - We recognize that in order to continue thinking one step ahead, we will need to try new things. We strive to provide an open environment that accepts this truth, making space for new ideas to emerge.

Humanity Always

 - We assume good intentions in every interaction, keeping ourselves accountable for the climate we create. We seek to understand our co-workers through this lens of conscious benevolence, authenticity and fellowship.

 - We operate with the intention of preserving resources, creating an environment we can all live in – for our business and the world. Sustainable care is essential to our ethos as an organization. We take a mindful approach to how we think about our people (employees) and our planet.

description_plain:
YOUR ROLE

This role sits within Edeneve, our new cosmetics brand currently being built within the Sunday Natural ecosystem. Edeneve focuses on high-quality skincare with a strong emphasis on natural ingredients, transparency, and modern formulation science.

As Senior Cosmetics Regulatory Manager, you will play a key role in bringing this new brand to life — ensuring full regulatory compliance while actively supporting product innovation from early concept to market launch.




YOUR ROLE

 - Own compliance and labeling for all new product launches, ensuring full alignment with EU and applicable international cosmetics law.

 - Take full ownership of regulatory projects, from change control and marketability assessments to implementing required measures end-to-end.

 - Act as the primary regulatory point of contact with external partners, legal counsel, and notified bodies; manage communication on marketability and compliance queries.

 - Lead and contribute to regular portfolio reviews in close collaboration with Product Development, Editorial, and Quality, ensuring all documentation and labels remain current and accurate.

 - Proactively monitor the regulatory landscape (EU, and where relevant US) for developments that may impact our product pipeline or existing portfolio, and brief internal stakeholders accordingly.

 - Support the assessment of new ingredients and formulation concepts at the innovation stage, flagging regulatory opportunities or constraints early in the development process.




YOUR PROFILE

 - Regulatory Affairs Manager with a hands-on mentality and a genuine passion for clean beauty.

 - Academic background in cosmetic science, chemistry, pharmacy, nutritional science, or a related discipline.

 - Solid working knowledge of EU cosmetics regulation (EC No 1223/2009); familiarity with US FDA cosmetics requirements is a strong plus.

 - Experience in a regulatory, compliance, or quality role — ideally within the cosmetics, personal care, or pharmaceutical sector.

 - Structured, detail-oriented, and reliable: you take ownership of your work and flag risks early.

 - Comfortable working cross-functionally across product development, quality, and commercial teams — you collaborate without losing sight of regulatory rigor.

 - An analytical mindset with the ability to assess market trends and translate them into regulatory implications for our pipeline.

 - Clear communicator in both English and German — written and spoken — and comfortable representing the brand externally.

 - Proficient in Google Workspace; experience with regulatory databases or cosmetics compliance tools is a plus.




WHAT DOES YOSHI EN OFFER

 - An appealing discount on all Yoshi en & Edeneve products.

 - We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year.

 - The Urban Sports Club membership, Swapfiets bike rental and a subsidy for the BVG ticket.

 - Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia.

 - You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas.

 - Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas.

 - We, the Yoshi Group, like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such





Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations. 

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

description_plain:
ABOUT YEPODA

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe – online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

As Senior Brand Experience Manager, you will own the end-to-end customer and brand experience across all touchpoints, online and offline. Your focus is to map and elevate the customer journey, shape unboxing and product experience, and turn customer insight into segmentation and decisions that keep Yepoda consistent, desirable, and loved at every interaction.




YOUR TASKS 

 - Own the end-to-end customer journey across channels, identifying and resolving friction points through data, surveys, and feedback

 - Partner with Marketing, Website, and CRM to personalize digital experiences at scale

 - Lead the unboxing and product experience — packaging, inserts, merchandise — partnering with Creative and Product Development on new launches, artwork approvals, and regulatory compliance across markets

 - Build data-driven customer segmentation and personas with CRM and Data teams to power tailored journeys

 - Own Voice of Customer efforts (reviews, surveys, social listening, support) and the brand perception/awareness studies, turning insights into dashboards and recommendations

 - Track CX and brand health KPIs (NPS, repurchase rate, churn, Brand Health Index)

 - Guard brand consistency across tone, visuals, and copy; own the Brand Book and ensure correct use of sustainability certifications (B Corp, 1% for the Planet)

 - Mentor junior team members on tools, processes, and onboarding

 - Manage cross-functional brand projects (e.g. Advent Calendar, Holiday Boxes, Sephora editions) from concept to launch


YOUR PROFILE

 - 5+ experience in CX, brand marketing, or customer insights, ideally within beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands.

 - Proven ability to translate data and customer feedback into actionable strategy and measurable outcomes.

 - Experience managing cross-functional projects across marketing, product, creative, and operations.

 - Comfortable owning segmentation, journey mapping, and CX reporting end-to-end.

 - Some experience coaching or mentoring junior team members.

 - Highly organised, analytical, and detail-oriented, with strong project management skills across parallel workstreams.

 - Collaborative, calm, and adaptable in a fast-moving scale-up environment.

 - Fluent in English; additional European languages (e.g. German, French, Spanish, or Italian) are a plus.

 - Experience working closely with packaging design and production teams is a strong plus.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

 - Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

 - Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

 - Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

 - We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

 - Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

 - Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.



Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

At Yepoda we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.

description_plain:
Javvy is on a mission to set a new standard for café favorites with better-for-you beverages that are craveable, convenient, and without compromise. Positioned at the intersection of café culture, convenience, and functional nutrition, we’re reimagining the drinks people buy every day — proving you don’t have to compromise between great taste and quality ingredients. What began as a cult-favorite DTC brand has rapidly scaled into an omnichannel business, now expanding into major retail while building a loyal community around better-for-you café favorites.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Javvy is looking for a highly creative, hands-on Art Director to help shape and execute the next chapter of our visual brand.

We’re looking for a designer at heart—someone who can establish a strong creative vision, lead and develop a talented design team, and still jump into the work when needed. You’ll oversee creative across packaging, retail, ecommerce, product launches, photography, partnerships, and brand experiences while remaining close enough to the work to personally design and execute high-priority assets.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional design craft with strong creative judgment and knows how to build a cohesive brand across a rapidly growing omnichannel consumer business.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN




CREATIVE DIRECTION & BRAND

 - Help define and evolve Javvy’s visual identity across every consumer touchpoint.

 - Translate brand strategy and GTM priorities into compelling creative concepts and scalable visual systems.

 - Maintain and evolve brand guidelines as Javvy expands into new products, categories, partnerships, and channels.

 - Lead creative reviews and provide clear, actionable feedback that raises the quality of the work.

 - Ensure a cohesive brand experience across packaging, retail, ecommerce, social, photography, partnerships, and experiential.


HANDS-ON DESIGN & PRODUCTION

 - Remain actively involved in design—not just creative direction.

 - Personally concept, design, refine, or productionize priority projects across packaging, retail displays and POS, product mockups, partnerships, events, ecommerce, and launch assets.

 - Own or oversee artwork through final production, including dielines, printer-ready files, digital and print proofs, and production revisions.

 - Partner closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and external production partners to ensure creative is accurate, compliant, and production-ready.

 - Maintain a high standard of craft while operating effectively within fast-moving timelines.


PACKAGING, PRODUCT & OMNICHANNEL

 - Lead visual development for new SKUs, flavors, formats, product categories, and brand partnerships.

 - Develop packaging concepts that balance brand consistency, strong shelf presence, product communication, and consumer appeal.

 - Guide packaging from initial concept through approved production artwork.

 - Lead creative development across retail, DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and other ecommerce channels.

 - Oversee retail PDPs, shippers, displays, endcaps, shelf communication, signage, and other point-of-sale materials.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Brand, Retail, Ecommerce, Product, Operations, and Regulatory to deliver creative against launch timelines.


PHOTOGRAPHY, CONTENT & AI

 - Establish visual direction for product photography, lifestyle imagery, and campaign content.

 - Develop creative briefs and provide art direction for photographers and external creative partners.

 - Guide AI-generated product and lifestyle imagery while maintaining brand consistency and quality.

 - Identify opportunities to use emerging creative tools and AI to improve creative output and team efficiency.


TEAM LEADERSHIP

 - Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team of brand and digital designers.

 - Provide creative direction, thoughtful feedback, and hands-on coaching through regular creative reviews and 1:1s.

 - Prioritize workloads and allocate projects based on business needs, timelines, and team strengths.

 - Support hiring, portfolio reviews, onboarding, and development of creative talent.

 - Help improve creative workflows, briefing processes, organization, and production standards as the team scales.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of professional design experience, ideally within CPG, food & beverage, beauty, wellness, lifestyle, or another highly visual consumer category.

 - 2+ years of experience providing art direction or leading designers.

 - An exceptional portfolio demonstrating both strong conceptual thinking and hands-on execution.

 - Deep experience in packaging and print design, including dielines, production artwork, prepress, proofing, and working with production partners.

 - Experience designing for retail environments, including POS, displays, shippers, endcaps, and signage.

 - Strong understanding of ecommerce and digital design, including PDPs, campaign assets, and omnichannel launches.

 - Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.

 - Exceptional typography, layout, composition, color, and visual storytelling skills.

 - Experience directing photography and external creative partners.

 - Comfortable using—or eager to adopt—AI-powered creative tools as part of the modern design workflow.

 - Ability to move fluidly between big-picture creative direction and detailed production execution.

 - Strong project management and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple launches and collaborate across functions.




YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU…

 - Are equally comfortable developing the vision and opening the file to make it happen.

 - Love building brands across packaging, digital, retail, and real-world experiences.

 - Can turn a loose idea into a polished, scalable creative system.

 - Enjoy mentoring designers while still practicing your own craft.

 - Thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and there is always something new to build.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You’ll help Javvy build a stronger, more recognizable visual brand while making the creative organization faster and more scalable. You’ll give our designers clear direction and mentorship, serve as a trusted creative partner across the organization, and take our biggest launches from early ideas through polished, production-ready execution.

Most importantly, you won’t just tell the team what great creative should look like—you’ll be able to help make it.




WHY THIS ROLE ROCKS:

 - Competitive Salary

 - 100% Company-Paid Health, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance for employees
   (Family coverage available at employee cost)

 - 401(k) Retirement Plan

 - Parental Leave

 - Free Access to Javvy Products

 - Career Growth Opportunities

 - Collaborative, Fast-Paced Start-Up Environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

Javvy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and applicable laws.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications and may be modified as business needs evolve.

description_plain:
Help shape the future of food packaging at one of the fastest-growing brands in refrigerated and frozen foods. Kevin's Natural Foods is seeking a strategic and technically skilled Senior Packaging Engineer to lead packaging innovation, sustainability, commercialization, and compliance across our growing portfolio. This is an opportunity to influence everything from next-generation packaging technologies and consumer experience to automation strategy and enterprise sustainability roadmaps. Working across Operations, R&D, Quality, Procurement, and Mars Food & Nutrition, you'll turn bold product ideas into scalable packaging solutions that drive growth, reduce environmental impact, and strengthen operational performance. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges and building the future of packaging, we'd love to meet you!



What You’ll Do:

Packaging Strategy & Program Leadership

 - Own Kevin's packaging strategy and multi-year roadmap, balancing consumer experience, food safety, operational performance, sustainability, regulatory compliance, and total delivered cost.

 - Lead enterprise packaging initiatives across innovation, renovation, productivity, supply continuity, and sustainability programs.

 - Develop and execute Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) mitigation strategies, including regulatory assessments, fee reduction opportunities, packaging redesign initiatives, and compliance planning.

 - Serve as the packaging technical authority, influencing cross-functional decisions and guiding long-term packaging investments.

Packaging Qualification & Validation Leadership

 - Design and govern the company's packaging qualification process, including standards, protocols, decision criteria, documentation requirements, and commercialization readiness reviews.

 - Develop risk-based qualification strategies for new materials, packaging formats, suppliers, equipment, and manufacturing processes.

 - Establish testing frameworks that evaluate package performance across product quality, shelf life, distribution, manufacturability, sustainability, and consumer use requirements.

 - Lead cross-functional qualification planning from concept through commercialization, ensuring alignment across R&D, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Marketing.

Package Development & Commercialization

 - Lead development and implementation of primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging solutions across refrigerated and frozen product categories.

 - Own packaging specifications, BOMs, technical drawings, and engineering standards to support scalable growth and strong change management practices.

 - Evaluate emerging packaging technologies, materials, and supplier innovations to improve performance, sustainability, and cost.

 - Provide technical leadership during plant trials, scale-ups, and commercialization events to ensure successful launches.

Qualification Execution & Performance Validation

 - Develop and execute package test plans covering shelf-life performance, seal integrity, transportation durability, environmental conditioning, and consumer use requirements.

 - Lead packaging capability studies to evaluate manufacturing performance, equipment compatibility, dimensional control, critical-to-quality attributes, and operational readiness.

 - Analyze qualification results, identify risks, and make data-driven recommendations regarding commercialization readiness and long-term package performance.

 - Partner with Quality, Operations, Procurement and suppliers to investigate failures, implement corrective actions, and validate sustainable solutions.

Operational Excellence & Supplier Partnership

 - Evaluate packaging solutions for manufacturability, automation compatibility, labor efficiency, line performance, and OEE impact.

 - Lead packaging-related root cause investigations and continuous improvement initiatives to reduce waste, improve reliability, and lower total cost.

 - Build strategic supplier relationships that drive innovation, improve performance, and ensure supply continuity.

 - Collaborate across Operations, R&D, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Mars Food & Nutrition to deliver scalable packaging solutions that support business growth.

Continuous Improvement & Capability Building

 - Develop packaging standards, governance processes, and best practices that support organizational growth and operational excellence.

 - Mentor team members and cross-functional partners on packaging technologies, qualification methodologies, and commercialization processes.

 - Establish scalable systems for packaging documentation, change management, and knowledge transfer.

 - Stay ahead of industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory developments to inform packaging strategy and business decisions.

 - Other duties as assigned and necessary.



What You’ll Need:

Required Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field.

 - 7+ years of progressive experience in packaging engineering, packaging development, or packaging commercialization.

 - Experience within food, beverage, refrigerated, frozen, protein, meal-kit, or consumer packaged goods industries.

 - Demonstrated success leading packaging projects from concept through commercialization.

 - Deep technical expertise in packaging materials, structures, converting processes, and manufacturing systems.

 - Experience developing and executing packaging qualification and validation programs.

 - Strong knowledge of food industry regulations and standards, including FDA, USDA, SQF, HACCP, and GMP requirements.

 - Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across multiple functions.

 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis capabilities.

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills.

 - Willingness to travel up to 20-30% for supplier engagement, testing, and plant support.

 - Passion for the clean-eating, better-for-you food space and a desire to contribute to a mission-driven brand.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Advanced degree in Packaging, Engineering, Materials Science, or related discipline.

 - Experience leading packaging sustainability initiatives.

 - Experience with Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) programs and packaging regulations.

 - Knowledge of recyclability assessments, PCR content strategies, and circular packaging design principles.

 - Exposure to packaging automation, equipment integration, and manufacturing optimization initiatives.

 - Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent continuous improvement experience.



Healthy, Diverse Teams Breed Innovation:

Kevin’s Natural Foods is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We deeply believe that diverse backgrounds and experiences make better teams, and we seek to attract talent from all walks of life. The team at Kevin’s is smart, humble, and passionate and we value a work environment that fosters personal development and opportunities to move within our small, but quickly growing organization.



More About Kevin’s Natural Foods:

Kevin's Natural Foods is a line of refrigerated and frozen meals, sides, soups, and sauces on a mission to empower even the busiest people to eat clean without sacrificing flavor. Co-founded by Kevin McCray who battled an auto-immune disorder for years, Kevin's Natural Foods was born from his desire to make clean eating seamlessly fit into any lifestyle. Shockingly delicious and made with clean ingredients, Kevin’s products are ready in minutes and always free from gluten, soy, and refined sugar. I

n 2023, Kevin’s Natural Foods joined the Mars Food & Nutrition family, allowing us to expand our reach, accelerate innovation, and bring our mission to even more households while staying true to the quality and integrity that define our brand. A true market disruptor, Kevin's is the first clean refrigerated entrée brand working to prove every day that proper nutrition can be as delicious as it is healthy.

description_plain:
At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams.


We’re a Berlin-based AgriTech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and Kaufland to reduce emissions across their supply chains and build long-term resilience. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet!



Your mission:

You are responsible for translating regenerative agricultural expertise and science in arable farming systems in temperate climates into actionable, scalable digital products for farmers on Klim's platform.

You ensure that Klim’s digital products are agronomically sound, farmer-relevant, commercially viable and delivered with high quality.



Your responsibilities:

 - Own the agronomic logic behind farmer-facing recommendations and assessments - cover crop mixes, tillage transitions, rotation changes, nutrient decisions - and judge whether a given recommendation makes sense for a given soil, location and goal.

 - Translate agronomy into buildable products. Turn agronomic principles into clear product and engineering specifications.

 - Bring empathy to the farmer’s context into our products. What is going on around our product for the farmers, what data are accessible and reasonable to ask for, what value we can deliver back to famers.

 - Act as a sparring partner to product, design and modelling. Challenge assumptions, find the gaps in our thinking, and say when an approach won't land with a farmer.

 - Challenge models and outputs against field reality. You dig into the numbers, spot what doesn't add up, and explain why a result contradicts what you would expect from experience.

 - Think like the farm owner, not just the agronomist. Tell us where farmers will hesitate, what proof they'll ask for, and what makes the change worth it to them, in money and beyond.

 - Own and review agronomic datasets, literature, and assumptions used in digital products.

 - Contribute to roadmap and prioritization decisions based on farmer value, willingness to pay, partner value, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance.

 - Support farmer validation through interviews, feedback analysis, test cases, and field-reality checks.

 - Support expansion into new regions by working out how farming systems differ and what that means for our recommendations.



Your profile:

 - You have 5+ years of experience in farm management, agronomic advisory, farm business consultancy, or a comparable role where you carried responsibility for real decisions on real farms.

 - You have a solid academic background in agronomy, agricultural sciences, or a related discipline. A strong practical track record can stand in its place.

 - You have strong, hands-on experience in open-field arable systems (cereals, oilseeds, root crops) in temperate Europe.

 - You have a deep understanding of regenerative arable farming, including soil health, nutrient management, crop rotations, cover crops, tillage, and reduced-input systems.

 - You have proven hands-on farm economics experience. You have built an investment case alongside a farmer and know which arguments actually convince, and which don't.

 - You combine regenerative conviction with practical judgment. You believe in regenerative impact and know what farmers will realistically adopt: no evangelism, no greenwashing.

 - You are interested in technology. You have used farm software, and follow what is happening in the space and believe in the potential but also see the issues.

 - You can find your way around a spreadsheet or a set of performance figures and spot where the logic breaks.

 - You have a creative spark. Given a half-formed idea, you improve it rather than only evaluate it.


LANGUAGES

 - Fluent English and fluent German. Most of our farmers are German, and you will be talking to them, reading their feedback and reviewing German farmer-facing copy. Experience of the German market is a strong advantage.
   
   

Your benefits:

 - Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

 - Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

 - Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

 - Flexible work model: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

 - Additional benefits for Germany-based employees: We offer a subsidy for a membership in  Urban Sports Club or  the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events.



At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realise!

description_plain:
ABOUT HALTER

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No ATVs, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic.

 

Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. Halter’s product, already at scale in New Zealand and Australia, brings a world leading solution to the market. Our first cohort of customers are thriving with Halter, and we are building out our team to scale Halter to thousands of customers throughout the U.S.



People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving real-world problems with a talented team and in a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.  We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.






ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re on the lookout for a Product Specialist to take ownership of Halter’s product and associated development projects in the U.S. You’ll work closely with the Halter HQ in New Zealand, the commercial team in the U.S.and our ranchers to ensure the Halter product is delivering undeniable value.



Halter is one of the world’s fastest-growing agritech companies, and the most transformative technology available in pasture-based grazing. With Halter’s cattle collars and app, ranchers can virtually fence and shift their cattle, as well as proactively monitor cattle locations and behavior.



We are looking for big thinkers who know how to get stuff done. We’re looking for people who are natural problem-solvers and are comfortable working in a dynamic, high-energy environment where they will be challenged on a daily basis. Our ideal person for this role is someone who is committed to deeply understanding our product and customers' needs. Above all else, you will care about our cattle and customers and champion their interests across Halter.



Travel will be required in this role.



What your day could look like:

 - Spending time on ranch with customers to figure out what we need to improve, fix, or build next to ensure that ranchers get the most value out of Halter.

 - Working closely with our product and engineering teams; providing input and feedback to make sure that Halter is always working on the most important projects and that we build what our ranchers need.

 - Leading projects to enable continuous innovation and expansion of the product, from design to execution to conclusion.

 - Sharing in-depth knowledge and context about U.S. ranches, animals and virtual fencing throughout Halter.

 - Partnering with our Territory managers to maintain strong alignment.

 - Critically thinking about the product end-to-end to proactively and reactively start initiatives valuable for our ranchers’ and their cattle.

 - Working with strategic customers to make sure they are fully utilizing the product and receiving value.

 - Other tasks from time to time to ensure the ultimate success of Halter in the U.S.






WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 - Interest in agri-tech, being tech-savvy and not afraid of learning our product's inner details and functionality.

 - Ranching experience is a must-have and be passionate about animals and the future of agriculture.

 - A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges.

 - Experience in leading cross-functional projects or running research trials.

 - Fast learner who is motivated to work hard and learn with a team doing things that have never been done before

 - Proven ability to think critically about a problem and reach strong, innovative conclusions

 - Thrive in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of autonomy and resilient & comfortable with ambiguity

 - Willing to travel for work (domestic and international) as well as weekends

 - A 'get stuff done' attitude!

description_plain:
At Orchard, we’re securing America’s food supply by building the AI Farmer that automates our nation’s farms. We are the industry leader, growing rapidly, and backed by more than $25 million from leading investors, including Quiet Capital, Shine Capital, and General Catalyst.

 

Every year, hundreds of billions of dollars in crop value are lost because critical farming decisions are made using incomplete and imprecise data. We’re building the technology to change that.

 

Our AI-powered camera systems mount to tractors and scan millions of trees, vines, and plants, capturing precise data on yield estimates, fruit size, crop health, disease, and more. We train edge vision AI models that analyze every plant and determine exactly what interventions and treatments it needs. That intelligence flows into FruitScope OS, our farm-management platform, where growers can understand their crops, make better decisions, and direct operations in the field.

 

Today, Orchard’s technology is trusted by some of our nation’s largest farms. They use our products to grow higher-quality crops while reducing chemical use and operating costs, helping them farm more profitably and sustainably than ever before.

 


OUR CULTURE:

 - Unshakeable Resilience – Our customers feed millions of people, and our customers depend on us. We are ultra-hardworking, never give up, and we do whatever it takes.

 - Always Keep Moving – We move fast, waste no time, and have an extreme bias towards action. Progress compounds every day, and our impact is measured in decades.

 - Improve Everything – At 1% success, we save millions of pounds of food from going to waste. If we are 100% successful we will impact the lives of billions of people across the world.

 - Farmers First – Every team member spends at least a few days in the fields with our farmers each month.

 - No Job Beneath Us – We’re low ego, own every outcome, and are all working towards the same goal.

 


THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Robotics Engineer at Orchard, you'll apply your cutting-edge robotics expertise at real-world farms. You'll deploy, develop, and implement our AI-powered camera systems in the fields.

You'll spend about 50% of your time traveling to beautiful farms (apple orchards, vineyards, nut farms, strawberry farms, etc) across California, Washington, and occasionally other parts of the country. 

You'll work closely with our farmers, sales team, and engineers, rapidly solving problems and iterating on our technology in the fields. The remaining 50% of your time will be spent remotely, working with our core engineering team from home.

You'll thrive if you enjoy technology and nature, are highly self-driven, and love engaging directly with customers.



About the Role:

 - Full-time, remote role with frequent travel (approximately 50% farm-based, 50% work-from-home).

 - Frequent flying/driving/hotel stays near farms, typically involving scenic drives of 1-3 hours to customer fields (all travel expenses fully covered by the company).

 - Many opportunities to directly influence product development.

 - Perfect if you are a hardcore engineer who also loves nature.

 - Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental coverage, and we cover 100% of the premium.

 - Our team is close-knit & highly driven, you’ll work directly with our CEO and entire team.

 - We’re deeply motivated by the impact we’re making – every line of code written or new system built means less food that goes to waste, and more people who are fed.



What You'll Do:

 - Deploy, debug, and develop the next generation(s) of our advanced, tractor-mounted camera systems at customer sites, ensuring they perform exceptionally in diverse farm environments.

 - Work closely with our farmers to deeply understand their operational needs, gather insights, and translate their feedback into real improvements.

 - Partner with our sales team during customer demonstrations to showcase Orchard's technology to new farmers.

 - Innovate and prototype creative solutions to unique problems encountered in the field, leveraging your robotics and engineering expertise.

 - Be a generalist, supporting different parts of our software and hardware stack if needed.



What Makes You a Good Fit:

 - 1-3 years of relevant experience in industry or academia.

 - Strong technical skills in robotics (Python, C++, embedded hardware, computer vision, localization, sensor fusion, or robotics hardware). 

 - You don't mind frequent travel, spending time out in the fields, and love the outdoors.

 - Self-motivated, able to solve problems independently and thrive in unstructured environments.

 - Excellent interpersonal skills and genuine excitement about engaging with customers.

 - Must not have allergies to common agricultural products (nuts, apples, grapes, strawberries, blueberries)



Bonus Points:

 - Experience optimizing robotics algorithms for embedded platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson).

 - Familiarity with agriculture or outdoor equipment.

 - Previous startup, outdoor adventure, or field deployment experience.



If you're looking to help make a positive impact in the world by building the future of farming, come join us!

description_plain:
As a purpose-driven, certified B corporation, Clover is leading the way for conscious businesses by demonstrating care for all stakeholders and moving the world forward. We are committed to lowering our environmental impact and meeting our sustainability targets, by providing kids and adults with healthy, nutritious, and delicious products that are made with care for animals, people, and the planet.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your expertise in quality and food safety directly impacts product excellence? We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Quality Assurance Manager to be at the heart of delivering on our promise of safe, healthy, and delicious dairy every single day. This pivotal role ensures that every drop of milk meets the highest standards of quality and safety by adhering to our commitment to excellence.

As our Quality Assurance Manager, you'll be responsible for implementing and maintaining the quality and food safety programs for Clover’s fluid dairy processing plant to ensure Clover is able to manufacture and deliver safe, healthy, and delicious food each day. They will manage a team of quality assurance technicians and be an integral part of Clover’s daily operations.




A DAY IN THE LIFE

 - Responsible for establishing, implementing, and directing quality control, quality assurance, and food safety programs to ensure conformance to standards.

 - Work closely as an integral partner with all operations departments to develop and maintain a culture of quality, food safety, and continuous improvement.

 - Implement and manage the site’s SQF Food Safety and Quality Plan.

 - Manage the daily activities of the team of 7 QA technicians.

 - Provide timely results and data analysis on various quality and safety metrics.

 - Perform food safety and sanitation audits to ensure compliance with company programs, customer expectations, and state and federal regulations.

 - Maintain an accredited Appendix N testing laboratory

 - Laboratory testing on raw materials, packaging, WIP, and finished products.

 - Calibration and operation of FTIR milk analyzer equipment.

 - Communication with Clover dairy producers on milk quality topics.

 - Provide technical support to vendors, customers, and various company departments as needed


WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

 - Demonstrated success in leading and managing people in a team environment

 - Demonstrated responsibility for food safety and quality.

 - Strong analytical and problem solving abilities.

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including oral and written communication skills.

 - Knowledge of food microbiology, chemistry, dairy standards and CIP sanitation.

 - Working knowledge of HACCP and GFSI compliant programs

 - Strong computer skills (Microsoft Office suite, Google suite, ERP).

 - Perform moderate physical labor on the job to include walking, climbing steps and ladders, lifting 50lbs, pushing and pulling 200lbs.

 - Must be shift flexible – company is operational 24/7


EDUCATION

Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Food Science, Microbiology, or related field and 3 or more years of quality assurance experience in a food processing environment - OR - an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job as defined above.



Based in Petaluma, California, in the heart of beautiful Sonoma County, Clover Sonoma offers high quality dairy sourced from its network of local family farms. A pioneer in sustainable dairy farming Clover has the largest organic acreage of regeneratively farmed land in the state and is committed to reducing its carbon footprint by lowering on-farm methane emissions, regenerative farming practices focused on soil health and packaging innovation. The first dairy in the US to become American Humane certified across all of its farms, Clover has delivered on its promise of producing the highest-quality dairy products — including milk, cheese, butter, and more — for more than a century. 

As a Certified B Corporation® Clover gives back 5% of net profits to help make nutritious food more accessible and uses its business as a power for good across its support for people, farms, animals, community and planet. 

For more information, please visit www.cloversonoma.com http://www.cloversonoma.com and join the conversation on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/CloverSonoma, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/clover.sonoma/, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clover-stornetta-farms-inc., TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/discover/clover-sonoma, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/cloversonoma.

description_plain:
The R&D Manager at Kevin’s Natural Foods plays a critical role in driving the innovation and development of our clean-label product portfolio. This role is responsible for leading the Product Development team, overseeing the commercialization process from concept to production, and ensuring new and optimized products meet our high-quality, nutritious, and flavorful standards. This position combines technical expertise in food science with strategic leadership, project management, and cross-functional collaboration to support Kevin’s mission: empowering even the busiest people to eat clean without sacrificing flavor.



What You’ll Do:

• Lead, mentor, and develop an R&D product development team, fostering a culture of 

innovation, curiosity, and accountability.

• Oversee all aspects of new product development from ideation, recipe creation, pilot 

production, scale-up, and commercialization.

• Drive project prioritization, resource allocation, and timelines to ensure efficient and 

successful product launches.

• Lead recipe formulation, costing, ingredient sourcing, and process optimization while 

maintaining compliance with SQF, USDA, and other certifications.

• Collaborate with nutritionists, QA/QC, and culinary teams to ensure products meet 

nutritional, sensory, and safety standards.

• Evaluate and implement emerging food trends, new ingredients, and innovative 

processing techniques.

• Work cross-functionally to set the strategic vision for product innovation, aligning new 

concepts with company goals, consumer trends, and competitive insights.

• Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Brand teams to support product launches, packaging, development, and marketing campaigns.

• Assist with taste panels, consumer testing, and sensory evaluations to ensure products exceed expectations.

• Serve as the primary R&D liaison for label approvals (GFCO/Paleo/NGPV/USDA) and 

regulatory compliance.

• Establish and maintain robust R&D processes, documentation standards, and best 

practices.

• Troubleshoot production issues, monitor consistency and quality, and optimize 

manufacturing processes.

• Maintain detailed records in recipe/formula systems, ensuring accuracy and 

reproducibility.

• Other duties as assigned to support the growth and evolution of Kevin’s Natural Foods.

• All other duties as assigned or necessary. 



What You’ll Need:

• Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Nutrition, or Culinary School 

certification; advanced degree a plus.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in food product development in a manufacturing 

environment, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.

• Deep knowledge of ingredient functionality, flavor development, sensory evaluation, and clean-label product development.

• Strong understanding of food science principles, GMP, HACCP, food safety, and 

regulatory compliance.

• Proven experience managing teams, projects, and cross-functional initiatives in a fast paced environment.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.

documentation.




Healthy, Diverse Teams Breed Innovation:
