description_plain:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Director of Editorial role at Suno is a leadership position that will help establish the framework and POV of editorial at Suno. We are growing a generational company

The ideal candidate is someone who…

 - Lives and breathes a diverse range of music

 - Attends live shows regularly

 - Has deep relationships across labels, artists, managers, and the broader music ecosystem

 - Is A trusted taste-maker whose recommendations people seek out — friends, colleagues, and industry contacts alike

 - Is fluent in how music moves online: platforms, subcultures, meme-to-mainstream pipelines, and how virality and quality intersect

 - Is comfortable being both a strategist and a doer — equally at ease setting editorial vision and personally selecting tracks for a playlist

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/UR6HQyggM89GakwE




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Set the editorial vision for how music is discovered and celebrated within Suno, including in-app playlist curation, artist spotlights, and genre, style and mood taxonomy

 - Oversee the development and maintenance of Suno's curation frameworks — ensuring the platform's musical taxonomy reflects both the breadth of Suno's community and the evolving landscape of AI-generated music

 - Champion artist spotlights and features as a meaningful touchpoint for community recognition and platform storytelling

 - Ensure editorial decisions are informed by data, community feedback, and cultural context, balancing algorithmic signals with human taste

 - Help build and lead the editorial team, including hiring, mentoring, and setting the standards for how curators evaluate and select music

 - Work collaboratively with and earn the trust of the current members of the team, rather than disrupting the ecosystem on Day 1

 - Partner with Product and Engineering to define how editorial signals (human curation) and algorithmic recommendation systems work together, rather than in competition

 - Develop a POV on how music made with Suno should be evaluated editorially — what "quality" and "originality" mean in this context, and how that differs from (or resembles) traditional A&R judgment

 - Manage editorial balance between music made with Suno and music licensed for Suno

 - Drive editorial not only from the lens of discovery but also engagement/remixing

 - Represent Suno's editorial voice externally — in artist and label conversations, press, and partnerships — as a credible authority on music discovery

 - Define and track success metrics for editorial programs (engagement, retention, artist satisfaction) and report on program impact to leadership
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 10+ years of experience in A&R, editorial, or a related field within the music industry

 - A genuine point of view on music curation, discovery, and what makes an editorial program feel authentic and culturally resonant

 - Strong operational instincts with experience building and improving processes across marketing or editorial workflows

 - AI fluency, or at the very least curiosity and fair review of music made with AI-assistance

 - Familiarity with metadata and taxonomy systems

 - Excellent communicator: able to represent Suno credibly with senior artist teams and external partners, and communicate clearly and directly internally

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by the pace and possibility of a high-growth environment

 - Passion for music and sincere belief in technology's potential to expand creative access and expression

 - A roll-up-your-sleeves mentality as we grow rapidly and are building a generational company

 - A passion for music, culture, and creativity, with a finger on the pulse of industry trends.

 - Ability to work cross-functionally across multiple teams (marketing, brand, creative, growth, engineering) that are growing rapidly


PREFERRED

 - Experience at a streaming, publication, or AI company

 - Familiarity with music taxonomy, metadata, or editorial curation systems

 - Experience working within or alongside product and engineering teams





PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)



Additional Notes:

 - Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 - This role requires working onsite at one of our offices.

 

Compensation:

The annual salary range for this role is $200,000 – $263,000



Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

description_plain:
About Early Media

Early Media is a media company creating and distributing groundbreaking digital series. We craft narratives with real viral potential and mass appeal while preserving the heart of indie production, telling meaningful stories audiences actually care about. Every creative decision is sharpened by a proprietary testing and marketing engine that collapses the distance between producer and consumer into the tightest iteration loop in the industry.

We're hiring a Scripted Producer to own individual series from pre-production through final delivery, while simultaneously helping build the infrastructure and standards that will power our scripted department. The playbook doesn't exist yet. You'll be doing real producing work while helping write it. If you've ever wanted to shape a production department, not just operate within one, this is that opportunity.



What you'll own

 - Your assigned series from kickoff through delivery; timelines, budgets, crew, and day-to-day logistics with minimal oversight.

 - Pre-production: breakdowns, scheduling, budgeting, location scouting, crew and vendor coordination.

 - The relationship between your creative team and Production leadership.

 - Department infrastructure: workflows, templates, and systems that can scale as the slate grows.

 - Talent relationships: writers, directors, and crew members worth building long-term connections with.

 - A creative perspective on your projects.



Must-haves

 - A builder, not just a producer. You're energized by creating the infrastructure, not just running it. If you need the playbook to already exist, this isn't the role.

 - 4-7 years of producing experience in scripted television, film, or high-volume digital/streaming content.

 - Track record taking scripted projects from development through delivery independently, across multiple formats or lengths.

 - Strong budget management; you know where costs hide.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. You create structure where there isn't any.

 - Experience managing junior production staff including coordinators and assistants.

 - Experience producing multiple simultaneous projects.



Nice to Have

 - Experience at an early-stage or startup production company where you've built infrastructure alongside producing.

 - Background producing content in social-first, short-form, or digital formats.

 - Existing relationships with writers, directors, or department heads in the scripted space.

 - Familiarity with production management tools (Wrapbook, Movie Magic Budgeting and Scheduling).

 - Understanding of how vertical, social-first content goes viral.

description_plain:
ABOUT THE JOB

 

Palette is a fast-growing startup at the center of the creator economy. Our team of 80+ is working towards defining the standard for talent management and marketing in an era of new media dominated by digital-first entertainers.

 

Our management infrastructure mirrors the depth of attention given to the world’s biggest cultural and entertainment icons, and previously reserved for artists in traditional arenas of entertainment. Today, it services a roster of 200+ creators and influencers with a combined following of 1B+ serving over 45.8B impressions monthly. Our creators have starred in Super Bowl commercials, launched national brands, and have been featured in nearly every major publication.

 

Our marketing agency executes strategy for some of the most influential brands and organizations in the world, including: The Biden White House, Amazon, simplehuman, and the Gates Foundation. 42% of Americans under the age of 40 are no longer accessible through traditional marketing channels – we enable organizations to speak to those audiences. Our marketing team has been recognized with 5 Shorty Impact Awards, and has advised three US Presidents on the future of the internet.

 


THE ROLE



Palette is looking for a Talent Coordinator to assist in the talent department’s day-to-day client management. The Talent Coordinator will have the ability to help shape our creators’ career trajectories and build their businesses cohesively. We want someone who will care for the well-being and growth of our creators, work with precision under tight timeframes, be responsive to all necessary requests around the clock, and have a can-do attitude.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES



 - Serve as Talent Coordinator servicing a roster of talent.

 - This includes communicating between the partner and creator expected delivery dates, delays, and re-draft requirements + caption requirements + live links, adding the opted-in offer to our internal accounting system, and procuring payment remittance details for accounting department.

 - Attend stand up meetings (1pm ET / 10am PT) with Talent Team, along with creator regroup meetings on a recurring basis, depending on the creator. In these meetings, the Talent Coordinator will come prepared with talking points in conjunction with the Manager of the respective creator, as well as take notes on the call for all follow up / action items.

 - Actively respond across the various channels of communication (imessage text group threads, slack, whatsapp, etc.).

 - Present potential management scouting selections on a weekly basis, as well as attend intro meetings with potential signees.

 - Keep up with the latest social media trends such as, but not limited to news stories, memes, trending sounds, etc.

 - Maintain an organized process and structure.




QUALIFICATIONS



 - 1-2 years of social media marketing (experience working with brand negotiation & deliverables) or project management experience (sending calendar invites, project management tool experience, detail oriented)

 - Has a passion for short form as well as new media and other social platforms

 - Able to proactively troubleshoot and problem solve quickly and through the proper escalation process

 - Strong verbal and written communication skills, ability to effectively translate technical language to non-technical stakeholders

 - Working knowledge of Google Workspace. Hubspot and Canva knowledge a plus

 - Excellent collaboration skills

 - High attention to detail and very organized

 - Self-starter, a fast learner who has critical thinking

 - A positive attitude and keen team player

 - The ability to work within strict branding guidelines




THE FOLLOWING SKILLS ARE NOT REQUIRED, BUT A PLUS:



 - Experience working at an agency

 - Ability to analyze data and identify insights to assess campaign performance

description_plain:
Advanced Systems Group, LLC enables creativity through better technology and operations for media creatives and content owners. From acquisition to delivery, on-premises or in the cloud, ASG ensures our clients’ success through tailored solutions. One of North America’s largest Media and Entertainment Technology and Operations suppliers, we provide engineering services, physical and cloud integration, training, support, and managed services. ASG delivers customized operations and services for all phases of media production, including creative and engineering. Founded in 1997, and providing nationwide services, ASG has teams based in North America, South America, and Europe.

Job Summary

Are you passionate about creating the future of live broadcasts? Join Advanced Systems Group as a Broadcast Engineer and fuel your career in an environment where innovation and impact go hand-in-hand. As a pivotal member of our Live Production Technical Operations team, you’ll be hands-on at the studio and at the bleeding edge of cloud production technology—helping deliver live broadcast experiences seen by millions worldwide.

Collaborate closely with industry leaders like our Technical Director and Extended Workforce Lead to conceptualize, build, and refine state-of-the-art control room and cloud-based systems. You’ll have the unique opportunity to influence system architecture, work with cutting-edge equipment, and solve complex technical challenges. If you're ready to think big, bring strategic vision, and work in a high-impact, visible role, this is the perfect place for you.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Design and Deploy: Partner with the Technical Operations team to architect and implement innovative on-prem, hybrid, and cloud-based production systems for enterprise-level experiences.

 - Lead Technical Success: Participate in cross-team training and technical knowledge sharing while supporting day-to-day studio operations.

 - Drive Broadcast Excellence: Oversee technical planning, encoder validation, and lead live test broadcasts.

 - Hands-on Systems Work: Configure, maintain, and integrate essential studio technologies—including Grass Valley, Calrec, and AIMedia systems—to ensure seamless operation.

 - Cloud Innovation: Support the expansion of control room functions into the cloud (AWS, AWS Elemental MediaLive), boosting scalability and compliance for our client.

 - Collaborate for Impact: Be a technical consultant to post-production, creative, and production teams—integrating new workflows and features that keep us at the forefront.

 - Problem Solve: Quickly triage, summarize and prioritize technical concerns, aligning future solutions and guaranteeing world-class live broadcasts.
   
   

What You'll Bring:

 - Deep technical know-how in studio production and IP-driven broadcast workflows

 - Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Clear, confident written and verbal communication

 - Detail-oriented with high initiative and ownership

 - Ability to craft and interpret technical documentation

 - Driven to respond and follow through for both internal and client stakeholders

 - Forward-thinking with a passion for innovation and customer service



Required Qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Communications Technology, or similar, OR an equivalent mix of education and hands-on experience

 - Experience supporting live studio environments

 - Demonstrated ability to work autonomously in high-stakes broadcast scenarios

 - Strong grasp of project and site management

 - Knowledge of signal flow, network architecture, and cloud IT infrastructure



Nice to Have:

 - IP networking and SMPTE 2110 experience

 - Demonstrated team collaboration and leadership

 - Background in automated/non-automated material handling systemst



Work Schedule:

 - Full-time, On-site

 - Call times are typically standard business hours for streams, with occasional early or late starts; occasional weekends
   
   

Are you ready to engineer live broadcasts for an audience of millions—driving innovation at the forefront of digital media and e-commerce? If you dream of working in a high-impact role with an industry-defining client, where your ideas and expertise elevate productions seen around the globe, we’d love to hear from you!



Apply today to join Advanced Systems Group and help define the future of live content.

Advanced Systems Group LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

description_plain:
Advanced Systems Group, LLC enables creativity through better technology and operations for media creatives and content owners. From acquisition to delivery, on-premises or in the cloud, ASG ensures our clients’ success through tailored solutions. One of North America’s largest Media and Entertainment Technology and Operations suppliers, we provide engineering services, physical and cloud integration, training, support, and managed services. ASG delivers customized operations and services for all phases of media production, including creative and engineering. Founded in 1997, and providing nationwide services, ASG has teams based in North America, South America, and Europe.

THIS ROLE IS ONLY OPEN TO CANDIDATES IN THE UNITED STATES WITH VALID WORK AUTHORIZATION.

 

Join Our Creative Team at Advanced Systems Group!

Are you passionate about motion design, storytelling, and shaping the way audiences engage with brands on social platforms? At Advanced Systems Group, we’re looking for a dynamic Motion Graphic Designer to bring inventive ideas, artistic flair, and exceptional technical skills to our fast-moving creative production team. If you thrive in high-energy environments and love turning imaginative concepts into visual masterpieces, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Do:

 - Lead end-to-end creation of stunning motion graphics, kinetic typography, and engaging animated videos for major social media campaigns, video platforms, and high-impact corporate content.

 - Collaborate with visionary team leads and stakeholders—translating ambitious ideas into compelling, executable motion content that breaks through the noise.

 - Champion the motion design identity, ensuring every asset you touch is on-brand and visually outstanding.

 - Build and optimize "Essential Graphics" templates in After Effects to empower seamless workflows and creative flexibility for the whole team.

 - Organize design assets with precision to enable effortless collaboration on projects and maintain high standards for every animation.

 - Apply your expertise in illustration, video editing, and deck design to support a wide array of creative initiatives.

 - Tackle urgent creative requests with calm, professionalism, and sharp problem-solving under pressure—your speed and agility keep projects on track.

 - Express your ideas and rationale clearly as you present designs, pitch concepts, and explain creative solutions to cross-functional teams.

 - Manage multiple fast-paced projects at once, keeping high-quality output flowing under tight, ever-changing deadlines.

 - Stay on the cutting edge by researching industry trends, new technologies, and evolving social media formats—ensuring our content leads the market.

Why Join Us?

 - Be at the forefront of motion graphics for industry-leading brands

 - Collaborate with a vibrant, multidisciplinary team that values creativity and outside-the-box ideas

 - Access cutting-edge creative tools—including the latest generative AI models

 - Drive real impact and see your work showcased in major campaigns

 - Enjoy opportunities to develop new skills, pursue your passion for design, and grow your career in a supportive, innovation-focused environment

What We’re Looking For:

 - Meticulous attention to detail and capacity to juggle multiple projects and urgent deadlines

 - Adaptability and creative agility in a rapidly evolving media landscape

 - Organizational superpowers and the ability to deliver high-quality results in a high-volume, deadline-driven setting

 - Brilliant storytelling instincts—able to distill technical or data-heavy concepts into simple, captivating motion stories

 - Strong command of animation fundamentals (timing, pacing, easing, anticipation)

Requirements:

 - BA/BS degree in Design, CS, or relevant experience

 - 6+ years of hands-on social content design—ideally in an agency, brand, or newsroom environment

 - Advanced skills in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and familiarity with Premiere, Photoshop, Cinema 4D

 - Experience leveraging Google generative AI models (Nano Banana, Veo, Flow) to push creative boundaries

 - In-depth understanding of each major social/video platform (LinkedIn, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube) and what makes content shine there

 - Rigorous grasp of design fundamentals and current trends

 - Working knowledge of the Google App Suite

Bonus Points:

 - Proven experience collaborating on cross-team projects

 - Strong skills in Adobe Creative Suite for developing static designs and templates

 - Familiarity with B2B and digital marketing creative best practices

If you’re ready to deliver next-level motion graphics that engage, inspire, and leave a lasting mark, let’s create something incredible together. Apply today—your talent belongs here!

Senior game designer for a new project in Shanghai, designing and implementing gameplay features, combat encounters, enemies, and level content in Unreal Engine.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 7+ years of professional experience as a gameplay or game designer.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Demonstrable experience crafting second-to-second action gameplay, such as level mechanics, layout design, or enemy/AI behavior.
- Familiarity with level design tools and concepts and a proven track record of building level blockouts.
- Experience with combat AI and familiarity with Unreal Behavior Trees.
- Extensive knowledge of Unreal's GAS, from Gameplay Effects to Ability Modifiers.
- At least 7 years of professional experience as a Gameplay Designer, including combat gameplay and/or level content created in Unreal Engine and Blueprint.
- Proven ability to implement enemies, NPCs, and combat mechanics into encounters.
- Ability to independently design new features and systems and support their implementation.
- Experience using AI in day-to-day work.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
No geographic filter: the role is onsite in Shanghai, China, and relocation is provided for hires from any location.

description_plain:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/514dfb89-54b4-4bf3-afe0-ceaf4ae3147e/our%20mission%20board.png]


We are looking for a passionate and experienced game designer who specializes in Unreal Engine to join our Shanghai Studio.

You will be working on one of our new projects. You should be able to independently design new features and systems, and support their implementation, but the ideal candidate will have demonstrable experience in crafting second-to-second action gameplay, including, but not limited to level mechanics, layout design and enemy/AI behavior.

If you think that describes you, then we’d love to hear from you.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/66a7198f-9ccd-4ba2-ac72-488ce331f438/banner_narrow_customs.jpg]




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Prototype gameplay content (mechanics, enemies, level interactivity) by yourself with minimal dependencies on other disciplines.

 - On-hands design and iteration of new features, game mechanics and gameplay content

 - Collaborate with other disciplines to follow your designs from initial documentation through to final in-engine polish.

 - Support the development of the game with any additional skills.
   
   


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - At least 7 years of professional experience as a Gameplay Designer with a portfolio demonstrating combat gameplay and/or level content created by yourself using Unreal Engine & Blueprint.

 - Proven ability to implement enemies, NPCs and combat mechanics into interesting encounters

 - Proactive doer who takes responsibility and pride in their own work when given the freedom to work independently

 - Strong cross-discipline communication skills

 - Being a great teammate - we believe making games is a team sport

 - A self-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.
   
   


WOULD BE NICE IF YOU ALSO HAVE

 - Familiarity with level design tools and concepts. Proven track record of building level blockout.

 - Experience with combat AI and familiarity with Unreal Behavior Trees.

 - Extensive knowledge of Unreal's GAS - from Gameplay Effects to Ability Modifiers
   
   


WHERE YOU'LL BE

This role is based in our Shanghai office. If you are not local, our relocation team would be excited to help you with your move to Shanghai,China. We provide comprehensive support not only for you, but also for your family!



–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. 

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. 

–––



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/7f048a7e-2800-4412-9b99-1a3b978c0413/banner_narrow_allstars.jpg]

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, and Squad Busters. Our mission is to create great games https://supr.cl/jd-games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/48e75b93-58a2-46bd-ae28-70a841bcedfd/banner_narrow_shanghai2.jpg]

The Shanghai studio
As Supercell’s first international game development studio, the Shanghai studio is one of the most exciting things happening in Supercell and a unique opportunity to join at a relatively early stage to help shape our path. Our vision is to be a world-class international studio, making new global hit games while leveraging the unique advantages of the game development scene in China and broader Asia.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/d822e263-a735-4e85-b0d1-55ec97d1a05a/banner_narrow_people3.jpg]

Hey, you Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture https://supr.cl/jd-why-you. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/33e38641-694b-41b2-b90e-997ee0941fe1/banner_narrow_titles.jpg]

You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles https://supr.cl/jd-job-title or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/114607f3-15f4-4c55-8587-d4d843335f7f/banner_narrow_chest.jpg]

Benefits and Compensation
Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits https://supr.cl/jd-benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/3fdeff1e-ef28-4879-8f80-54c8c5590973/banner_narrow_relocating.jpg]

Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

description_plain:
NEW GRAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER (2026 OR 2027)

We’re a profitable video game start-up in London with 15 million monthly players and we’re hiring New Grad Software Engineers (2026 or 2027)  to join our 11-person founding team.

 

About us

Creating games with editable worlds usually takes 20k+ lines of well-optimised code and large amounts of effort. Bloxd gives you editable worlds in 5 lines of code, within 5 minutes. You can play our games at bloxd.io http://bloxd.io.

 

About you

You’re passionate about gaming and excited by the prospect of building great games that bring millions together. You have strong engineering fundamentals and a strong product sense, are eager to wear many hats across game design, UI/UX, and community management, and can iterate quickly on a live product whilst learning from player feedback.

 

You’re equally energised by difficult engineering problems as you are by voxel, sandbox, and multiplayer games. You think deeply about what makes these games fun and enjoy building the technical systems that make them possible.

 

What we’re looking for

 - A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related subject, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Some professional experience in software engineering, either through internships, or scaled side projects.

 - Experience developing games, game engines or modding through side projects.

 

Things you could work on within your first 2 months:

 - Create and manage your own game

 - Develop new gameplay systems inside existing games

 - Build new engine features for use by other game developers

 - Profile and optimise performance

 - Develop an in-game item marketplace

 - Improve our partner implementations (E.g. CrazyGames, Discord Activities)

 - Play a lot of Bloxd :)

 

Our tech

We have a TypeScript-first codebase, and use a combination of React, WebGL, and Node. This tech allows us to deliver Bloxd in an incredibly accessible way, and provides a great developer experience. You’ll need to be happy to pick these up if you’re not already familiar with them.

 

Benefits

 - Healthcare

 - 5% pension match on qualifying earnings

 - A permanent desk in our King’s Cross office

 - 25 days holiday + bank holidays

 - Competitive salary + stock options

description_plain:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/00de5607-c2c3-4137-982f-52e7e6a20d6f/spike%20keyboard%20(1).jpeg]


IN THE BRAWL STARS MARKETING TEAM, YOUR FOUR PS ARE PASSION, PLAYERS, POP, AND PECULIARITY! TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE, THE TEAM KEEPS TALKING ABOUT CREATIVITY, CREATIVITY, CREATIVITY. YOU MIGHT BE THE MISSING FOURTH C IF YOU CAN CREATE CATCHIER COPY THAN THIS!

Brawl Stars is one of the biggest mobile games in the world, with 100M+ monthly active players and a content machine that ships at a pace few studios can match. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own the go-to-market execution for our updates, seasons, and IP collaborations – turning every launch into a moment that players and creators can't stop talking about. This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll sit at the intersection of game development, creative production, and community – then make sure the world notices.

You'll report to the Live Ops Marketing Lead and work closely with cross-functional teams across game development, live ops, community, art, and analytics. We want someone with sharp creative instincts, a bias for action, and the ability to think strategically while shipping at high velocity.

We are looking for a seasoned creative marketer with product marketing experience who thrives in a multifunctional, uber-collaborative environment and is obsessed with delivering the best player experience. We value those who bring a fresh perspective, enjoy experimentation, and thrive in an environment that challenges traditional norms.

The Product Marketing Manager will be part of the Brawl Stars game team within the Live Ops Marketing pillar, bridging the gap between the marketing and product teams. Brawl Stars ships at a pace few studios can match – major updates every few weeks, each accompanied by trailers, social content, creator activations, and community campaigns. This role is the engine behind all of it: ensuring every launch moment is crafted with care, lands with impact, and converts into pure fandom.

From marketing strategy to in-game communication execution, this person loves to think strategically while getting their hands dirty. They have sharp creative instincts – the kind of person who can give clear, specific feedback on a trailer cut, a social post, or a visual concept – combined with exceptional communication and project management skills to bring together all marketing stakeholders: producers, communities, brand, creative and art direction, esports, regional/local activations, analysts, and researchers.

You can have your particular skill (or two), and we don't expect you to be perfect in everything. What's more important is your creative eye, your ability to elevate content at speed, and your eagerness to help build a love for the game that delivers our players a seamless and immersive experience.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/7a053edc-bf2e-4db4-85ee-5630e2b5d305/banner_narrow_customs.jpg]




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Own the go-to-market planning and creative execution for Brawl Stars updates, seasons, chapters, and IP collaborations – from concept through delivery and retrospective.

 - Drive creative direction for marketing campaigns – working with in-house artists, video producers, and external partners to produce trailers, social content, and launch assets that hit the right tone and quality bar. You don't just manage creative, you elevate it.

 - Collaborate with the game team to shape how features and content are revealed and positioned – co-designing animations, teasers, and in-game communication that build anticipation and drive engagement.

 - Partner with community managers and the content creator ecosystem to ensure every launch is amplified organically – designing moments that give creators something worth making content about.

 - Coordinate go-to-market plans for evergreen marketing campaigns for new features, content, or updates designed to engage our global audience. Collaborate with regional teams to amplify these tentpoles with local flavor and cultural relevance.

 - Develop a deep understanding of the game and business, including existing features, product roadmap, and live operations. Coordinate global marketing efforts and align with product and business goals.

 - Strategize and operationalize player communication inside and outside the game, including pop-ups, push notifications, platform features, and store optimization (ASO).

 - Collaborate with Marketing Analytics and Business & Operations stakeholders to analyze campaign performance and apply learnings to inform future campaigns for constant performance improvement.

 - Identify and develop growth levers through marketing via rigorous AB testing, scaling up initiatives that drive meaningful business growth.

 - Build repeatable creative frameworks and production rhythms that allow the team to deliver consistently at high velocity without sacrificing quality.
   
   


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally in the gaming industry and/or entertainment

 - Strong creative instincts – you can give clear, actionable feedback on a trailer, a social post, or a campaign concept. You understand what makes content land with an audience.

 - A solid understanding of social platforms and content culture, especially among younger audiences. You know what trends and why.

 - A deep understanding of the game/product development process and lifecycle management.

 - Experience working with a broad range of marketing functions (e.g. brand, performance, influencers, and esports) with a good understanding of how they can work together to deliver growth.

 - Analytical skills to assess market data and campaign performance – you use data to sharpen creative decisions, not replace them.

 - Experience giving detailed feedback and communicating direction between both internal teams and external partners while respecting schedules.

 - Excellent project management skills – you can run multiple launches in parallel, keep stakeholders aligned, and still care about the details.

 - A self-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

 - Growth mindset with a passion for marketing, innovation, and risk-taking.

 - You are a team player and communicate excellently in English.

 - Strong analytical skills to assess market data and product-specific performance.

 - Located in or willing to relocate to Helsinki





WHERE YOU'LL BE

This role is based in our Helsinki Studio.




–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. 

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. 

–––



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/88b3477a-7124-479e-babc-94125c5b23be/banner_narrow_allstars.jpg]


ABOUT SUPERCELL 

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games https://supr.cl/jd-games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings https://supercell.com/en/news/learning-from-failures/, and killing lots of projects. 



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/0272a5b3-a7a2-4f1c-b97b-725eae66daf0/banner_narrow_people3.jpg]


HEY, YOU MIGHT LOVE IT HERE!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture https://supr.cl/jd-why-you. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/49ae2117-cfbb-4fbd-bc4c-f67357d2f376/banner_narrow_titles.jpg]


YOU ARE NOT YOUR JOB TITLE ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles https://supr.cl/jd-job-title or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/860d5de4-aa96-4e01-879c-889b7039330b/banner_narrow_chest.jpg]


BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION 

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits https://supr.cl/jd-benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/b52ac2fb-3f94-46bc-9c36-32ad780b2eae/banner_narrow_relocating.jpg]


RELOCATION? YES!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/9c5aae7d-1c7f-44e2-9b45-54904fa6e736/banner_narrow_portraits-2026.jpg]


NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD APPLY? 

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

description_plain:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/a1098e0c-ee3b-4eb7-8d2a-166c711f91f2/image.png]





CLASH OF CLANS IS ONE OF THE MOST RECOGNISABLE GAMES EVER MADE. WE WANT TO KEEP IT THAT WAY, AND THEN SOME.

Clash is growing beyond the game, showing up in trailers, campaigns, toys, and collaborations. The visual identity has to stretch to cover all of it, stay true to what players love, and still feel fresh. We're also modernising how we make things: pipelines are evolving, our content production is scaling, and we're working more closely with external partners than ever before.

We need someone who can own this at a strategic level. Someone who sets the vision, builds the conditions for great work, and steers the IP with confidence across every surface it touches.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/7a053edc-bf2e-4db4-85ee-5630e2b5d305/banner_narrow_customs.jpg]




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Define and evolve the visual direction of Clash across the game, cosmetics, and wherever else the IP lives. True to its DNA, but never frozen in time.

 - Set the standard for style and brand fit across in-game art, marketing, trailers, toy lines, campaigns, and entertainment partners, and empower the team to uphold it.

 - Partner with game design, product, and marketing leadership to ensure art strategy supports gameplay clarity, player understanding, and long-term brand health.

 - Mentor and support Clash artists, help them do the best work of their careers while staying aligned on the IP.

 - Shape the roadmap for modernising Clash pipelines (2D to 3D, audio, tooling, and emerging technologies), championing approaches that give artists more time for the work only they can do.

 - Represent art at a senior level across the business: outsourcing partners, Entertainment and Partnerships, marketing, and franchise collaborators.


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - A strong track record leading art direction on stylised games. Mobile and live-service experience is a big plus.

 - Deep IP and brand instincts, the ability to define what's on-brand vs off and build the frameworks that help a whole team make that call consistently.

 - Leadership experience on a highly collaborative senior art teams: setting vision, developing artists, and making the culture as strong as the output.

 - Strategic experience managing outsourcing pipelines and external partners at scale, balancing quality ambitions with the realities of live-game timelines and budgets.

 - Comfort operating in a low-process, high-trust environment where you own the outcomes, not just the opinions.

 - A self-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.


WOULD BE NICE IF YOU ALSO HAVE

 - Experience with cosmetics economies or large seasonal content pipelines.

 - Experience bridging game art strategy and marketing/UA: key art, trailers, social.

 - Familiarity with Clash (as a player or from prior work) and a feel for how it's evolved.


WHERE YOU'LL BE

This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. Clash of Clans team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios however most of our Artists are located in Helsinki!

To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role especially if based out of London.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read. 

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page. 

–––



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/88b3477a-7124-479e-babc-94125c5b23be/banner_narrow_allstars.jpg]


ABOUT SUPERCELL 

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices https://supr.cl/jd-offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games https://supr.cl/jd-games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings https://supercell.com/en/news/learning-from-failures/, and killing lots of projects. 



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/0272a5b3-a7a2-4f1c-b97b-725eae66daf0/banner_narrow_people3.jpg]


HEY, YOU MIGHT LOVE IT HERE!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture https://supr.cl/jd-why-you. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/49ae2117-cfbb-4fbd-bc4c-f67357d2f376/banner_narrow_titles.jpg]


YOU ARE NOT YOUR JOB TITLE ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles https://supr.cl/jd-job-title or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/860d5de4-aa96-4e01-879c-889b7039330b/banner_narrow_chest.jpg]


BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION 

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits https://supr.cl/jd-benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/b52ac2fb-3f94-46bc-9c36-32ad780b2eae/banner_narrow_relocating.jpg]


RELOCATION? YES!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/4cc1b726-11dc-4dab-b6cf-387c9cd55134/banner_narrow_portraits-2026.jpg]


NOT SURE IF YOU SHOULD APPLY? 

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

description_plain:
About Creatify

Creatify is building the world’s first end-to-end AI advertising agent—a platform that automates the entire video ad lifecycle, from scripting and avatar-led generation to testing, optimization, and publishing across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and more.

We’ve surpassed 3 million users across 18,000+ teams. Leading brands—including Applovin, Alibaba, HubSpot, Binance, NewsBreak, and Zumper—use Creatify to produce personalized, high-performing video ads in minutes.

We have raised $24M in funding from leading Silicon Valley firms including WndrCo, Kindred Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, NFDG, Comcast Ventures, Creator Ventures, Leadout Capital, Hat Trick Capital, and many more. Check out our latest coverage by Fast Company https://www.fastcompany.com/91344416/jeffrey-katzenberg-bets-big-on-ai-video-ads-with-a-15-5-million-investment-in-creatify, TechCrunch https://techcrunch.com/2025/06/02/former-dreamworks-ceo-jeffrey-katzenberg-co-leads-15-5m-series-a-for-ai-video-ad-platform/, Bloomberg TV https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2025-05-28/jeffrey-katzenberg-says-ai-is-not-the-end-of-hollywood-video, and our recognition as one of IVP Enterprise AI 55 in 2024 https://www.ivp.com/content/the-ivp-enterprise-ai-55-2024/. 

Based in Mountain View, we are a team of passionate AI researchers, engineers, and advertising veterans. Join us in reinventing the advertising industry with AI.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own creative strategy for paid social video ads across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube—focused on CTR, CPA, and ROAS.

 - Develop ad concepts from scratch: hooks, angles, narratives, and formats built for rapid testing and iteration.

 - Write platform-native scripts that feel conversational and built for the scroll—not the boardroom.

 - Manage and mentor a small, high-output creative team—setting the bar for quality, speed, and ambition.

 - Be the creative face of Creatify to key clients: present strategies, pitch concepts, and build trust as a strategic partner.

 - Design AI-powered workflows that supercharge production speed, creative variation, and testing cycles.

 - Build repeatable creative frameworks and playbooks that enable the team to produce ads at scale.

 - Use performance data to scale winners, kill underperformers, and iterate fast.


WHO YOU ARE

A hands-on creative leader equally comfortable whiteboarding concepts, jumping into CapCut, or prompting an AI model. Builder energy, not manager energy.

 - 3+ years in creative direction, paid social advertising, or agency-side performance creative.

 - Strong conceptual thinker—you instinctively know what hooks and messaging drive action.

 - Deep fluency in social-first ad formats and real user behavior on major platforms.

 - Data-aware: you use metrics to guide creative decisions, not just gut instinct.

 - Systems thinker who designs scalable frameworks, not one-off executions.

 - Excellent communicator who can present to clients, rally a team, and make complex ideas accessible.

 - Experience managing creative teams in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

 - Bonus: ex-creative agency owner or co-founder—you know what it takes to build a creative operation from the ground up.


AI & TOOLS

 - Hands-on with AI creative tools (Veo3, Sora2, Kling, or similar) and skilled at turning them into repeatable production workflows.

 - Strong AI prompting intuition—you know which formats consistently produce usable, high-quality results.

 - Proficient with Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, or equivalent.


WHY CREATIFY

 - Shape the creative playbook at a company redefining how ads are made—your fingerprints will be everywhere.

 - Series A momentum with real revenue, real customers, and massive market opportunity.

 - Work at the bleeding edge of AI + advertising with access to tools before most people know they exist.

 - Small team, big ownership—every idea has a real shot at shipping.

We are an equal opportunity employer and highly value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description_plain:
MARKETING DATA ANALYST

Location: Remote
Status: Full-Time 

At Marketing Architects, we believe TV advertising is still the most powerful marketing channel. But the typical process for TV is expensive, difficult to scale and to measure. So we flipped the traditional approach on its head and rebuilt the agency model with the client in mind. Today, we're growing a team of talent from across the United States to reimagine how brands advertise on TV.




ROLE OVERVIEW 

The Data Analyst is a core member of our Analytics team, responsible for answering real business questions using marketing and media data. You’ll report to the Director of Analytics and work closely with cross-functional partners to ensure our measurement is accurate, thoughtful and actionable.

This role is closest to the data and we’re taking an all-inclusive approach to help clients effectively navigate the complexities of measuring television advertising effectiveness. You’ll deeply understand campaign inputs, assumptions and outputs, and you’ll help teams and clients clearly understand what the numbers mean (and what to do next). We expect AI to be part of how you work. Use it to move faster and cover more ground than an analyst could alone, and bring the judgment that decides which answers are actually right.

 

What you'll do: 

 - Deliver accurate analysis: Complete high-quality analyses that directly answer business and client questions, ensuring data accuracy, and consistency.

 - Evaluate TV performance: Measure the impact of TV and streaming campaigns on digital performance, business outcomes and overall marketing effectiveness.

 - Uncover actionable insights: Go beyond surface-level results to identify patterns, risks and opportunities that strengthen campaign decisions.

 - Validate data and assumptions: Question inputs, methodologies and outputs to ensure results make sense and stand up to scrutiny. Including AI-generated outputs.

 - Translate data into clarity: Build clear visualizations and explain findings in plain language so internal teams and clients can confidently act on them.

 - Work AI-forward: Use AI tools to accelerate querying, scripting, QA and first-draft analysis so you can test more scenarios and turn work around faster using appropriate context, then apply your own judgment to what the results mean.
   
    

Who you are: 

 - An agency-trained analyst: 2–5 years of experience in marketing analytics, media analytics or a related quantitative field, ideally supporting campaign measurement.

 - Strong academic foundation: 3.5 GPA or equivalent academic performance in a quantitative field such as business, economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, marketing or similar.

 - Data-literate: You interpret performance data, identify trends, and connect insights back to defined KPIs to inform decisions.

 - Strong in Excel: Comfortable using formulas, pivots tables and structured analysis to organize, validate and analyze large datasets.

 - Experienced with BI or data tools: You’ve worked in platforms like Domo, Databricks, SQL or similar environments to explore and troubleshoot data.

 - Presentation-ready: You’ve built clear, client-ready slides that explain campaign results or analytical findings in a logical way and can present them with confidence.

 - AI-enabled: You use AI tools to improve workflows, explore data or enhance analysis and you understand their strengths and limitations. You can point to work AI helped you do faster or more thoroughly, and you can explain your methodology and your math without it.

 - Accountable for the answer: The conclusions are yours. You can walk anyone through the logic, the assumptions and the numbers unaided, and you know when a tool’s output needs to be thrown out.
   
    

Our values:

 - Hungry Humble Smart: We seek a trifecta of talent. We take initiative and act with urgency. Look inwards before outwards. Value EQ over IQ.

 - Mindset Matters: Success starts between our ears. We face challenges with a calm confidence and pivot quickly. As eternal optimists, we know we are capable of great things and have survived worse. Our best days are always ahead.

 - Team Is Hero: We, not me. Being a hero is a team sport and it's the unique talents of many that make us one of a kind. No one person can win the day, but great teams can change the world.




BENEFITS OVERVIEW

We offer rewarding careers that encourage growth while providing industry-leading benefits including:

 - Fully remote within the US

 - 100% employer-paid medical, dental and disability, with vision option

 - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 4% company match

 - Flexible paid time off, 9 paid holidays plus 2 floating holidays

 - Paid parental leave

 - Annual office supply allowance, monthly internet stipend and employer-paid cell phone

 - Opportunities to connect virtually and in-person twice a year with our fully remote team

Learn more at marketingarchitects.com/careers https://www.marketingarchitects.com/careers




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

We want applications from everyone, regardless of race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizen status, age, disability, military or protected veteran status, genetic predisposition or carrier status or any other legally protected status.

Our remote-friendly work model supports flexibility across the US, however we are currently unable to support employment in California. We are unable to consider applicants who live outside of the US.

At this time, we're not considering candidates that need any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, O-1, etc.

The application for this position may request a short, job relevant assessment as part of our multi-stage interview process. Reasonable accommodations are available for this assessment, please reach out to talentteam@markarch.com.

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, location and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

description_plain:
Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

Sensor Tower's mission is to measure the world's digital economy. As the Product Manager for Web Insights, you'll own strategy and execution for our web and generative AI analytics products, ensuring they're accurate, intuitive, and solve real customer problems

You'll be assigned high-impact initiatives sourced directly from active customer requests, such as building an SEO/competitive-traffic solution with raw URL-level traffic data, improving competitive discovery and reporting UX, and expanding GenAI citations and brand-visibility tracking. You'll interact directly with users and business stakeholders to gather detailed use cases and translate them into clear requirements. You'll collaborate with Data Science to refine and expand web traffic and engagement estimates, and share implementation and project management responsibilities with Engineering to ship new features and data pipelines. You'll also partner with Product Marketing and GTM to communicate the value of new capabilities and drive adoption of the Web Insights product.

This is a great fit for a Product Manager who is energized by analytics products, comfortable getting into the data themselves, and excited about the web traffic, competitive intelligence, or digital marketing space.



Salary range: $125,000 - 150,000 USD




WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

 - Interview users to identify needs, workflows, and pain points related to web traffic and engagement data.

 - Write clear technical requirements for new features, metrics, and data delivery solutions.

 - Collaborate daily with Data Science and Engineering to prioritize, scope, and ship improvements to web  estimates and product features.

 - Propose and maintain a roadmap for future Web and Generative AI Insights releases.

 - Analyze usage and product data to identify opportunities and measure the impact of shipped features.

 - Communicate functional and business details of upcoming releases to less technical teams, including Marketing, Sales, Customer Success.

 - Monitor data quality and accuracy of web estimates, working with Data Science to resolve issues and improve methodology.
   
   


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–5 years of professional experience, preferably in product management at a B2B or SaaS company.

 - Experience working with data products, analytics platforms, or APIs.

 - Comfortable with writing SQL and using data directly to inform product decisions.

 - An interest in web analytics, competitive intelligence, digital marketing, or adjacent spaces (SEO experience is a strong plus).

 - Familiarity with BI and analytics tooling (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Amplitude, Mixpanel) is a plus.

 - AI-fluent and comfortable working daily with tools like Claude, building custom agents, and leveraging MCP integrations to move faster and unlock new workflows.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

 - Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and Sales/GTM teams.

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is a plus, but not required.
   
   

Fraud warning:

It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as LinkedIn, Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob. At no point will Sensor Tower ever ask for money, credit card, or bank account information to complete a job application. Communications received from Sensor Tower are only sent by e-mail addresses ending in sensortower.com http://sensortower.com. All Sensor Tower interviews will be conducted via phone or Zoom. At no time will a conversation be moved to an alternative email outside of sensortower.com http://sensortower.com or text. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume when applying.



To all recruitment agencies:

Sensor Tower does not accept third party resumes. Please do not send resumes to our jobs alias, Sensor Tower employees or any other organization location. Sensor Tower is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Sensor Tower will not pay any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Sensor Tower.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.

As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.

Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe t

hat every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values https://www.sitecore.com/company guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.

As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.

Learn more at Sitecore.com http://Sitecore.com.

About the Role: 

We are looking for a Solution Engineer with strong presentation skills as well as a strong technical and digital background to support our Channel Partners. As a Solution Engineer, your primary responsibility is to deliver technical and strategic support throughout the entire sales cycles for our partners in Latin America (LATAM). Some of the largest and most complex enterprise solutions in the region, which will require a broad technical skillset and excellent business acumen and insight, will challenge you.

What You Will Do: 

 - Act as primary contact for designated partners, fostering strong relationships across all levels

 - Understand each partner's unique objectives, challenges, and requirements, aligning Sitecore solutions accordingly

 - Proactively identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and contract renewals to drive revenue growth

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to enable exceptional support

 - Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer feedback to inform product enhancements

 - Support our partner’s sales teams with technical aspects of the Sitecore sales processes

 - Enable and assist partners in the prospecting phase to deliver the best possible solution proposal

 - Deliver bespoke demonstration scenarios of the Sitecore software solutions

 - Develop and deliver Proofs of Concept to Sitecore partner prospect organizations

 - Occasional public speaking on events in the regions

 - Solution prototyping, delivery, skinning, and presentation

 - Spending a portion of your time learning and upskilling on the platform and new and associated technologies and features

 - Writing technical answers and proposals to RFP, RFQ, RFI from prospects
   

What You Need to Succeed: 

 - Experience with combining technical elements with business needs and business requirements of the clients

 - Experienced at demonstrating software using a value based approach

 - Demonstrate the ability to resolve more complex technical issues and integration of multiple products to create solutions

 - An appreciation and understanding of cross-channel digital marketing Technologies

 - Ability to absorb and integrate large amounts of information in short timescales

 - Excellent team player, able to work closely with other technical sales and business development colleagues, while at the same time understand the value of self-drive, and the ability to control and prioritize own time independently

 - Experience conducting business across Latin America (LATAM), with an understanding of regional business practices, cultures, and market dynamics.
   

Additional Skills That Could Set You Apart:

 - Solid experience and understanding of one or more Web Content Management systems,e-commerce, or digital asset management systems

 - Understanding of the MarTech landscape and trends including SaaS and Headless content solutions

Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other local legally protected characteristic.

description_plain:
WHAT WE'RE BUILDING

Mutiny is the self-improving AI infrastructure for GTM teams to execute faster and close more revenue. Our ambition is to do for revenue velocity what Cursor and Claude Code did for engineering velocity. With Mutiny, everyone in sales and marketing gets a bench of GTM athletes that handle any work across their revenue motion and learn from what's actually moved their deals.

In April we re-launched the product as an agent-first platform. Anthropic showcased us as a leader in AI GTM. MRR is growing more than 70% month-over-month, with customers like Uber, Rippling, and Snowflake. We're backed by Sequoia, YC, and Insight, and we're building a generational company.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Most CS roles are graded on how few problems the customer has. You'll be graded on how much they grow. As a growth strategist at Mutiny, you'll own a book of managed accounts and become the reason teams at customers like Rippling, Uber, and Snowflake get more out of AI than their peers. CS isn't a support function here. It's how we turn early traction into the customer base that defines a category. You'll build the playbooks as you go and shape what customer success looks like at an AI-native company from the ground up. This role is in person in New York City, five days a week.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Your book. Onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion across your managed accounts. Every customer outcome runs through you.

 - Customer expertise. Become the expert on how each customer's business works and where Mutiny fits in. Translate that into "aha" moments that move their roadmap.

 - The AI motion. Teach customers how to use our agent-first platform to create assets that actually move the needle for their sales and marketing teams. Their team uses Mutiny because you made it obvious how.

 - EBRs that move things. Run business reviews that tell a real story and drive action. Follow-ups that are crisp and lead somewhere.

 - Renewals and expansion. Build the case six months before it comes up. Adoption and customer health are the leading indicators. Revenue is the lagging one.

 - The shared playbook. When you find a better onboarding flow, a sharper EBR, or a new play that's working, you document it. The next growth strategist starts where you ended.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Customer outcomes are personal. Seeing a customer hit a milestone is what gets you out of bed. Their goals are your goals. You don't celebrate the renewal, you celebrate the result that made it inevitable.

 - The expert in the room. You dig into how the product works, how the customer's business works, and how to connect the two. You create "aha" moments by tailoring advice to what each customer actually needs.

 - Trust comes quickly. Customers feel like you're genuinely in their corner. You're empathetic, direct, and you always bring context and a clear ask when you need something from them.

 - Precision communicator. Crisp follow-up emails. EBRs that tell a real story. Complex concepts in simple terms, with no jargon to hide behind.

 - Scrappy and resourceful. You don't wait for a perfect process. You figure things out, document what works, and leave it easier for the next person.

 - Renewal mindset. You're building the case for why a customer should stay and grow, not scrambling when it comes up. Adoption and health are the leading indicators you watch.
