description_plain:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

At Instructure, our vision is to help people learn, develop, and engage from their first day at school to their last day of work. Our goal is simple: create more effective ways for everyone everywhere to access education, make discoveries, share knowledge, be inspired, and do big things. We accomplish all this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome things. So here’s your opportunity...

 

We are seeking a Strategic Learning Consultant to work with businesses as part of our Professional Services team. Strategic Learning Consultants help customers manage change and deepen and elevate their use of Instructure products to meet organizational goals through strategic planning, customized consultation, applicable resource development, project management, training, and hands-on targeted coaching.  To lead positive change, increase platform adoption, enhance learner engagement, and drive organization-specific initiatives, the team tailors content and customer experience to support institutions.  

 

This position will focus specifically on working with project sponsors, leaders, instructional designers, and other staff to effectively use Instructure products to meet the organization’s instructional goals.  Providing exceptional customer service to maintain strong relationships will be critical in this role. A successful Strategic Consultant will help the customer plan for change, increase and enhance Instructure product use across the organization, incorporate best practices, and build capacity within the organization to sustain their use after the consulting period is over.

 

What you will be doing:

 - Collaborate with key stakeholders to create and execute effective and detailed communication, training, and engagement plans.

 - Act as an agent of change within the organization to support the implementation of the organization's vision and goals for Instructure products.

 - Use data effectively and follow an inquiry process to share your analysis of challenges, apply targeted strategies, and elevate the teaching and learning within Instructure products.

 - Mentor and motivate organization leaders, faculty, designers, and staff on all things Instructure, specifically Canvas, Canvas Career, & Impact, and inspire educators to achieve unparalleled awesomeness with these products.

 - Listen to the needs of the organization and help to meet those needs with Instructure products, including building adoption resources, model courses, and other key deliverables.

 - Plan, schedule, and conduct product training and consulting sessions using appropriate tools and organizational skills. 

 - Help leaders make connections between product usage and instructional best practices for learners.

 - Follow-up after consulting sessions to monitor progress and promote success.

 - Collaborate with team members, Instructure employees, and customers to enhance our product(s) use across the organization.

 - Prepare, curate, and deliver amazing help documents, incredible course materials, and superstar presentations specific to the organization.

 - Demonstrate a willingness to tackle any task that supports the customer’s rollout of the Instructure Learning Platform while also following internal procedures, Instructure security and privacy protocols, and institution policies.

 - Travel to support the rollout of Instructure products as needed and appropriate.

 - Identify areas where additional support, training, or consulting are needed.

 

Here is what you will need to know/have:

 

 - At least three years of teaching, or consulting experience, including experience with a digital learning environment. 

 - At least two years of Canvas experience is required, more preferred, including making awesome and engaging Canvas courses that are responsive to and inclusive of teaching and learning needs in a digital learning environment. Additional experience with other Instructure tools is a plus, including, Studio, Catalog, Credentials, or Impact.

 - At least one year in an educational leadership position overseeing a team that supports the use of a learning and assessment management system for pedagogical purposes, more preferred.

 - Experience leading change, building strong relationships, effective professional development programs, and rolling out a technology platform to a large organization.

 - Current knowledge of technology adoption strategies, professional development protocols, and educational technology best practices.

 - Impeccable executive leadership presence and top-notch verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.

 - Creative thinking, strong problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including upper management, clients, and other departments.

 - Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment and be comfortable with ambiguity.

 - Experience with delivering awe-inspiring presentations in an educational environment and the ability to keep consulting sessions fresh, fun, effective, and relevant.

 - Ability to react to project adjustments and alterations promptly and efficiently.

 - Willingness to tackle any task supporting the customer’s Instructure product rollout.

 - Bachelor’s Degree in Instructional Technology or equivalent. Master’s Degree in Educational Leadership or Instructional Technology a plus.

 - Willingness to travel to client sites is required. Future assignments may require additional travel and extended onsite engagements in other locations.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

 - Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

 - Flexible work culture.  Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

 - Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

 - Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

 - Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

 - The technology and tools you need to do your best work 

 - Motivosity employee recognition program

 - A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection



We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

description_plain:
We're a 125-person EdTech scale-up powering learning in 140+ countries, helping students and teachers thrive through an intelligent platform that combines rich, interactive pedagogy with smart AI and data.




WHY JOIN KOGNITY?



 - Work on problems that matter – Your work directly influences the lives of teachers and students in over 100 countries. The scale is global, and the outcomes are tangible.

 - High ownership, high expectations – You are trusted to take initiative, make decisions and drive outcomes. Responsibility comes early, accountability is real, and results matter.

 - A fast-moving, high-performing team – You will work with smart, driven colleagues across the globe on complex problems. Standards and expectations are high, feedback is direct, and the pace is fast.

 - Continuous growth is the baseline – Everyone is expected and supported to learn quickly, improve constantly and raise their own bar. If you enjoy responsibility, momentum and meaningful challenge, you will thrive here.




WHAT YOU'LL DO



As a Content Coordinator, you will get a chance to keep content work moving reliably across Kognity's Content Operations team, its freelance contributors and the Product and Tech teams it depends on.

 - Deliver small content update projects, acting as the single point of contact from brief through authoring, QA and upload to live deployment, ensuring every asset quality.

 - Run the end-to-end contractor lifecycle, from sourcing and briefing freelance subject specialists to onboarding, tracking assignments and closing out engagements cleanly.

 - Triage and route incoming content feedback from users and internal teams, tracking it through to resolution and surfacing patterns that shape content priorities.

 - Work on third-party content rights, permissions and licensing, keeping records audit-ready and escalating copyright questions to the right stakeholders.

 - Build and maintain the trackers, dashboards and documentation that give the content team visibility over its work, and help bring AI tools into everyday content operations.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Background in content coordination, project coordination or operations, ideally within tech, product, digital publishing or EdTech.

 - Proven ability to keep multiple workstreams organised and moving, ideally with a tracker or system you've built to manage competing priorities.

 - Strong communication skills, able to adjust tone and detail for audiences from freelance contributors to legal and finance stakeholders.

 - Fast learner who picks up new tools, platforms and content systems quickly, with minimal repeated guidance.

 - Skilled at turning scattered information, such as feedback threads or contractor performance notes, into clear improvements patterns and concrete recommendations.

 - Experience leveraging AI tools to enhance creativity, decisions, and execution
   
   


OUR VALUES

 - We take ownership

 - We are transparent

 - We make every week count

 - We obsess over customers

 - We show up with heart
   
   


HOW WE HIRE

 1. Discovery call with a Recruiter

 2. Hiring manager discussion

 3. Case study

 4. Values discussion

 5. Leadership talk

 6. References
    
    

Equal opportunity

Every qualified person will be evaluated regardless of age, gender, identity, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status or religion. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

 

See more about how we collect and process your personal data in our Privacy Notice https://kognity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Kognity-Recruitment-Privacy-Notice_0326.pdf.

description_plain:
ABOUT US

Our mission is to reinvent the way people learn, starting with language.

Learning a language can change a life by opening doors to new cultures, careers, and communities. Two billion people around the world are actively trying to learn a language, but the best way to learn (one-on-one tutoring) is hard to access at scale and hasn’t been meaningfully improved in decades. Speak is building a human-level, AI-powered tutor in your pocket: a conversation-first experience that lets learners actually speak, get instant feedback, and progress through carefully designed lessons. The result is a complete path from beginner to confident speaker across multiple languages.

Speak first launched in South Korea in 2019, where Speak has now become the number one language learning app, and we now serve learners across many markets and 15+ languages. Speak is one of the world’s leading AI companies, with over $150m raised in venture investment from OpenAI, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and more, with a distributed team across San Francisco, Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, and Ljubljana.




ABOUT THE DESIGN TEAM

We’re a small and mighty team of five that sit at the intersection of craft, research, invention and product thinking. We build consumer experiences used by millions, alongside B2B products that help organizations bring Speak to their teams. The design work is genuinely novel — inventing how someone talks to an AI tutor, what feedback feels like when you're learning out loud, how a roleplay session should land emotionally, and how you measure a true proficiency score.

Our work shapes the future of how people learn with AI and we partner closely with Engineering, Learning Design, Product, and Analytics to do it. We stay close to our users and to how our experiences actually feel by prototyping with AI, testing conversation design and voice interaction, and getting comfortable with ambiguity.

Our team takes craft seriously and has a lot of fun doing it — we developed our design principles in a multi-week offsite and iterate on them on a living board in our office. We take language classes together to ground our work in first principles. We stay close to our learners through team trips to Seoul, Tokyo, and Taipei, as well as lighter-touch interviews, surveys, betas, and AB tests. We believe in a critique and build culture with high trust, and also get a bit competitive over ping pong. We have something to prove: that learning products can be both deeply effective and beautifully crafted. If you want to do the most interesting design work of your career, let's talk.




ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Product Designer focused on consumer experiences, you’ll design the core moments that help learners build real-world speaking confidence: finding the right path, practicing with AI, getting feedback, staying motivated, and building a lasting learning habit.

Speak is inventing new interaction patterns for language learning — from AI tutoring and voice-first practice to roleplay, proficiency measurement, and personalized curriculum. You’ll work across ambiguous, high-impact product areas where interaction design, learning science, AI behavior, and emotional craft all matter.

 - Shape strategy and end-to-end product experiences for Speak’s consumer learning surfaces, bringing deep empathy for learners across cultures, motivations, and proficiency levels

 - Design across key growth moments — onboarding, activation, habit formation, retention, and subscription experiences — while protecting learner trust and long-term learning outcomes

 - Prototype quickly in AI tools, code, or interactive design tools to make new learning experiences feel real before they are fully built

 - Partner with Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to define opportunities, evaluate impact, and raise the quality bar for learner-facing product work

 - Use qualitative and quantitative signals to understand learner behavior, synthesize insights, and make strong product judgments

 - Invent novel interaction patterns for AI-powered learning that go beyond generic AI templates

 - Thrive in an ambiguous, fast-moving startup environment where the best answer often has to be discovered through making

The exact product area you will work on will depend on team needs and your strengths, but likely areas include onboarding, activation, personalized learning, speaking practice, subscriptions, and learner motivation. This role is primarily anchored in our consumer experience, with opportunities to collaborate across adjacent surfaces as Speak grows.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 6+ years of product design experience. You have experience designing high-quality consumer products.

 - You stay close to users. You think about real people learning real languages in real contexts. You actively seek out the humans using the product, not just data about them and are able to synthesize valuable insights about them that inform strategy and direction. You seek ways to put your work in front of people, before you feel it’s perfect just to learn something valuable.

 - Product thinking and structured judgment. You frame the problem before solving it and always know why you’re doing something. You can distill what you’re working on into simple narrative framings and key beats without being lost in the details.

 - AI-native workflow. You already use AI creatively in your process to unlock speed and quality and are eager to continue learning how to apply it in novel ways.

 - Taste and craft while moving fast. You can spot a great idea in a sea of okay ones and understand what’s worth investing in building. You do this while moving quickly and know when to stay scrappy vs invest deeply in final polish.

 - Communication and stakeholder collaboration. You can own a room, build trust, and push back when something isn't right. You bring people into your work along the way knowing that multiple perspectives produce the strongest work.


WE ALSO LOVE TO SEE

 - Experience in language learning, education, or another domain with deep cross-cultural product surface area

 - A bias toward prototypes to communicate ideas, test assumptions, and make your thinking tangible

 - A strong portfolio that demonstrates user-centric thinking, high craft, and innovative interaction patterns

 - Contributions to design systems that scale beyond a single team

 - A point of view about agentic workflows you'd be excited to share with our team and ability to tinker directly in code




WHY WORK AT SPEAK

 1. Join a fantastic, tight-knit team at the right time: we're growing very quickly, we've most recently raised our Series C from some of the top investors in the valley, and we've achieved product-market fit in our initial markets. You'd join at a magical time when a single person could significantly change the course of the company.

 2. Do your life's work with people you’ll love working with: we care strongly about our craft and want every person at Speak to feel like they're growing every day. We believe in the idea that working with people you both enjoy and have respect for makes everything better. We hire thoughtfully and only work with people we admire deeply.

 3. Global in nature: We're live in over 40 countries and launching in a number of new markets soon. We have dedicated offices in San Francisco, Ljubljana, Seoul, Tokyo, and Taipei, and you’ll have the opportunity to talk to users in each of these regions on a regular basis as well as travel.

 4. Impact people's lives in a major way: Learning a language is one of the single most life-changing skills one can learn, and right now 99% of people never achieve their goal because the process is broken. We’re helping millions of people achieve their goals and improve their lives.

Speak does not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Kira is a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier Venture Capital funds including New Enterprise Associates (NEA), Andrew Ng’s AI Fund https://aifund.ai/, and Primavera. We live in a world where technology is rapidly changing the educational experiences of students and teachers everywhere, and we have the opportunity to shape how this change takes place. It is Kira Learning https://kira-learning.com/’s mission to harness transformative AI technologies to make world-class teaching and learning accessible to everyone.



As a Senior Software Engineer at Kira, you will own core backend systems and infrastructure that power critical product workflows. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building reliable, scalable services, improving infrastructure and developer tooling. While this is a backend-leaning role, the ideal candidate is comfortable going full-stack when needed, partnering closely with product teams to ship end-to-end features. 



This is a full-time position that requires flexibility with work hours and availability outside of regular business hours. We have offices in San Francisco, CA and New York City, NY and we ask that employees work from one of the two locations and come into the office in-person 4 days a week.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Ship impactful, end-to-end features that improve student and teacher experiences

 - Help set and evolve technical direction, translating business goals into pragmatic technical plans

 - Improve product and engineering foundations, including code quality, observability, CI/CD, and developer tooling

 - Own operational excellence, addressing performance, scalability, security, reliability, and incident response

 - Partner closely with product managers and designers on UX, interaction design, and execution

 - Participate across the full lifecycle: prototyping, testing, rollout, and ongoing support

 - Provide technical leadership through design discussions, code reviews, and mentorship
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience

 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience or equivalent practical experience

 - Strong backend experience (e.g., Kotlin, Python, Go, Rust, Scala), with willingness to ramp up on Kira’s stack (Kotlin, Python)

 - Ability to own technical decisions and execute with minimal guidance in ambiguous environments

 - Hands-on experience operating production systems and cloud infrastructure (ideally AWS)

 - 2+ years experience mentoring and/or managing junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and high-quality delivery

 - Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and reliable deployment practices

 - Clear written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

 - Comfort operating in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment with changing priorities

 - A positive, can-do attitude. You’re not deterred by minor setbacks and are able to swiftly overcome ambiguity

 - Impeccable attention to detail

 - (Preferred) Extensive experience contributing to frontend codebases (e.g., React, TypeScript)

 - (Preferred) Experience with integrating LLM-backed services, including API usage, evaluation, and operational considerations

What We Offer

 - Competitive compensation and equity. For applicants in the US, the salary range for this role is $180,000 - $250,000+, depending on relevant considerations like professional experience and related skill sets

 - Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including a medical insurance plan with 100% coverage of employee

description_plain:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

 


FUNCTION OVERVIEW

Harvey's Legal Engineering team is composed of former practicing attorneys who work to bring value to Harvey's prospects and customers. Legal Engineers lead discovery, demos, trainings, and onboarding alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real legal work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow.

 

At Harvey, we segment the Legal Engineering function into three teams: Legal Engineers (Pre-Sales), Legal Engineers, Product Specialists (Post-Sales), and Legal Engineers, Custom Solutions (Pre- and Post-Sales). Legal Engineers across all three subgroups understand how lawyers think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live in-practice pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what the legal profession needs. It's a team built to power Harvey as the platform lawyers can trust with their most important work.

 

You may be asked to travel around 2-3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1-3 days at a time.




 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Legal Engineer (Pre-Sales)

Legal Engineers are lawyers who left practice to help build the future of legal work. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams throughout the pre-sales process. They lead collaborative pilot programs, guide prospects through what’s possible with AI, and work alongside lawyers to understand their workflows, build tailored solutions, and demonstrate meaningful value in real legal use cases. Along the way, they bring prospect feedback back into the product, helping shape the future of Harvey.

 

Legal Engineer, Product Specialist (Post-Sales)

LEPS take over once a prospect becomes a customer. LEPS build trusted relationships with many of the world's leading legal teams by learning their workflows and showing them how to weave Harvey into daily practice.  The LEPS role spans the entire customer journey, from leading onboarding and enablement, to sitting down with a full practice group to build agents on real matters. Along the way, the LEPS translates legal practice needs into actionable feedback for product and engineering, contributes to customer-facing content across practice areas, and upholds Harvey's credibility as the leading AI platform for lawyers.

 

Legal Engineer, Custom Solutions (Pre-Sale and Post-Sale)

LECS are a specialist group that work on complex no-code custom Harvey in-app solutions. LECS meet with group heads, general counsel, and other senior stakeholders to learn how key processes run today. Drawing on their legal expertise, they use natural language prompting to design bespoke resources, including agents, playbooks, and other tools, that improve the quality, speed, and experience of that process. The build is collaborative. The LECS scope it with the customer, prototype against sample documents, and refine it alongside their team. Most LECS work happens post-sale, but the team also supports strategic accounts pre-sale on an advisory basis. LECS concentrates narrowly on designing tools that automate a specific process, and on building relationships with the senior leaders who own it.

 

*In your initial interview with our recruiting team, you'll learn more about all three roles, and we'll identify which may be the best fit based on your background and our current hiring needs.

 


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - JD or equivalent legal qualification.

 - 3 + years of practicing law in-house, at a top-tier law firm, or advising a sophisticated corporate legal team.

 - Strong understanding of the workflows, challenges, and demands of law firms, including balancing legal risk with business priorities.

 - Executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility with legal and business stakeholders at all levels.

 - Outstanding communication and presentation skills — comfortable leading a live demo, facilitating a workshop, or engaging in strategic customer conversations.

 - Deep curiosity about AI's potential to transform legal work, paired with a practical, solutions-oriented mindset and bias toward action.

 - Track record partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results, with curiosity for testing approaches and optimizing for customer outcomes.

 - Cross-functional experience (business, ops, compliance, product), sales/customer-facing experience (law firm BD, secondment), and/or hands-on experience using AI tools in legal practice are all pluses.

 


COMPENSATION

$220,000 - $320,000 USD OTE 75/25 split

description_plain:
Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control.  Whether you’re buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That’s why the world’s most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business.


We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50  and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com http://www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.



Ironclad is looking for a Lead Counsel, Employment and Litigation with 8+ years experience to serve as the primary employment law advisor and a versatile contributor to the Legal team's broader compliance, litigation, and risk management work as the company scales. This role would report to and work collaboratively with the Deputy General Counsel, Corporate & Employment to provide guidance on employment related legal matters that align with our company culture and global business objectives. This role will have a key role in a broad range of employment and HR issues, including policy and process development, employee relations issues, investigations and compliance. The role will work closely with People and Legal leadership.



This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco office. Office attendance is required at least twice a week on Tuesdays and Thursdays for collaboration and connection. There may be additional in-office days for team or company events.



Responsibilities:

 - Serve as the first point of contact for Ironclad’s People Team to develop and deliver creative solutions to complex employment issues that align with the company’s strategic goals and values.

 - In partnership with the People Team, establish enterprise policies and scalable processes that will govern the legal aspects of the employment life cycle, including recruitment, compensation matters, reorganizations, leave management and administration, policy governance, employee privacy and more.

 - Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on employment law trends, workplace investigations, and complex personnel issues and collaborate with the People Team to develop strategic solutions that align business objectives with applicable employment laws and regulations.

 - Develop and deliver training programs for managers and People Team members on employment law best practices.

 - Serve as the employment law team lead for international expansion and other corporate initiatives.

 - Advise on matters arising out of the development and use of AI technology in recruiting/hiring, compliance, and other employment processes.

 - Advise managers and employees on the interaction between AI tool use and attorney-client privilege, including how to preserve privilege when using AI in the context of sensitive personnel matters, investigations, and legal escalations; partner with Legal Operations and the People team to develop practical guidance and guardrails.

 - Serve as the first-line internal resource for litigation and pre-litigation matters, including triaging demand letters, agency charges, subpoenas, and threatened claims; coordinating litigation holds with IT and Legal; and managing outside litigation counsel relationships on active matters.

 - Aid in developing our global compliance program.

 - Contribute to broader Legal team initiatives — including compliance program development, privilege training, cross-functional escalation frameworks, and legal operations improvements — as a collaborative member of the full Legal department.



Qualifications:

 - JD from an accredited law school and admission to the CA Bar.

 - 8+ years of legal experience, with at least 3+ years in-house in tech; strong preference for experience in high growth B2B company.

 - Proven track record in employment law matters, including employee relations issues, leave administration, pay equity, workplace investigations, performance management and policy development.

 - Experience managing or supporting employment-related litigation, pre-litigation disputes, and government inquiries, including demand letters, agency charges, subpoenas, and litigation holds; comfort coordinating with outside litigation counsel on active matters.

 - (Nice to have) Prior exposure to regulatory matters or compliance programs.

 - Intellectual curiosity and genuine willingness to lean into new areas of law, including compliance, regulatory developments, AI governance, and marketing review, as the needs of a growing Legal team evolve.

 - Positive, business-focused attitude with excellent judgment, high integrity, and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously and on time.

 - Ability to quickly assess business challenges and understand business objectives, making timely and pragmatic recommendations in light of company priorities.

 - Ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of people, collaborate with and build in partner relationships internally and externally.

 - In-depth understanding of how legal issues impact different parts of the organization and ability to translate complex legal issues in a clear and understandable manner.

 - Strong project management skills and a demonstrated ability to build and scale programs (including internationally) and lead cross-functional initiatives (including having led change management efforts).

 - Deep understanding of the modern Legal tech stack and surrounding LegalTech ecosystem.

 



Base Salary Range: $199,000.00 - $249,000.00 + offers bonus

The base salary range represents the minimum and maximum of the salary range for this position based at our San Francisco headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors, including individual proficiency, anticipated performance, and the location of the selected candidate. Our base salary is just one component of Ironclad’s competitive total rewards package, which also includes equity awards (a new hire grant, along with opportunities for additional awards throughout your tenure), competitive health and wellness benefits, and a commitment to career growth and development.



Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


US Full-Time Employee Benefits at Ironclad:

 - 100% health coverage for employees (medical, dental, and vision), and 75% coverage for dependents with buy-up plan options available

 - Market-leading leave policies, including gender-neutral parental leave and compassionate leave

 - Family forming support through Maven for you and your partner

 - Paid time off - take the time you need, when you need it

 - Monthly stipends for wellbeing, hybrid work, and (if applicable) cell phone use

 - Mental health support through Modern Health, including therapy, coaching, and digital tools

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits (US Employees)

 - 401(k) plan with Fidelity with employer match (US Employees)

 - Regular team events to connect, recharge, and have fun

 - And most importantly: the opportunity to help build the company you want to work at

**UK Employee-specific benefits are included on our UK job postings

description_plain:
About Us

UniCourt is a Legal Data as a Service (LDaaS) company dedicated to unlocking the potential of court data for Am Law 200 firms and Fortune 500 companies. Delivered via the only API-first platform in the legal technology market, UniCourt provides real-time state and federal court data for legal analytics. Our proprietary technology turns disparate court records into accessible, actionable insights. The UniCourt Enterprise API is the gold standard in legal data delivery, powering data-driven revenue growth and client satisfaction strategies.

Our team largely operates remotely across multiple time zones and countries. If you're looking to work at a company with opportunities to forge your career path in legal tech, UniCourt is the right place for you.

 

Position Summary

We are seeking a thoughtful, execution-oriented Product Manager to help drive the development of UniCourt DART, a legal technology platform focused on docket research, analytics, and tracking. This role will work closely with engineering, design, leadership, and customers to define and deliver product initiatives that improve how legal professionals access, analyze, and act on litigation and court data.

The ideal candidate has experience leading cross-functional product initiatives in B2B SaaS environments and is comfortable operating in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment. Legal tech experience and/or a law degree is strongly preferred.

 

Duties & Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Execution

 - Lead product initiatives across docketing, analytics, workflow, and platform capabilities

 - Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria

 - Collaborate with stakeholders to shape roadmap priorities, timelines, and execution plans

 - Drive product initiatives from early concept through launch and iteration

Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Work closely with Engineering teams to define requirements, prioritize work, and deliver high-quality product releases

 - Partner with Design and Engineering to improve usability, scalability, and platform performance

 - Coordinate communication and alignment between Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Leadership teams

 - Balance customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities in product decision-making

Product Discovery & Analytics

 - Conduct customer interviews, usage analysis, and competitive research to identify opportunities and improve product direction

 - Define, monitor, and analyze key product metrics and usage insights

 - Help identify areas for workflow optimization and enhanced customer experience

 - Stay informed on legal technology trends, litigation workflows, and evolving customer needs

Platform & Enterprise Features

 - Support the development of billing, subscription, and usage-tracking functionality

 - Contribute to RBAC (role-based access control), permissions, and enterprise administration design decisions

 - Collaborate on API-related initiatives, structured data workflows, and enterprise platform functionality

 

Education, Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Required

 - 3–5 years of product management experience, preferably within B2B SaaS environments

 - JD or other legal background strongly preferred

 - Experience leading product initiatives from concept through launch

 - Strong experience working directly with Engineering teams in agile development environments

View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/us-csm https://juro.notion.site/us-csm?source=copy_link



***




THE KEY BITS



 - Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located in Massachusetts and have long-term working rights in the US.

 - Flexibility: We have office hubs in Boston (US) and London (UK) as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work https://app.notion.com/juro/p/Choice-first-work-4044718b99fa4e2baa84a88a1051eab9?pvs=24 approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub. For this role, we prioritise candidates who prefer to work from our Boston office at least ~2 days a week.

 - Salary: We benchmarked $145,000 + 20% annual bonus (in 4x quarterly instalments based on performance targets) + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework https://app.notion.com/juro/p/Progression-framework-c9acbf27ec464b81b5bd4b3a22abe6dc?pvs=24 for someone based in Massachusetts.

 - Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 2.5 hours over 2 weeks, incl. a home task.

 - Start date: As soon as you can start.

 - Reporting to: George Hughes, Head of Customer Success

 - More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers http://juro.com/careers, our handbook https://juro.notion.site/handbook or ask talent@juro.com anything.






HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER




Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated https://www.law.com/legaltechnews/2023/03/30/legal-industry-reacts-to-goldman-sachs-generative-ai-report-keep-calm-and-panic/?slreturn=20231019075707 with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.



2026 is a big growth year for Juro. Our customer base is growing fast, especially in the US, and more teams are relying on us daily.

A lot of our customers have got early value from Juro and are ready for what comes next. They want more guidance, better alignment across their teams, and help embedding Juro into how they really work.

To deliver that at scale, we need smart automation paired with strategic human connection. As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you'll build the playbooks, automations, and touchpoints that help customers succeed while identifying the moments where your personal involvement drives the most impact.

You'll own a ~$3M book of business and have a voice in shaping how CS evolves as Juro grows.



Every Customer Success Manager’s mission at Juro is to make Juro's customers successful. Great means:

 1. Portfolio health is strong

 2. Customers are retained, growing and expanding

 3. Champions are identified and nurtured across key accounts

 4. Customer feedback is shared clearly to product and GTM teams

 5. You manage large / complex customers, coach junior CSMs + lead team initiatives



We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits https://juro.notion.site/benefits and choice-first work https://juro.notion.site/choice-first-work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub https://juro.notion.site/dei.






WHO WE LOOK FOR



Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.



Every Juror finds their balance across our four principles https://www.notion.so/Principles-acf77a5d174f427eb46aa3134a206296?pvs=21 — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day. Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz https://my-juro-personality.lovable.app/ to see how you map against our principles.



On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

 - You’ve built 3+ years* of customer-facing experience at an AI or SaaS scale-up (Series A-D).

 - You’ve engaged senior stakeholders, including Director level and above, holding credible, value-led conversations.

 - You’re confident consistently identifying and nurturing customer relationships across multiple accounts.

 - You’re known for strong discovery and problem solving skills, digging into what’s not working and taking action to move things forward proactively.



* What you did is more important than how long you did it. While this range is an orientation for you to understand the level of experience we’re looking for, we still want to hear from you if you think you have what it takes but don't quite meet this number.



This job likely isn’t for you if:

 - Rolling up your sleeves in an early‑stage, “build‑the‑playbook‑as‑we‑go” environment feels chaotic instead of energising.

 - You're not comfortable with travel to meet customers in person. This role involves building relationships face-to-face, not just over Zoom.

 - Working outside a rigid 9‑to‑5 window (to catch East & West Coast customers) sounds like more hassle than opportunity.






OUR MISSION




Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making legal contracts frictionless, collaborative and accessible.

Juro’s intelligent contract automation platform is on its way to de-throning desktop tools as the paradigm for collaborating on legal documentation around the world.

We’re doing that by rebuilding contracts from the ground-up around a browser-native experience, augmenting workflows with powerful AI and enabling all teams to conduct contracting jobs faster than ever before.

Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation https://juro.com/blog/vision-2024.






GOT MORE QUESTIONS?



Check if they're answered on:

 - Our extended job description for this role: https://juro.notion.site/us-csm https://juro.notion.site/us-csm?source=copy_link

 - Our company handbook: https://juro.notion.site/handbook https://juro.notion.site/handbook?pvs=4

 - Our careers page: https://juro.notion.site https://juro.notion.site/



There, you'll find answers on topics such as career progression, inclusion & belonging, the interview process, benefits and more. Or reach talent@juro.com for anything.

description_plain:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


ROLE OVERVIEW

Legora is looking for an Editorial Specialist to join our Communications team in London or Stockholm. This role will sit within the Editorial team and help shape how Legora shows up across social, editorial, and owned content channels.

You’ll be responsible for producing sharp, high-quality content that brings Legora’s story to life — from day-to-day social media production to longer-form editorial pieces, customer stories, campaign assets, and thought leadership. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, fast editor, and detail-oriented operator who understands how to turn ideas, news, and company moments into clear, compelling content for a professional audience.




WHAT YOU’LL DO



 - Produce and publish social media content across Legora’s owned channels, with a focus on LinkedIn.

 - Draft, edit, and adapt content for a range of formats, including social posts, newsletters, blog posts, customer announcements, event recaps, web copy, and campaign assets.

 - Work closely with the Editorial and Communications teams to maintain a consistent tone of voice across all external content.

 - Turn company updates, product developments, customer stories, events, and industry insights into timely, audience-relevant content.

 - Support the editorial calendar, helping plan, coordinate, and deliver content across channels.

 - Collaborate with colleagues across Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer, and Leadership to gather inputs and shape them into polished narratives.

 - Help develop content packages around launches, partnerships, events, customer wins, and thought-leadership campaigns.

 - Edit and proofread copy to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and alignment with Legora’s messaging.

 - Monitor social and editorial trends relevant to legal technology, AI, and the legal industry.

 - Support reporting on content performance and use insights to improve future output.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



 - 3–5 years of experience in editorial, communications, content marketing, journalism, social media, or a related field.

 - Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to produce clear, polished copy quickly.

 - Experience creating content for social media, especially LinkedIn.

 - Strong editorial judgment and attention to detail.

 - Ability to translate complex or technical topics into accessible, engaging content.

 - Comfortable working with stakeholders across different teams and seniority levels.

 - Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple pieces of content and deadlines at once.

 - A proactive, collaborative mindset and willingness to work in a fast-moving environment.

 - Interest in legal technology, AI, professional services, or B2B communications.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience working in a high-growth technology company.

 - Experience writing for legal, professional services, SaaS, AI, or enterprise audiences.

 - Familiarity with content calendars, social scheduling tools, analytics platforms, or CMS workflows.

 - Basic understanding of employer brand, executive communications, or media relations.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, you’ll help Legora communicate with clarity, consistency, and momentum. You’ll be a key contributor to the editorial engine behind our external presence — ensuring that our ideas, customer stories, product moments, and company updates are turned into high-quality content that reaches the right audiences at the right time.




LOCATION

This role is based in London or Stockholm and is part of Legora’s Communications team.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

ABOUT DILIGENCESQUARED

DiligenceSquared is the AI-native consulting firm. We deliver investment-grade market research and commercial due diligence, powered by AI agents and led by experienced consultants. Our founding team brings deep experience from Blackstone and BCG, and we’re backed by Y Combinator and Relentless. Our clients include 5 of the 10 largest private equity firms in the world and represent more than $3T in combined AUM.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a sharp, client-facing Business Lead to own the delivery of commercial due diligence for leading private equity funds.

You'll be the human-in-the-loop at the heart of our AI-powered research process: translating client needs into precise guidelines for our AI agents, overseeing the quality of their outputs, and ensuring every engagement is delivered with white-glove service.

This is a highly visible, client-facing role. You'll work directly with partners and deal teams at top-tier PE funds, have real ownership over your work, and help shape how we build and scale the product – without the layers of process that come with larger organizations.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own project delivery across multiple simultaneous CDD engagements, from kickoff through final report

 - Manage client relationships day-to-day

 - Coordinate expert sourcing across expert networks

 - Work closely with our AI systems to oversee interviews, analysis and synthesis to ensure coverage against client briefs

 - Partner with our engineering team to translate client and operational insights into product improvements

 - Build and refine internal processes and templates that improve delivery quality and speed

 - Collaborate with the founding team on product feedback

description_plain:
The Firm

Castleton Tower is a boutique consulting firm founded by executives who have built and led quantitative research, data science, and technology teams at top-tier hedge funds and asset managers. We work exclusively with investment management firms (RIAs, family offices, hedge funds, and asset allocators) helping them modernize their data infrastructure and build AI-ready foundations.

What makes us different: We're a lean firm where senior practitioners do the actual work. No armies of junior consultants learning on your dime. Our engagements blend high-level strategy with hands-on technical implementation. We'll assess your technical & business strategy, design your data architecture and also code up the full stack infrastructure where needed.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a strategic leader who can drive data and technology transformation for investment firms. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution. You'll need to be equally comfortable in a boardroom discussion about portfolio analytics and a working session designing Snowflake schemas.

What you'll get:

 - Strategic Impact: Lead full-scope projects from roadmap to production, not just strategy decks that sit on a shelf

 - Direct Mentorship: Work alongside the firm's Principals on every engagement

 - Modern Tech Stack: Work with best-in-class tools (similar to Snowflake, dbt, Dagster, Sigma, AWS, etc.) and cutting-edge AI/agentic development workflows

 - Path to Partnership: Clear trajectory toward firm equity and partnership for high performers

Core Responsibilities

Client Leadership & Strategy

 - Partner with senior investment professionals (PMs, CIOs, COOs, Heads of Operations) to understand their business goals and translate them into actionable technical roadmaps

 - Own client relationships end-to-end, managing expectations, deepening engagements, and identifying new opportunities

 - Lead projects from inception to delivery, ensuring the final product solves the actual business problem

Technical Solutioning

 - Design data architectures and analytics solutions that fit the client's investment workflow

 - Use Python and SQL to build dashboards, analytics tools, and investment applications

 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery

 - Guide architectural decisions across modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, cloud infrastructure)

This is not a "heavy" data engineering role, but you need to understand the underlying tools and architectures well enough to recommend optimal approaches and know what's technically feasible.

Qualifications

Required:

 - Prior experience within an investment management or trading organization (hedge funds, asset managers, quant shops, or market makers)

 - Demonstrated project leadership and comfort managing relationships with senior executives

 - Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis and application development

 - Strong conceptual understanding of modern data infrastructure

Valued:

 - Management consulting experience (strategy or implementation)

 - Experience at financial technology firms serving asset managers

 - Familiarity with investment operations, portfolio analytics, or fund accounting workflows

Personal Attributes:

 - High ownership mentality: you see problems through to resolution without being told

 - Executive presence to hold your own with senior investment leaders

 - Intellectual curiosity about both the investment side and the technology side

 - Comfort with ambiguity and ability to structure unstructured problems

Location & Compensation

Location: Hybrid in the NYC area. Expect to travel roughly one week per month for on-site client work.

Compensation:

 - Total compensation: $250k to $500k (commensurate with experience)

 - Firm equity available for high performers

description_plain:
ABOUT SAILPEAK

At Sailpeak, we are a Brussels-based consulting firm specializing in guiding Banking & Insurance firms through the complexities of digital transformation. With expertise in Business Strategy, Data & AI, and Digital Transformation, Sailpeak helps clients navigate an ever-evolving landscape and reach new heights of success.




🤖 ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Business Analyst with 2–5 years of experience to join our growing team in Brussels.

In this role, you will work on impactful digital transformation projects across our leading banking and insurance clients. While core business analysis is at the heart of what you will do day-to-day, being part of Sailpeak means you’ll also have exposure to our internal initiatives and cutting-edge solutions in Data & AI.




📊 YOU WILL:

 - Translate Business Needs: Turn business strategy and product roadmaps into clear business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories.

 - Bridge the Gap: Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technology/delivery teams to ensure alignment and smooth project delivery.

 - Optimize Processes: Map, document, and analyze end-to-end process flows and operational workflows to identify inefficiencies and drive optimization.

 - Manage Stakeholders: Build strong relationships with key client stakeholders to gather feedback, align priorities, manage expectations, and track overall progress.

 - Support Delivery & Rollout: Assist in change management, user testing, training, and solution adoption across business units.

 - Track & Report Performance: Provide insights and reporting on project KPIs, adoption metrics, and business outcomes to support strategic decision-making.

 - Explore AI Opportunities: Identify potential areas where automation, data analytics, or AI-enabled tools (e.g., digital assistants, intelligent process automation) can add extra value to business processes.
   
   


📊 YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:

 - 2–5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within the Financial Services, Banking, or Insurance sector (or consulting for these industries).

 - Strong capability in requirements gathering, process mapping, and gap analysis.

 - Solid understanding of core banking or insurance operational processes and digital tools.

 - Interest/Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with or curiosity about AI and automation technologies (e.g., chatbots, speech-to-text, digital assistants, predictive analytics) is a strong plus.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
   
   


🗣️ LANGUAGE SKILLS

 - Fluency in English AND either French or Dutch (proficiency in all three is an asset).
   
   


🤹 OTHER SKILLS

 - Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies is a big plus.

 - Proactive problem-solver with strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.

 - Ability to work independently and autonomously in high-impact environments.

 - A passion for continuous learning, growth, and keeping up with digital and tech trends.
   
   


🎁 WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

 - 💸 Competitive Compensation: An attractive salary and benefits package tailored to your experience.

 - 🦾 High-Impact Projects: Work on high-stakes transformation initiatives with leading banking and insurance clients while enjoying a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment.

 - 💿 Tech & AI Exposure: Opportunity to learn about and get hands-on exposure to modern Data & AI solutions as part of Sailpeak’s core DNA.

 - 🫂 Mentorship & Growth: Close guidance from Directors and Partners with proven track records at renowned firms like Google, PayPal, Semetis, and Sia Partners.
   
   


🧑‍🔬 THE PROCESS

 - Step 1: 30-minute call with our Talent team (focusing on your current situation, motivation, experience, and practicalities).

 - Step 2: 45-minute deep dive into your project experience with one of our experienced consultants.

 - Step 3: 30-minute call with one of the founders to discuss motivations, ambitions, and cultural fit.

 - Step 4: Onsite Business Case at our Brussels office.
   
   


READY TO APPLY?

Are you ready to build a rewarding career in management consulting and shape the future of financial services with Sailpeak?

description_plain:
WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO

If you're obsessed with technology and love grinding on complex systems, this is where you'll showcase your technical skills while solving hands-on operational challenges for law firm owners.

You'll deploy CRM configurations, project management systems, automation workflows, analytics dashboards and AI implementations while identifying business bottlenecks and designing solutions that streamline entire practices.

At Swans, we are assembling a team of "Avengers": technical problem-solvers who walk into struggling firms, identify the exact operational issues killing their growth, then build and deploy technical solutions that unlock millions in revenue potential for our clients.




ABOUT SWANS

 - Our Company: We are a fast-moving consulting & implementation agency that improves the way US law firms use technology to deliver better services to their clients.

 - Our Team: We're currently an international team of 10 and expect to grow to 30+ in the next 12 months.

 - Our Culture: We are energetic, no-BS, intense, results-oriented, and driven to change our industry forever.




DAY IN THE LIFE

The role has a dual nature:

 - 75% hands-on system design, building & implementation

 - 25% operational analysis, consulting & client interaction

The technical side of the job will have you solve challenges across 5 main areas:

 - CRM systems: A firm’s slow intake team is losing viable cases. You will build the automated email, SMS & AI workflows that ensure instant lead response and qualification.

 - Case Management / Project Management systems: Staff have abandoned their system, leaving hundreds of overdue tasks. You will standardize, automate, and clear this backlog, making the system a reliable single source of truth.

 - Data & Analytics: A firm owner is "gambling" on marketing, lacking clear financial data. You will build the data pipeline and profitability dashboard that provides real-time clarity.

 - Automation: Staff waste hours manually copying data into 200+ confusing document templates. You will consolidate these into smart templates and build an automation that generates complex documents perfectly in seconds.

 - AI: A firm is overwhelmed by repetitive tasks and suffers from low tech adoption. You will lead AI training sessions that embeds practical, safe, and efficient AI use into their daily work.

We are tool-agnostic and believe in using the best solution for the problem. You will gain deep expertise in a variety of best-in-class platforms (both generic and legal-specific).

The client side includes challenges like:

 - Uncovering law firm operational challenges and connecting these to technical solutions

 - Autonomously gathering requirements, presenting to & training client teams, and managing adoption of deployed solutions

 - Building working relationships with clients and ensuring their high satisfaction & NPS

You will be handling anywhere from 1 to 4 client engagements at a time (depending on their size & complexity), owning the full implementation while being supported by a senior consultant and an extensive knowledge base of past client projects & solutions. Our end-to-end client engagements usually have a duration of at least 6 months, so you will get a chance to truly dig in and get familiar with the clients' teams & processes to drive meaningful impact.




WHY THIS CHANGES EVERYTHING FOR YOU

If you're a high-performer frustrated by corporate bureaucracy, endless approvals, and career ladders based on tenure, this is your off-ramp. We are an anti-bureaucratic team for ambitious professionals who want their impact measured by results, not by time-in-seat.

Conversely, if you're a high-impact freelancer tired of the "feast-or-famine" cycle and juggling the overhead of sales & admin, this is your place. We provide a steady stream of complex, high-value clients so you can focus 100% on building solutions. You get to maintain the high ownership you love, but with the stability and leverage of a competitive salary and an elite team.




WHAT WE NEED

 - Client-ready communication skills - You'll present to law firm staff and senior executives, you will need to translate complex technical concepts to a non-tech-savvy audience

 - Systems thinking approach - You naturally see how technical solutions connect to business outcomes, and can solve hard problems autonomously

 - Builder mentality - You genuinely enjoy the process of designing, testing, and perfecting systems with high attention to detail

 - Technical experience - Proven track record of deploying & configuring CRMs, Project Management systems, Analytics Dashboards, Automation tools (Low-Code/No-Code), and/or AI applications

 - Ownership mentality - You like to get your hands dirty and pull through challenges autonomously, you take pride in your work and don't need micromanagement

 - Curiosity - You are excited to learn new tools & skills and can do so quickly, you are eager to adapt your approach if someone shows you a better way of solving a problem, you are coachable

 - Professional English fluency - You'll advise successful US-based law firms, B2 level at a minimum




IDEAL BACKGROUND

 - 2-5 years of experience in similar roles

 - Experience in client-facing roles and/or consulting, especially for SMEs

 - Experience with CRMs (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive)

 - Experience with Project Management/ERP Systems (e.g. Asana, Monday.com, Airtable, ClickUp, SAP)

 - Experience with automation/iPaaS tools (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n, MS Power Platform)

 - Experience with GenAI (e.g. Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek)

 - Experience with data analysis (e.g. BigQuery, Looker Studio, PowerBI, Tableau)

 - Experience working with REST APIs (integration)

 - Track record of learning complex tools quickly and applying them to business problems

Note: we DON'T expect candidates to have ALL the above skills and tool knowledge.

Portfolio preferred - showcase projects that demonstrate your systematic problem-solving approach.




THIS ROLE WILL NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You are looking for a "chill" 40-hours job environment, this job is INTENSE and you will be pushed to your limits on a daily basis

 - You want to be assessed on your inputs, this role will require you to own your OUTPUTS and your clients' results

 - You prefer to work in a managerial capacity, this role requires HANDS-ON building & deployment of systems and interacting with clients, you will own your projects end-to-end

 - You prefer pure technical implementation without business interaction, this role requires operational analysis skills and direct client COLLABORATION as well as technical execution

 - You're looking for hands-on coding opportunities, our team works exclusively with low-code and NO-CODE platforms rather than traditional development

 - You are looking for a predictable corporate environment with a structured workday and a linear career path, this role is highly DYNAMIC, priorities can change quickly, and we have zero tolerance for office politics

This role is for those who want to own their impact, accelerate their growth, and build systems that matter.




LOCATION & SCHEDULE

Fully Remote, with quarterly in-person meetups in locations all over the globe chosen by popular vote of team members (potential lineup for next year: USA, Tokyo, Dubai, Bangkok)

Flexible Schedule, but availability needed for client meetings Mon - Fri, morning US hours (afternoon-evening Eastern European Time)

We operate in focused 4-week sprints. Each sprint starts with clear goals and success metrics, followed by hands-on building, iteration, and delivery. You’ll own concrete outcomes every sprint; creating systems, improving adoption, and driving measurable client impact. This structure keeps work fast, accountable, and deeply execution-focused.




COMPENSATION

 - Competitive salary

 - Performance-based bonus & promotion path

 - Flexible benefits

 - Career-defining growth investment: we spent over $200,000 on team development last year – executive coaching, certifications, and training that accelerates your career beyond any traditional path




OUR MISSION

The legal industry is broken – outdated, overpriced, and structurally rigged against innovation and access. Today, 92% of low-income households can’t afford legal help, and meaningful reform is blocked by laws that prohibit non-lawyers from owning or operating law firms.

Our mission is to change that. By equipping law firms with cutting-edge tech and world-class operations, we will push the industry 10 years forward – delivering faster, better, and more affordable legal services at scale.




SWANS CORE VALUES

Value alignment is non-negotiable. Because of the close collaboration with the founding team and the direct impact on clients, it's essential that you genuinely connect with and embody our commitment to our core values:

 - Relentless Excellence: “We pursue mastery in every detail, not for perfection’s sake, but because success with our clients and mission requires it.”

 - Radical Integrity: “We choose transparency, honesty, and accountability, not for virtue’s sake, but because trust is the only way our work succeeds.”

 - Sincere Care: “We care enough to anticipate needs and act with empathy and intention, because genuine connection drives everything we build.”

Our standards are high - historically, less than 0.5% of candidates possess the rare combination of technical aptitude, client-facing skills, and cultural alignment we require.

description_plain:
ABOUT LATTICE PARTNERS

Lattice Partners is an AI product studio & consulting firm.

As a consulting firm, we assist our clients by providing them with AI strategies, trainings, and by building highly personalized AI-powered applications and AI agents. Our primary objective is to help them save time & money and get ahead of the competition. We operate across all industries, with clients in entertainment, finance, and manufacturing.

As a product studio, we build 0→1 AI products for clients starting businesses and for ourselves. We do everything from competitor analysis, user research, product design, development, and go-to-market strategy.

Across all of our work, we move efficiently, building applications that are maximally useful while leaning heavily on AI tooling.

We are always pushing ourselves to be more curious, ambitious, and efficient. We love using AI in our work and driving real, measurable value for our clients, who trust us to help them.




WHAT WE OFFER

Full ownership & freedom. We would like you to own the design process from start to finish and to operate independently. You will be given full control of product decisions as you grow into your role.

A fun, productive, user-first team. We exist to serve our clients and their businesses. This requires us to be focused and productive, but we have fun while doing it!

A path to growth and exploration. Our business has exploded in its first year, from 0 to $150,000+ (and growing fast) per month in revenue. As we grow, we’d like you to grow as well, explore new skillsets, and take on new projects and responsibilities.

An AI-native team. We stay up to date on the latest AI tools and news, integrating new tools where we see fit. We strive to use AI in our workflows to increase efficiency, while maintaining a high bar for quality.

Monthly stipend for learning about AI and trying new AI tools!




WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will be the first full-time designer for Lattice Partners and will be expected to juggle multiple projects for our clients. We build mission-critical software that's tailor-made for each client, so you'll get the opportunity to interact directly with users and meet their needs rapidly. You’ll also get the opportunity to start brand new projects from 0 to 1.

You’ll be responsible for owning the end to end design process including:

 - User Research

 - Product Ideation

 - UX Design

 - UI Design

You'll be in our daily stand-ups, in client meetings, and in critical meetings driving the directions our products take.

Ideally, we would like you to evolve into a Design Lead role.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

An AI-focused product designer with experience in Next.js apps and an interest in solving real business problems for our clients.

Requirements

 - 3+ years of product design experience in a professional environment

 - Experience designing AI applications

 - Experience designing products and features independently

 - You have the ability and curiosity to think through complex design problems and trade-offs

 - You can collaborate directly with engineers to get your designs implemented and understand what's possible

 - Experience with AI coding tools. You use Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code to create mock-ups and interactive designs.

 - Like us, you are curious about new industries and businesses and how technology can help them

 - Must be in a US timezone: PT/MT/CT/ET

 - Previous work that you’re proud of and can share with us

Nice to haves

 - Passion for becoming an excellent AI-first designer

 - Previous consulting / contracting experience juggling multiple projects

 - Startup experience




LOCATION

The Lattice Partners team is primarily based in Los Angeles but operates remotely. We work PST hours.




COMPENSATION

The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $160,000. This will start as a 3-month contractor position, with the goal to evolve into a full-time W-2 role with benefits.
