description_plain:
ABOUT CAPE

Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.

Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected and have privacy.

We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.

Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.




THE TEAM

At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to own and scale the systems, processes, and analytics that power our go-to-market engine. You'll sit at the intersection of Business Development, Operations, and Finance - turning messy processes into clean, automated, data-driven workflows, and giving leadership the visibility they need to make good decisions.



This is a hands-on role for someone who's equally comfortable architecting a Salesforce data model, running a forecast cadence, and investing in enablement to scale our BD org. You'll partner closely with sales leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to remove friction across the revenue lifecycle - from lead to renewal.






WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 - Systems & Data
   
   - Own the CRM (Salesforce) data layer: Object model, field definitions, pipeline data integrity, and the hygiene processes that keep the data trustworthy.
   
   - Evaluate, select, and integrate GTM tools, making thoughtful build-vs-buy decisions as the tech stack scales.
   
   - Partner with data/analytics teams to ensure CRM data flows cleanly into downstream reporting and BI systems.
   
   - Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give sales and executive leadership visibility into pipeline health, conversion, and rep performance.
   
   - Support monthly/quarterly business reviews with clear, data-backed narratives.

 - Process & Deal Support
   
   - Own or support deal desk operations: Approval workflows, non-standard deal structuring, and SLA management.
   
   - Document and continuously improve sales processes and methodology to ensure consistent execution from prospecting through close.
   
   - Partner with Ops to ensure seamless implementations, as well as create automations to help the team proactively manage the customer lifecycle.
   
   - Enable on-target fulfillment from Ops to the customer through detailed information management and clear communication.

 - Cross-Functional Partnership
   
   - Act as the operational thought partner to Business Development, Operations, and Finance leadership, translating business needs into scalable systems and processes.
   
   - Ensure BD is enabled, training the team on the most up to date pricing strategy, proactively creating customer facing collateral, or educating the team on the latest product SKUs.
   
   - Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive audiences.






EXPERIENCE

 - 4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, or a closely related role, ideally in B2B SaaS or defense tech.

 - Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce (administration, reporting, data model design); certification a plus.

 - Solid analytical skills - comfortable working in SQL, Excel/Sheets, and BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

 - Experience owning or heavily supporting a forecasting cadence and pipeline reporting.

 - Familiarity with the broader revenue tech stack (marketing automation, sales engagement, CPQ, BI, and data warehouse tools).

 - A track record of turning ambiguous, messy problems into documented, scalable processes.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and present to leadership.

 - A builder's mindset: bias toward action, comfortable prototyping a solution rather than waiting for a perfect spec.






COMPENSATION

We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted based on your location, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role in New York, NY is $150,000-$180,000 depending on experience and interview performance.

Our benefits include:

 - 401(k) match

 - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents

 - 12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)

 - Stipends for
   
   - Family-forming needs
   
   - Gender-affirming care

 - Unlimited PTO




OUR CULTURE & VALUES

 - We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning.

 - We believe that personal privacy and national security are not at odds, and that they can be reconciled through strong technology.

 - We believe companies exist to build awesome things and take care of the people who build them, so we offer top-tier healthcare, 401(k) matching, and a generous vacation policy that our team actually uses to recharge.

 - We believe that a stronger company and a better product are built by people from all walks of life. We hire without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. If you are great at what you do, you belong here.
   
   


HOW TO APPLY

Click the link below to apply.

We reserve the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes received from outside recruiting agencies and / or individual recruiters without being responsible for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, and without regard to disability or status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by law.

description_plain:
IMS CORE ENGINEER / ARCHITECT



The IMS/VoLTE Integration Engineer will analyze, prepare, implement and verify the configuration and integration of a node, network and/or system. Your scope of work could include the scenarios of introduction, upgrade expansion, functionality and capacity. Your work will in part form our customer legacy.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :

As part of the mobile core team, you will take care of our IMS mobile platform; you will have the following responsibilities:

 - Manage networks and nodes within the IMS domain for our 2.5G, 3G & 4G networks (SIP, H323, IMS/IMT, VoLTE, VoWiFi)

 - Using dashboards (and building new ones) to clearly and quickly discover issues and patterns

 - Accountable and responsible to follow the communications procedures in place when handling an incident. Communication is both internal within our company and external to our third-party providers.

 - Maintenance, troubleshooting, security audits, and emergency response

 - Undertake fault handling and corrective actions on node, service and infrastructure level

 - Handle project activities, implementing / adapting (new) IMS E2E service functionalities, nodes, services

 - When needed, cover the 7x24 monitoring shift responsibilities (On call support, Baby Sitting activities etc.)

 - Wireshark tracing of critical infrastructure to debug issues

 - Provide input, implement and verify improvements in processes and work instructions ·

 - Verify and implement configuration changes

 - Work to identify and drive improvement




KEY QUALIFICATIONS

At least 10 years’ experience in the core network domain with a mobile networks

 - Holding a BSc degree in Telecommunication or Computer Science (post-graduate studies are a bonus) and 10+ years core telecommunications network experience.

 - Working knowledge of telecom networks like 2G, 2.5G, 3G and LTE (MME, SGW, PGW, and MME).

 - Great Conceptual understanding of IMS evolution and trends - IMS Subsystems, functionalities and IMS services call flows.

 - Great knowledge of IMS network topology (their various interfaces), Core IMS Parameters and Features.

 - Worked on different type of Core Nodes, CSFB, IMS (P-CSCF, I-CSCF, S-CSCF, MTAS, HSS, CUDB, MGCF, etc.).

 - Experience with SS7, ISUP, BICC, SIP, H248, Diameter signaling & protocols configuration change IMS based services is necessary.

description_plain:
ABOUT HIYA

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Protect team at Hiya builds products at the intersection of voice, telephony, and artificial intelligence. Our work spans both audio intelligence (e.g., deepfake detection, fraud intent detection, etc.) and conversational AI, specifically on voice AI agents that enhance protection and productivity for consumers in their mobile devices. We train our own proprietary models and use third-party solutions to complement our core offering.

Our products need to delight the end-users while at the same type provide strategic and commercial value to our telecom operator partners.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will have a key role in the team by leading one (or multiple of) these products. We are looking for someone that can work both at a strategic level, defining the vision and “why” we build what we build, while at the same time is very hands-on in the product development process, working side by side with engineers with a very clear “builder” mentality, going deep into the technical details of the solution.

The core of this role is not aimed at managing a backlog, running sprint plannings and standups and writing PRDs. This is a role that needs to be close to our customers to understand what they want, transform uncertainty into clarity, connect dots, build a product vision and execute it. You will own the product end-to-end.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Talk a lot to customers (telecom operators) and understand what they want and why.

 - Form a product vision to solve our customers and users problems.

 - Prioritize ruthlessly, say “no” a lot and make sure that everyone (team, customers and internal stakeholders) understands what we are doing and why.

 - Work closely with other teams at Hiya, in particular:
   
   - With our Engineering team to execute the vision, being hands on, setting priorities and prototyping ideas yourself. Sometimes creating your own PRs.
   
   - With our Research team to prioritze our model training roadmap.
   
   - With our Revenue team to uncover customer needs, price our products and support them in customer-facing meetings and events.
   
   - With our Legal team to understand how regulation shapes our product.
   
   - With our Finance team to work on our product economics, business cases and investment decisions.

This is role is for you if:

 - You have at least one of the following experiences: (1) worked in product management at a venture-backed startup, (2) you have been a founder or early employee in a startup and were close to the product or (3) you have been a management consultant (MBB) and can prove that tech is not a new thing to you.

 - You likely have a technical background either by education or professionally.

 - You have a strong sense of urgency when you execute and instill that to the people that surround you.

 - The idea of building AI solutions that will impact millions of people in their day-to-day communications excites you.

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity and uncertainty and you embrace autonomy, charting your own path and knowing when to ask for help.

 - You are very curious and like to understand how things work and are not afraid of trying or learning new things very fast.

 - Your way of working includes AI at its core to multiply the speed and quality of what you do.

 - You are close to the tech and AI ecosystem and you feel an urge to test the last model or product that was just launched.

 - You have excellent communication skills both written and spoken and you are able to structure your thoughts clearly to deliver your ideas to people.

Bonus Points

 - Experience with AI or voice AI either at the model, orchestration or application layer.

 - You have launched successful products before as PM.

 - You can show something you have built yourself without an engineer.

 - You have done something out of the normal in your life that shaped you to be who you are today.


HOW WE WORK

Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems. We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy. Context is shared openly, and decisions are discussed, challenged, and then made. Once a call is made, we commit and move forward.

You’ll be expected to work through ambiguity, weigh tradeoffs, and take responsibility for results—while keeping a high bar for quality and customer trust.

Every team member at Hiya is expected to live our core values:

 - Serve, our customers and partners by holding a high bar for trust and quality

 - Own, share in success and open up to failures

 - Lead, listen, show up with a point of view but commit entirely once a decision has been made

 - Improve, even if it means changing course or contradicting ourselves

 - Do, rather than observe


HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

Compensation & Ownership

 - Base Salary: $188,000- $218,000
   
   - Compensation is determined by role scope, skills, experience, location, and market data.

 - Equity Compensation: ownership aligned with your impact and the company's growth

Benefits & Support

 - Employer-sponsored Insurance
   
   - Medical, dental, and vision (PPO & HDHP); 50% dependent coverage
   
   - Health, flexible spending, and dependent care accounts
   
   - Life, AD&D, and accident coverage, with company-paid life and long-term disability

 - 401(k) with 3% company match (via Fidelity)

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - Paid parental leave

 - Work-from-home equipment stipend

 - $1,000 annually to invest in your learning and growth

 - $1,000/year in charitable donation matching

 - Team lunch 2x per week


COME WORK WITH US!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!



Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

description_plain:
About Sent

Sent is an infrastructure for sending A2P messages across SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS through a single unified API. Our intelligent routing model automates channel selection based on deliverability and cost, ensuring lower cost and global reach without any channel-specific integrations.

We recently closed a $12M Series A backed by Companyon Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, UIF, and others. We're hiring to build the best infrastructure to replace multi-channel messaging stacks.

About the Role

We're hiring someone to build Sent's partner ecosystem across the startups and developer tools landscape. You'll own the full lifecycle - identifying high-leverage partnerships, structuring agreements, launching integrations, co-hosting events, and driving co-sell revenue.

Because Sent is an API-first product, this isn't a role where you can hand-wave the technical details. You need to understand how developers evaluate and adopt infrastructure, speak credibly about APIs and integrations, and ideally have built things yourself. The best version of this person has spent time in tech and still ships side projects on weekends.

This is a build-from-scratch role. You'll define the strategy, close the first wave of partnerships, then operationalize what works into scalable programs as Sent grows.

What You'll Do

Strategic & Integration Partnerships

 - Identify and prioritize partnerships across developer tools, CRMs, marketing platforms, and marketplaces based on revenue potential and integration value

 - Structure partnership agreements - co-sell, referral, integration, and reseller models

 - Negotiate commercial terms, SLAs, and GTM commitments

 - Coordinate with product and engineering on integration roadmaps and technical requirements

Ecosystem & GTM

 - Launch co-marketing and co-sell programs that generate measurable pipeline

 - Host in-person events and represent Sent at partner events, conferences, and industry forums

 - Track partner-sourced revenue, integration adoption, and ecosystem health metrics

 - Report performance to leadership and shape broader GTM strategy

What You'll Bring

Required

 - At least 4 years in partnerships/BD/sales at a developer-focused company or VC (investing, platform, or portfolio ops) 

 - Experience structuring and closing partnership agreements - not just sourcing

 - Strong understanding of API ecosystems, SaaS business models, and how developers adopt infrastructure

 - Technically conversational - you can demo an API, read docs, and talk integration architecture with engineers

 - Proven ability to build programs that generate measurable revenue or adoption

 - Comfortable working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales

 - Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills

 - Located in NYC or willing to relocate

Nice to Have

 - You build side projects, hack on APIs, or have shipped something yourself

 - Previous experience building a partnerships function from scratch

 - Existing network across VC platform teams and/or the developer tools ecosystem

 - Familiarity with messaging APIs, CPaaS, or communications infrastructure

What Makes This Role Special

 - Own the function. Build Sent's partnerships org from strategy to execution - this is your team to build.

 - Massive surface area. Messaging touches every SaaS company, CRM, and communication platform. The partner ecosystem is enormous.

 - Native distribution. Use your network as a real go-to-market channel, 

 - Revenue impact. Partnerships directly drive adoption, integration depth, and deal size. Your work shows up in the numbers.

 - Cross-functional influence. Shape product roadmap through partner requirements and integration priorities.

Our Commitment to You

 - Meaningful equity with high growth potential

 - Top-tier medical, dental, vision fully covered

 - 401(k) with 100% match up to 4%

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Beautiful NYC workspace with daily meals and unlimited snacks

 - New MacBook Pro + Apple Studio Display

 - Wellhub Gold or Equinox membership

Sent, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

description_plain:
About Elveo

Elveo is what happens when two pioneers in direct-to-device (D2D) communications join forces. Elveo brings together a combined 20 years of expertise to close the coverage gap for more than 50 mobile network operators (MNOs) and major distribution partners operating in 60+ countries worldwide.

That heritage and our technology powers what we call ‘elevated intelligence’ — a new approach that processes and adapts on orbit, delivering voice and data services straight to mobile users, IoT devices and machines across enterprise, government and humanitarian sectors worldwide.

As a team, we’re on a mission to deliver powerful compute and connectivity directly to individuals and objects everywhere on Earth.

Join us, and become part of a globally inclusive company that is transforming satellite communications from a niche service to an essential global infrastructure, and democratizing connectivity for billions worldwide.

Ready to take the next step? Join us.

 

Job Summary

Elveo is looking for a RF Systems Technical Project Manager to oversee technology development projects related to our satellites and their wireless payloads. This role will be responsible for developing and managing assigned technology development projects from cradle to grave, guiding and enabling the future path along Elveo’s Technology Roadmap. This requires an individual that is entrepreneurial and drives/assists in the pursuit of technology development efforts across Elveo’s organization.



Managing RF systems technical projects at Elveo requires familiarity with wireless communications, modern communications signals and protocols, RF system design, high speed digital design, COTS component integration, and software and hardware development. The effective candidate thrives equally in informing/architecting the future and setting the necessary project plan for execution of strategically significant efforts across multi-functional teams.



Core Responsibilities

The RF Systems Technical Project Manager will manage technical projects in the wireless communication domain. Specific activities include

 - Manage multiple RF systems projects that span from concept generation through product realization for new technology development efforts in the wireless communications domain.

 - Coordinate with project sponsors and key senior team members in defining and budgeting for new technology development efforts.

 - Work with technology leads to define projects at the task level including task definition, duration, and relationship to other tasks, as well as resource loading projects to create measurable schedules.

 - Understand, manage, and take ownership of cost, schedule, and technical performance and risks associated with assigned efforts.

 - Act as the primary interface to project sponsors, key senior team members, and other stakeholders on project status and performance.

 - Interact regularly with suppliers / subcontractors related to technology development projects.



Qualifications

 - A Bachelor’s Degree or better in science, engineering, or relevant technical field from an accredited university; a Master Degree in a relevant technical field is preferred.

 - 10+ years of industry experience, including 3+ years in a Technical Project Management role.

 - Technical understanding of and experience working on RF System development projects, including RFFE design and test, antenna design and test, and digital beamforming system design and test (e.g., beamformers).

 - Demonstrated experience as a Technical Lead or Project Manager working in the RF domain is a plus.

 - Exposure to government programs and a current active security clearance is a plus.

 - Knowledge and understanding of processes, tools, and metrics essential for project monitoring and control and risk management.

 - Experience transitioning technologies from a design concept to a functioning product is a plus.



ITAR Requirements

To comply with U.S. Government export control regulations (ITAR), applicants must be one of the following: (i) a U.S. citizen or national, (ii) a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) a refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) an asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158. Individuals who do not meet these criteria must be eligible to obtain the necessary authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. For more information, please refer to the ITAR guidelines.

Learn about ITAR here. https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/ddtc_public?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987



Job Location

Washington, DC area

description_plain:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.



Job Summary

OpenGov’s Professional Services (PS) team delivers configurable, scalable solutions to state and local governments using Government App Builder (GAB) — OpenGov’s proprietary low-code/no-code application development platform.

As a Business Application Developer III, you will design, configure, and enhance customer or business specific applications using platform capabilities, configuration, data modeling, workflow automation, and limited scripting.

You will split your time between:

 - Designing and configuring business applications using Government App Builder

 - Partnering directly with implementation teams and customers to translate business processes into scalable, automated solutions

 

This role is ideal for a technically strong problem solver who understands data modeling, workflow logic, and business process design — but does not require heavy full-stack engineering in frameworks such as React, NodeJS, or Java. You will play a key role in delivering high-impact solutions that modernize government operations.

 

Key Responsibilities

 1.  Application Configuration & Solution Design

 - Partner with customers and implementation teams to understand operational workflows and system requirements.

 - Translate business requirements into scalable application designs within Government App Builder.

 - Configure entities, forms, fields, validations, permissions, dashboards, and reports.

 - Apply structured configuration standards to ensure usability, maintainability, and scalability.

 - Participate in validation sessions and backlog refinement to align configuration with scope.

 2. Data Modeling & Architecture

 - Design structured data models including entity relationships and cross-table references.

 - Apply data modeling best practices including normalization, denormalization trade-offs, and referential integrity.

 - Configure field-level validations and data constraints to ensure data quality.

 - Support data migrations including field mapping, data transformation, and validation of imported records.

 - Troubleshoot data inconsistencies and recommend corrective design patterns.

 3. Workflow & Process Automation

 - Configure approval workflows, routing logic, conditional triggers, and status transitions.

 - Implement task assignments, notification rules, and automation components.

 - Translate documented decision trees and business rules into platform logic.

 - Optimize workflows for compliance, accountability, and audit transparency.

 - Ensure scalability of workflows across departments and user roles.

 4. Business Rule Implementation & Light Scripting

 - Implement conditional logic using platform configuration tools.

 1. Write limited JavaScript (or similar scripting) for:

 - Complex validations

 - Calculations and derived fields

 - Conditional routing

 - Data transformation logic

 - Maintain clean, reusable logic patterns without overengineering or heavy custom code.

 5. Integrations & Interoperability

 - Configure and validate integrations between Government App Builder and external systems (e.g., ERP, financial systems).

 - Support API-based, file-based, event-based or scheduled data exchange patterns.

 - Design field mappings and transformation logic to ensure data consistency across systems.

 - Document integration patterns and reusable configuration standards.

 6. Embedded Delivery Support

 - Serve as a technical configuration specialist within active customer implementations.

 - Partner with Project Managers and Implementation Consultants to deliver configured solutions on time and within scope.

 - Troubleshoot configuration issues during UAT and go-live phases.

 - Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer to Customer Success teams.

 7. Project & Delivery Management

 - Contribute technical effort estimates for configuration and automation tasks.

 - Manage work across multiple concurrent engagements.

 - Ensure timely delivery of configured applications within broader project timelines.

 - Maintain high standards of quality, documentation, and responsiveness.

 

Required Qualifications

 - Total 3 to 9 years of work experience, including 3+ years of experience in low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Appian, Microsoft Power Apps, Mendix, ServiceNow, etc.) or enterprise application configuration roles.

 - Strong understanding of data modeling concepts like entity relationships, referential integrity, normalization, and denormalization.

 - Experience designing and implementing business workflows and approval automation.

 - Working knowledge of JavaScript or similar scripting language for implementing business rules.

 - Ability to translate complex business processes into structured, configurable application logic.

 - Experience with integrations (REST APIs, file-based transfers, event based workflows or batch processes).

 - Experience integrating third-party APIs and embedding outputs into larger application workflows.

 - Strong understanding of security standards (e.g., OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI).

 - Strong analytical thinking with systems and process-improvement mindset.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

 - Proven success working in fast-paced, iterative environments with cross-functional stakeholders.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience in GovTech or public-sector workflows (budgeting, grants management, procurement, capital planning, permitting, capital project management etc.).

 - Background in Professional Services, consulting, or customer-facing implementation roles.

 - Familiarity with security concepts such as role-based access control and data governance practices.

Why Join OpenGov Professional Services

You will help modernize government operations by designing configurable, scalable applications that replace spreadsheets, manual workflows, and disconnected systems. As part of our Professional Services team, you will:

 - Build impactful solutions without heavy custom engineering overhead.

 - Shape best practices for Government App Builder implementations.

 - Collaborate with the platform engineering team for improving and enhancing the platform for required capabilities.

 - Work with mission-driven teams serving state and local governments.

 - Develop expertise in workflow automation, structured data modeling, and enterprise configuration at scale.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

description_plain:
SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER

Boston, MA  •  Full-time

 


ABOUT OUR COMPANY

Government’s biggest challenges — homelessness, election administration, emergency response — don’t get solved inside a single agency. Work happens across dozens of organizations that often struggle to coordinate, share information, and act in real time.

Civic Roundtable is an AI-powered government operations platform that helps public servants do exactly that. We give wide networks of agencies and partner organizations the tools to consolidate information, coordinate mission-critical work, and move faster together so the people on the frontlines of public problems have what they need to serve their communities.

Trusted by 4,000+ organizations across all 50 states, Civic Roundtable emerged from the Harvard Innovation Labs and is backed by General Catalyst.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for our first product hire beyond our Head of Product. Roundtable's product surface has grown quickly: collaborative spaces, a CRM, Documents, Forms, Events, and an AI layer running across all of it. You'll take ownership of a meaningful slice of it, working alongside an engineering manager and a pod of engineers. There's no roadmap process to administer, no analytics team to request numbers from, no research org to hand discovery to - you'll do that work yourself, and you'll shape how we do it from here.

You'll report to our Head of Product and work daily with engineering, design, and our deployments team. This role is based in Boston, in-person at least 1 day a week.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle - Own core product areas and be accountable for outcomes, from ideation and strategy to execution and launch.

 - Engage directly with customers - Run user interviews, workflow mapping, usability testing, shadowing, competitive research, and data analysis. Work with Customer Success and Sales to understand pain points, and translate those insights into high-impact product investments.

 - Drive high-velocity execution with engineering and design - Translate strategy into intuitive experiences that are built to scale. Help engineers and designers understand users deeply enough to make great product decisions and iterate rapidly.

 - Define what success looks like - Set success metrics before you build, make sure the right things get instrumented, and review outcomes after launch.

 - Land the launch - Craft messaging that resonates with users, enable Sales and Marketing to win with customers, and drive cross-functional readiness across teams.

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in product management - A track record of shipping high-quality products end-to-end, from discovery and definition through launch and iteration, ideally in B2B SaaS. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, with urgency and ownership, in fast-paced, low-structure environments.

 - High agency - You bring structure to ambiguous problem spaces and move without being told. You have a bias to action and have a scrappy high-ownership mentality, willing to QA, debug alongside an engineer, or backstop a customer team when that's what the team requires.

 - Strong product, user, and business instincts - You care how products feel and fit into someone's daily work, and you balance user needs, domain complexity, and system constraints to find the high-leverage improvements. You find the real need underneath a customer request and prioritize by impact, zooming out to vertical-level strategy and back down to precise workflow nuance.

 - Excellent communication - You can articulate a product vision and the tradeoffs behind it to diverse audiences including customers, engineers, executives, and cross-functional teams.

 - Fluency with metrics and experimentation - Use data to test ideas, learn from user feedback, and iterate quickly.

 - Hands-on AI experience - You've built agents, prototypes, or AI-powered workflows yourself. You consistently and creatively apply AI to improve your own product processes.

 


WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING @ CIVIC ROUNDTABLE

 - You'll have a competitive salary, meaningful equity, health benefits, and flexible work arrangements as part of our first 30 employees

 - You'll build products that help government work better for millions of people, from delivering housing services to supporting elections, emergency response, and veterans.

 - You'll work directly with founders every day and have real influence on the product, company, and culture from the ground floor as one of our first 30 employees.

 - You'll help define what AI-native software looks like for the public sector, turning emerging capabilities into products that solve real problems for public servants.

 - You'll tackle complex coordination problems that span organizations, agencies, and systems, where there’s no established playbook or obvious product category to copy.

 - You'll build, ship, learn, and iterate quickly. You’ll have the autonomy to make high-quality product decisions, turn insight into action, and ship features that have an immediate, measurable impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you’re passionate about building great products and making a difference, we want to hear from you!

description_plain:
🏛️ ABOUT GOVWELL

We the people — and the taxpayers — deserve good government. Yet today, interacting with government services is often frustrating and inefficient. GovWell is building the AI operating system transforming how governments serve communities, starting with local agencies.

GovWell replaces legacy software for municipalities and counties, empowering public servants to radically streamline public services and cut internal processing time for permits and licenses by up to 95%.

Founded in 2023, GovWell powers 5,000+ mission-critical processes for agencies in 35+ states serving millions of residents. The company has raised $35M in funding from Insight Partners, Work-Bench, and Bienville Capital, and the team works in person at GovWell HQ in New York City. Read more about our founding story in TechCrunch https://techcrunch.com/2024/07/29/govwell-is-bringing-automation-and-efficiency-to-local-governments/.





☀️ WHY GOVWELL?

 - A mission that matters: Building AI-powered products to fix outdated government systems isn’t just a technical challenge—it’s a historic opportunity to improve our foundational relationship with government and ensure trillions of tax dollars result in high quality services. WATCH: Mission & Vision with CEO & Co-Founder Troy LeCaire https://www.loom.com/share/3d733b22ca0d4fa6be241e0cdd36311a

 - Real-world impact: GovWell’s product is the system of record for government services that affect millions of Americans. From streamlining permitting for small businesses to accelerating affordable housing development, your work will make an immediate difference.

 - Join a startup in hyper-growth: We’ve found product-market fit and are scaling the business very quickly (4X ARR growth in the last year). As an early team member, you’ll learn what it takes to build a successful startup. You’ll work closely with the founders while enjoying exceptional autonomy and ownership over your work.




🌟 ROLE OVERVIEW

GovWell is hiring a Narrative and Content Lead to own the stories we tell and build content that earns attention in a crowded market. You’ll set our editorial agenda and create distinctive content across thought leadership, customer stories, social, original research, and more.


You’ll work closely with the Head of Marketing, founders, and broader marketing team to turn GovWell’s customers, products, data, and perspective on government into content people genuinely want to read and share. From analyzing permitting data across the country to telling the stories of the public servants we work with, you’ll have a unique set of raw materials to build from.


This role offers significant ownership over GovWell’s content function, from deciding what stories are worth telling to writing, publishing, distributing, and measuring them.


We have a hybrid work culture that combines regular in-person collaboration at our New York City office (3+ days per week) with flexibility to work remotely.




💻 WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own GovWell’s editorial calendar and publishing cadence across blog, social, email, and other channels, including how content is distributed and optimized for SEO and AI discoverability

 - Write and publish compelling content across formats, including thought leadership, original data reports, gated guides, product stories, and analysis of trends shaping government

 - Own GovWell’s social presence and ghostwrite for our founders, developing distinct voices and a consistent publishing rhythm that builds our audience

 - Build our customer story engine by sourcing, producing, and publishing case studies and customer videos in partnership with Sales and Deployment

 - Set a high editorial bar and continuously experiment with new formats, stories, and creative bets that help GovWell stand out and earn attention




🧠 WHO YOU ARE

 - 1–3+ years in content marketing, journalism, editorial, or a related role with a portfolio of published work you personally wrote, ideally in a B2B environment 

 - Exceptional writer and storyteller who can turn technical, bureaucratic, or complex topics into clear, compelling stories with a distinct point of view

 - Creative and highly curious, with strong taste and an instinct for finding stories people actually want to read

 - End-to-end publisher who can take an idea from research and writing through distribution, SEO, and performance analysis

 - Comfortable owning social channels and ghostwriting for executives, with an ability to adapt voice and format to different audiences

 - Revenue-minded, with an understanding of how content can generate pipeline, influence deals, strengthen brand, and engage existing customers

 - AI-forward, using AI to accelerate research and execution without sacrificing originality, judgment, or quality

 - Strong alignment with our Core Values. https://govwell.com/careers#core-values




💸 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Compensation within the posted salary band will be commensurate with experience. All offers will include:
   
   - Competitive base salary + bonus.
   
   - Equity / stock options.
   
   - Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
   
   - 401(k) program.
   
   - Flexible PTO.

description_plain:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Strategic Operations Lead, Public Sector serves as a force multiplier for Socure's Public Sector business, supporting federal, state, and local government agencies—as well as education and healthcare institutions—as they modernize identity verification and combat fraud.

Reporting to the General Manager of Public Sector, you'll operate as a strategic partner and chief of staff, driving go-to-market execution, operational excellence, AI-enabled workflows, and cross-functional initiatives that accelerate growth. This is an ideal role for someone from consulting, finance, government, GovTech, or civic technology who thrives in ambiguity and wants broad exposure to senior leadership in a high-growth, pre-IPO environment.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


REVENUE & CUSTOMER EXECUTION

 - Lead execution of key customer and revenue initiatives, including quarterly business reviews, agency briefings, contract renewals, proof-of-value and pilot readouts, and RFP responses.

 - Support renewal and recompete strategies through pricing analysis, financial modeling, scenario planning, and risk assessment.

 - Identify expansion opportunities through agency, program, and market analysis.

 - Develop executive-ready materials that translate customer, policy, and technical requirements into clear recommendations.


BUSINESS OPERATIONS & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL EXECUTION

 - Partner across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, Product, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Legal to drive execution across complex public sector sales cycles.

 - Own key operating cadences, including deal reviews, forecasting, internal QBRs, leadership meetings, and all-hands.

 - Track priorities, dependencies, and follow-ups while proactively identifying and resolving blockers.

 - Improve reporting, workflows, and cross-functional processes to increase operational efficiency and visibility.


STRATEGY & LEADERSHIP ENABLEMENT

 - Build scalable operating systems, dashboards, AI-enabled workflows, and automation to improve execution.

 - Serve as a strategic thought partner to Public Sector leadership, driving high-impact initiatives from concept through execution.

 - Conduct ad hoc strategic, financial, and operational analysis to support business decisions.

 - Bring structure to ambiguity by balancing strategic planning with day-to-day execution.




WHAT YOU BRING

We're looking for a strategic operator who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and enjoys solving complex business challenges. We welcome candidates from a variety of high-performing backgrounds, including:




STRATEGY, FINANCE & BUSINESS OPERATIONS

You may have experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, strategic finance, or another highly analytical operating role. You're comfortable working with senior stakeholders, building executive-ready analyses, and turning data into actionable recommendations.




GOVERNMENT & PUBLIC SECTOR

You may come from state, local, or federal government as a budget analyst, program manager, project manager, strategy lead, chief of staff, or legislative staffer. You understand procurement cycles, appropriations, stakeholder management, and the operational realities of delivering programs in the public sector—particularly within identity, benefits, fraud prevention, tax administration, workforce, or citizen services.




PUBLIC SECTOR CONSULTING & GOVTECH

You may have advised or partnered with government agencies through organizations such as Deloitte, Booz Allen Hamilton, Accenture Federal Services, Guidehouse, ICF, or a GovTech company. Experience supporting RFPs, agency relationships, public sector modernization, procurement, or regulated industries is highly valued.




DIGITAL GOVERNMENT & CIVIC TECHNOLOGY

You may come from organizations such as 18F, the U.S. Digital Service, state or local digital service teams, or civic technology organizations. This includes chiefs of staff, strategic operators, and program leaders who have helped scale organizations, improve operations, and coordinate across executive leadership, product, engineering, policy, and go-to-market teams.




CORE SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

Regardless of your background, you'll be successful in this role if you bring:

 - 2–4 years of experience (or 1–2 years post-MBA) in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

 - Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to create executive-ready presentations and recommendations.

 - Exceptional project management and stakeholder management skills across cross-functional teams.

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities across long, complex sales and procurement cycles.

 - Familiarity with government procurement, contracting, RFPs, or regulated industries is a plus.

 - High attention to detail, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

 - Ability to bring structure to ambiguity while balancing strategic thinking with execution.

Direct public sector experience is a plus but not required. We're ultimately looking for curious, high-performing operators who are eager to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful business impact.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT SOCURE

We hire curious builders who:

 - Take ownership and operate with a founder mentality.

 - Stay deeply customer-focused and connect their work to revenue and mission outcomes.

 - Thrive in ambiguity and move quickly to solve problems.

 - Continuously learn, iterate, and improve.

 - Understand how Product, Go-to-Market, Data Science, and Operations work together to drive results.

 - Build trust across teams while creating scalable, efficient ways of working.




WHY THIS ROLE

 - Partner directly with the General Manager of Public Sector and senior GTM leadership.

 - Operate as the strategic right hand and chief of staff to a growing business segment.

 - Build broad experience across strategy, revenue, customer execution, finance, and operations.

 - Help shape one of Socure's fastest-growing, mission-driven businesses.

 - Develop deep expertise in public sector identity, fraud prevention, and digital modernization.

 - Position yourself for future leadership opportunities across strategy, operations, revenue, or general management.

Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.




Follow Us!

YouTube https://www.youtube.com/c/Socure  |  LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/socure/ |  X (Twitter) https://x.com/socureme  |  Facebook https://www.facebook.com/socure/

description_plain:
ABOUT CAPE

Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.

Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected and have privacy.

We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.

Today, Cape provides our secure network to consumers, businesses, and government agencies alike. We closed our Series C in March 2026, and we are scaling rapidly, with the goal of giving people back control of their most personal information.




THE TEAM

At Cape, we are the architects of a privacy-centric movement that is just getting started. We are relentless builders, constantly innovating at the edge of what's possible in telecommunications. We operate on a foundation of high trust and high expectations. Our structure is flat, and collaboration matters more than hierarchy. As a member of our team, you will collaborate with world-class engineers, architects, and visionaries, and work across organizational lines to solve "impossible" problems and deliver mission-critical results for our users every single day.




THE ROLE

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the technical operators who ensure Cape’s products actually work in the field for the customers who depend on them most. In a world of demo-ware and big promises, FDEs delivers tangible outcomes: they embed with federal customers, translate ambiguous mission needs into working software, and feed hard-won demand signal back into product and engineering.



This is a hands-on builder role at the seam between Business Development and Engineering. You will be the customer’s technical advocate inside Cape and Cape’s technical advocate inside the customer’s building. You will scope deployments, prototype integrations, troubleshoot live issues on production networks, and pull engineering priorities directly from operator pain. Where the product doesn’t yet do what the mission requires, you will build the bridge—and then push the durable fix into the roadmap.



FDE is a small, high-trust team. We're building this together. You will not be handed a playbook, you'll help write it.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Customer Deployment & Delivery

 - Own the technical delivery of Cape’s products into federal and national security customer environments—from first prototype through operational acceptance and sustainment

 - Embed with customer teams around the world to understand workflows, threat models, and constraints that don’t appear in any requirements document

 - Configure, integrate, and tune Cape’s mobile core capabilities against the specific mission profile of each deployment

 - Lead customer exercises, pilots, and demonstrations; structure them to produce decision-quality evidence rather than theater

 - Provide direct technical support during live operations and incidents; conduct root-cause analyses and drive preventive fixes back into the platform


PROTOTYPING & ENGINEERING

 - Write production-grade code to build the glue, integrations, tooling, and one-off capabilities that unblock customer deployments

 - Prototype new product features in the field, validate them against real mission use, and work with core engineering teams to expand on successful hypotheses

 - Make sound tradeoffs between bespoke customer work and reusable platform investment—default toward the platform when the pattern repeats


BRIDGE BETWEEN CUSTOMER, PRODUCT, AND ENGINEERING

 - Translate customer mission requirements into clear, prioritized engineering asks; translate engineering constraints back into language program officers and operators can act on

 - Advocate internally for customer priorities with concrete evidence: deployment data, operator quotes, blocking issues, and the cost of inaction

 - Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to inform the roadmap—surfacing patterns across deployments that warrant platform investment versus one-off solutions

 - Partner with Business Development and Solutions Architects on captures, pilots, and follow-on opportunities; provide the technical credibility that converts pilots into programs of record





EXPERIENCE

Required

 - 2+ years of experience in a software engineering or forward deployed engineering role

 - Demonstrated technical competency across multiple domains—a “Swiss army knife” profile who can credibly code, debug networking issues, reason about systems-level tradeoffs, and learn quickly

 - Strong ability to scope ambiguous problems, sequence delivery, and make sound prioritization calls without explicit instruction

 - Excellent written and verbal communication; able to brief a flag officer, write a clear engineering ticket, and run a customer working session with equal fluency

 - High ownership and resourcefulness—comfort with the parts of the job that aren’t glamorous, and a track record of doing whatever needs to be done to deliver

 - Demonstrated ability to engage directly with customers to scope technical requirements and deliver against them end to end

 - U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a U.S. Top Secret security clearance (active TS strongly preferred)

 - Willingness to travel up to 50% to customer sites, military installations, and partner locations

 - Washington, DC or New York-based or willing to relocate


PREFERRED

 - Active TS/SCI clearance

 - Prior military service, government civilian experience, or time in roles involving communications, signals, cyber, or intelligence

 - Experience in a hands-on technical role with significant customer facing responsibilities—for example, a former FDE in a high growth startup, a startup engineer who carried customer deployments, or a defense tech deployment engineer (Palantir, Anduril, Shield AI, etc.)

 - Background in mobile networks, telecom, networking infrastructure, or cybersecurity

 - Experience as an early engineer or operator at a high-growth startup—comfort with the ambiguity, pace, and missing infrastructure that comes with sub-100-person companies

 - Experience teaching, mentoring, or onboarding technical teammates

 - Track record of taking field-driven feature work into a core product roadmap






COMPENSATION

We offer competitive compensation that is geo-adjusted based on your location, along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create. Salary range for this role in New York, NY or Arlington, VA is $175k-$235k depending on experience and interview performance and location.

Our benefits include:

 - 401(k) match

 - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents

 - 12 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents, no waiting period)

 - Stipends for
   
   - Family-forming needs
   
   - Gender-affirming care

 - Unlimited PTO




OUR CULTURE & VALUES

 - We hire excellent people, give them outsized responsibility, and trust them to execute. Every person at Cape has a proven track record of tackling hard problems and winning.

 - We believe that personal privacy and national security are not at odds, and that they can be reconciled through strong technology.

 - We believe companies exist to build awesome things and take care of the people who build them, so we offer top-tier healthcare, 401(k) matching, and a generous vacation policy that our team actually uses to recharge.

 - We believe that a stronger company and a better product are built by people from all walks of life. We hire without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. If you are great at what you do, you belong here.
   
   


HOW TO APPLY

Click the link below to apply.

We reserve the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes received from outside recruiting agencies and / or individual recruiters without being responsible for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, and without regard to disability or status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by law.

description_plain:
ABOUT US

Astera is a private foundation on a mission to steer science and technology toward a better future. We believe the coming years will bring an era of unprecedented scientific and technological advancement as exponential progress in AI converges with central advances in other fields to accelerate innovation. This inflection point provides an unparalleled opportunity to fundamentally rethink the institutions, systems, and tools that drive progress. We have committed a $3.5B endowment to that work and fit the form of our support to the function it serves: grants, investments, and in-house research programs. We accept meaningful risk in the research we back and expect some of it to fail because transformative ideas are rarely the ones already proven. Our projects, and the foundation itself, operate like high-velocity startups, with a high performance bar and competitive compensation to match. We are searching for leaders who are compelled by the challenge of driving high-impact change in the way science is funded, conducted, and communicated. You can read more about our mission, vision, and programming at astera.org/vision http://astera.org/vision.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Astera Institute is looking for an Events and Communications lead that will shape Astera into a place where the most interesting conversations in science and technology happen, and where the people having them want to be. Reporting to the COO of the Foundation Division, you'll have ownership over building Astera's external presence and internal culture as a research institute: programming our events, convenings, and communications. As an AI-forward organization, we're looking for someone excited about the transformative potential of AI tools and ready to build that fluency from day one.

Event Management (40%)

 - Design and run events end-to-end, from symposia to Friday socials: venue, vendors, logistics, guest experience, and the details that separate a good event from a memorable one

 - Build the operational infrastructure that lets programming scale: playbooks, vendor relationships, budgets, and tooling

 - Partner with Division leadership in developing the events and moments that accelerate our programming

 - Build the social fabric that turns a collection of researchers into a community, including the unstructured moments where good conversations happen

Communications (40%)

 - Partner with leadership to shape Astera's external comms strategy (audiences, channels, content, etc) and own execution against it

 - Steward Astera's voice across the website, written materials, and external touchpoints, in close collaboration with leadership

 - Manage website, blog, and socials, including writing, editing, and coordinating updates as Astera's work evolves

 - Run the calendar of external-facing moments and the production pipeline behind it

 - Build and manage a roster of external contractors and consultants (writers, designers, PR, etc.) — knowing when to bring in specialists, scoping the work, and getting great output on Astera's timeline and budget

General Operations (20%)

 - Flex to the "unknown unknowns" of a young, growing organization — event logistics, hub operations, cross-functional support during peak periods, and special projects across the Operations stack.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Demonstrated ability to design and execute high-quality convenings end-to-end, including the unglamorous logistics that determine whether they work

 - Capable writer, able to draft as needed in a voice applicable to Astera, and to give substantive editorial direction on everything else.

 - Comfortable directing comms work and managing external contracts end-to-end across modalities (writing, design, web, video, social), including the judgment to know when to draft something yourself vs. bring in a specialist

 - Experience building the systems, playbooks, vendor relationships, and budgets that let programming scale without losing quality

 - Track record of working closely with technical or research-driven people in a way that earned their trust

Just as important as technical qualifications is cultural alignment:

 - Motivated by enabling science and technology that could reshape the future

 - Excited to define what a modern research institute looks and feels like, rather than inheriting an established playbook

 - Thrives in early-stage environments where the role will evolve significantly and the path forward is often ambiguous: comfortable proposing direction while staying calibrated to leadership's priorities

 - Values giving and receiving direct feedback as a cultural multiplier, and sees AI tools as an opportunity to uplevel how the work gets done

 - Generous collaborator who doesn't maintain strong boundaries around what "isn't your job"


LOCATION

This role is based onsite in Emeryville, CA

description_plain:
Eleos is hiring scientists to do foundational and applied machine learning research into the potential well-being and moral status of AI systems. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, cognitive science, and philosophy of mind, doing original, rigorous research to guide and inform decision-makers at frontier AI companies, policymakers, and the public.




ABOUT ELEOS



At Eleos, we are working to understand and address the potential well-being of AI systems. We believe that it is possible that near-future AI systems could be sentient or possess other properties worthy of moral consideration. We also believe that research on AI well-being may be importantly relevant to AI safety research, and we see our work as part of the broader project of navigating the development of transformative AI to ensure a flourishing future for all. We take a pragmatic approach, prioritizing ambitious but tractable projects. We are a nonprofit organization.




WHAT YOU’LL DO



 - Design and conduct empirical research on foundational topics relevant to the potential well-being and moral status of AI systems, such as LLM preferences and values https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13339, the ability of LLMs to introspect https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17120, persona vectors https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17031, and the representation of valence in LLMs

 - Design and conduct applied research on the potential well-being of frontier AI systems (e.g., our prerelease evaluations of Claude Mythos Preview https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/08ab9158070959f88f296514c21b7facce6f52bc.pdf#page=180)

 - Collaborate with external researchers across the AI welfare and AI safety ecosystems on empirical and conceptual research projects

 - Write papers and blog posts and present talks reporting your research




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR




YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE:

 - Strong interest in understanding the potential well-being of AI systems

 - A track record of leading and publishing impactful empirical ML research

 - The ability to design, run, and iterate on experiments quickly and creatively, including the engineering skills to implement necessary tooling and infrastructure


STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE:

 - Familiarity with existing research on AI welfare and/or safety

 - A PhD in computer science or the cognitive sciences

 - Significant experience with mechanistic interpretability methods




COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS



We’re open to a wide variety of seniority levels for this role, with annual salary dependent on level ($201,634 to $428,982).




BENEFITS

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance: Employee premiums covered 100% by Eleos (and 75% of dependent premiums covered)

 - 401(k): Immediate vesting with 100% employer match up to 6% of salary

 - Time off and leave: Unlimited paid time off; parental leave for new parents

 - Our office: Catered meals; snacks and drinks; gym and shower; gorgeous views of the SF Bay Area

 - Relocation support: Stipend for moving to the SF Bay Area

 - Health and wellness benefits




LOGISTICS




LOCATION

This role is based in our Berkeley office with the expectation that employees will work from the office at least 3 days per week. In future, we may hire Research Scientists in other locations or remotely; you’re welcome to submit this application to be considered for those roles if and when we are looking to fill them.




WORK AUTHORIZATION

This position is open to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and individuals currently authorized to work in the U.S. We may be able to sponsor visas for this role, but it will depend on your particular situation.



Eleos is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Eleos collects personal information from job applicants — including contact details, employment and education history, and application materials — through our applicant tracking system for the sole purpose of evaluating your application and communicating with you during the hiring process. We do not sell your personal information or use it for advertising. You have the right to request data deletion or correction; to exercise these rights, contact us at ops@eleosai.org. Unsuccessful applicants' data is retained for up to 24 months and then deleted.




AI USAGE

We may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence and automated systems, to support recruiting and hiring activities. These tools assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, matching qualifications to job requirements, and managing the recruitment process. Final hiring decisions are made by human decision-makers.

description_plain:
ABOUT BASIS

Basis https://www.basis.ai is a nonprofit applied AI research organization with two mutually reinforcing goals.

The first is to understand and build intelligence. This means to establish the mathematical principles of what it means to reason, to learn, to make decisions, to understand, and to explain; and to construct software that implements these principles.

The second is to advance society’s ability to solve intractable problems. This means expanding the scale, complexity, and breadth of problems that we can solve today, and even more importantly, accelerating our ability to solve problems in the future.

To achieve these goals, we’re building both a new technological foundation that draws inspiration from how humans reason, and a new kind of collaborative organization that puts human values first.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Basis, our Scientific/Technical Writers play a pivotal role in communicating our research and ideas to a diverse audience, including researchers, funders, and the general public. This role involves close collaboration with our research scientists to develop compelling grant proposals, articulate project specifications, and create engaging blog posts and social media content.

Key Qualifications:

 - Exceptional writing skills: Ability to produce clear, concise, and compelling content.

 - Grant writing and editing experience of at least three years. Experience in writing successful scientific grants is highly valued, particularly for the NSF, DARPA, and/or NIH.

 - PhD (or equivalent experience) in a technical area, including statistics, programming languages, machine learning, computational neuroscience, cognitive science, physics, or mathematics.

 - Technical proficiency: A solid foundation in technical or mathematical concepts, with a keen interest in and capacity to understand Basis' core technical research https://www.basis.ai/our-work/#core-technology areas, such as probabilistic programming, causal inference, collaborative intelligent systems, and program synthesis.

 - Versatile communication: Skilled in synthesizing complex information for various audiences. Able to adapt writing style to suit different modes – from rapid, urgent communication to methodical, long-term projects.

 - Collaborative spirit: Comfortable working closely with research teams, understanding their work, and effectively translating it into written form.

 - Passion for AI and its impact: Ideally, candidates will have a genuine interest in AI, its societal implications, and Basis’ mission.

What We Offer:

 - An opportunity to be at the forefront of AI research and its applications.

 - A collaborative and supportive work environment.

 - Engagement with complex, meaningful problems with societal impact.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Collaborate with research teams to develop and write grant proposals.

 - Create detailed project specification documents and reports.

 - Craft engaging and informative blog posts, social media content, and other communication materials.

 - Translate complex technical and research concepts into accessible language for diverse audiences.

 - Contribute to Basis’ overarching mission and goals through effective storytelling and communication.


ROLE DETAILS

Exceptional candidates who may not meet all of the following criteria are still encouraged to apply.

 - FT/PT: This is potentially a full-time or part-time position

 - Hours: While we prioritize in-person collaboration for its benefits to creative work, there is a degree of flexibility in your working hours. Expect to be available during certain set times each week for meetings, and be prepared to attend multi-day Basis-wide in-person events.

 - Location: This role is ideally in-person in either New York City or Boston, but we will consider hybrid/remote candidates.

 - Salary range: Competitive salary and benefits.


APPLICATION COMPONENTS

Please submit the following attachments (pdfs preferred):

 - Your CV or resume.

 - A cover letter briefly describing your relevant experience.

 - 3-5 writing samples. These can be grant proposals or other forms of technical writing.



Non-Discrimination Notice
Basis Research Institute provides equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or genetics and prohibits discrimination based on all protected characteristics.



Privacy Notice

By submitting your application, you grant Basis permission to use your materials for both hiring evaluation and recruitment-related research and development purposes. Your information may be processed in different countries, including the US. You retain copyright while providing Basis a license to use these materials for the stated purposes.

Read our full Global Data Privacy Notice here https://www.basis.ai/join-us/privacy-notice/.
