description_plain:
ABOUT US

FAR.AI http://FAR.AI is a non-profit AI research institute working to ensure advanced AI is safe and beneficial for everyone. Our mission is to facilitate breakthrough AI safety research, advance global understanding of AI risks and solutions, and foster a coordinated global response.



We’re structured to support that work from early research through real-world adoption:



Independent by design. We can pursue what's most impactful based on our theory of change and share what we find publicly.



A portfolio approach. Rather than focus on one single direction, we run diverse bets across the safety stack. We take promising ideas from initial experiments to deployment, informed by red-team partnerships with frontier labs and governments.



Serious infrastructure for ambitious research. A dedicated engineering team runs our compute cluster and experiment-scaling stack, so researchers spend their time on research instead of on infra.



Setting the standard. Our events convene key decision makers; our red-team works with frontier developers and governments; and our communications inform the public. Together, this drives adoption and sets the new standard in safety.



Since our founding in July 2022, we've grown to 50+ staff https://www.far.ai/about/team, published 40+ academic papers https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=FVJ24k8AAAAJ, and convened leading AI safety events https://far.ai/events/. Our work is recognized globally, with publications at premier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML including a Best Paper Honorable Mention in 2026 https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/oral/71065, and ICLR, and features in the Financial Times https://www.ft.com/content/175e5314-a7f7-4741-a786-273219f433a1, Nature News https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-024-02218-7, Wired Magazine https://www.wired.com/story/jailbreaking-ai-models-google-anthropic-openai-spacexai/ and MIT Technology Review https://www.technologyreview.com/2020/02/28/905615/reinforcement-learning-adversarial-attack-gaming-ai-deepmind-alphazero-selfdriving-cars/. We conduct pre-deployment testing on behalf of frontier developers such as OpenAI and independent evaluations for governments including the EU AI Office https://www.far.ai/news/far-ai-selected-to-lead-eu-ai-act-cbrn-risk-consortium and publish the AI Security Leaderboard https://leaderboard.far.ai/ based on our red-teaming expertise. We help steer and grow the AI safety field through developing https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.06624 research https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.20702 roadmaps https://www.researchgate.net/publication/396910034_Open_Technical_Problems_in_Open-Weight_AI_Model_Risk_Management with renowned researchers such as Yoshua Bengio; running FAR.Labs https://www.far.ai/programs/far-labs, an AI safety-focused co-working space in Berkeley housing 40+ members; and supporting the community through targeted grants https://www.far.ai/programs/grantmaking to technical researchers.




THE ROLE

We are hiring our first in-house accountant to build our internal capacity as we scale the organization. Over the next 12–18 months, this role will be critical in helping FAR.AI http://FAR.AI grow to roughly triple its current size while expanding to new geographies and entities.

Reporting to the Head of Finance, this is a hands-on, full-cycle role suited for an experienced accountant who is comfortable operating independently, managing multiple concurrent bodies of work, and has worked in dynamic work environments, covering many roles across accounting and financial operations.



Why This Role / Why Now

FAR.AI http://FAR.AI is entering a pivotal phase of growth, backed by over $100M in funding and expanding opportunities to shape how advanced AI systems are developed and governed. Our work spans technical research, policy, and operations, including partnerships, such as red-teaming frontier models with leading AI companies and governments. As the scope and impact of our work accelerate, we are building operations capacity to better support and enable the organization.



As FAR.AI http://FAR.AI's first in-house accountant, you will lay the financial foundation that enables everything we do, from funding AI safety research and events to expanding into new geographies. You will own the day-to-day accounting operations while improving the systems, controls, and processes that will scale with us. This means you won't just be keeping the books, you'll be shaping how a mission-critical organization manages its finances during a pivotal period of growth.



For accountants who enjoy autonomy, building, solving problems, and care about long-term societal impact, this is a rare and meaningful opportunity.



If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities

 - Own the full accounting cycle

 - Lead month-end and year-end close processes, preparing and reviewing journal entries, accruals, and account reconciliations

 - Maintain accurate general ledger records for a U.S. non-profit with international staff & operations, including an entity in Singapore

 - Support grant and fund accounting, including tracking restricted and unrestricted funding, preparing grant financial reports, and ensuring compliance with donor requirements

 - Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports for leadership and the board

 - Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, and tax preparers

 - Partner with the Head of Finance and the Finance Manager to develop and document accounting policies, internal controls, and financial processes suited to a scaling organization

 - Support financial operations of the organization, as needed

 - Respond to ad hoc financial analysis and reporting requests from program teams, leadership, and external stakeholders



Must-Have Qualifications

 - 5+ years of hands-on accounting experience, with demonstrated ownership of full-cycle accounting responsibilities

 - CPA license or active progress toward CPA

 - Excellent at working across spreadsheets and financial systems, including Google Sheets, Quickbooks Online, Ramp, Mercury, and Airtable (among others)

 - Track record of working independently with minimal oversight

 - Managing competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-moving environment

 - High attention to detail and accuracy, with a systematic approach to reconciliation and documentation

 - Strong communication skills, including being able to explain financial information clearly to non-finance colleagues



Nice-to-Have Qualifications

 - Experience with nonprofit accounting, including fund accounting, grant reporting, and 990 preparation

 - Familiarity with multi-entity or multi-currency accounting

 - Experience supporting or coordinating external audits

 - Passion for working in an impact-driven organization

 - Experience developing or improving financial controls

 - Experience implementing or improving systems

 - Has worked in a startup-like environment




LOGISTICS

You will be a full-time employee of FAR.AI http://FAR.AI, a 501(c)(3) research non-profit.

 - Location: Berkeley, CA (onsite/hybrid) or Remote, based in the US.

 - Hours: Full-time (40 hours/week).

 - Hiring process: A screen, a task test, and in-depth interviews with the team, followed by reference checks.



If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact us at talent@far.ai. Otherwise, if you don't have questions, the best way to ensure a proper review of your skills and qualifications is by applying directly via the application form. Please don't email us to share your resume (it won't have any impact on our decision). Thank you!

description_plain:
ABOUT OPENAI FOUNDATION

AI is already changing how people work, learn, and access care. It has the potential to unlock extraordinary benefits—faster medical breakthroughs, accelerated scientific discovery, more personalized services in healthcare and education, new tools for creativity and invention, higher productivity and economic growth, improved public services like transportation systems, and so much more.

But building powerful systems to benefit humanity is only a part of the work of our mission. Advanced AI models will also present new challenges that are already surfacing, and we need to be prepared to identify these challenges and develop solutions to address them.

These are the two dimensions of what we’re building the Foundation to do. We aim to enable the use of AI to find solutions to humanity’s hardest problems, transform what people are capable of, and deliver real benefits in people’s lives—while working hard with partners to be ready for new challenges, and to help make society resilient, as AI advances.

This work is just beginning. Over the next year, as we quickly ramp up, the Foundation expects to invest at least $1 billion across life sciences and curing diseases, jobs and economic impact, AI resilience, and community programs.  This includes early investments toward our previously announced $25 billion commitment to curing diseases and AI resilience.




ABOUT CIVIL SOCIETY AND PHILANTHROPY

Civil Society and Philanthropy is a new OpenAI Foundation team dedicated to putting advanced AI to work on challenges facing people and communities globally.

We will partner with nonprofit and civil society organizations and governments around the world, putting in place the resources needed to ensure AI can meaningfully support their work. We combine philanthropic investment, technical expertise, and convening power to work alongside trusted partners that deliver essential services across geographies and issue areas. Together, we identify opportunities where AI can strengthen their work, expand their reach, and tangibly benefit their communities.

We're starting with three areas:

 - Put AI to work in essential services where it can meaningfully improve access and outcomes.

 - Give civil society organizations the tools, expertise, and support to adopt AI responsibly.

 - Build shared infrastructure so that successful tools and lessons can benefit the entire social sector.

We believe the most meaningful applications of AI will be shaped not by technology companies alone, but by the teachers, clinicians, legal advocates, public servants, researchers, governments, and community organizations applying these tools to solve real-world problems.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Program Officer is a key role on the Catalytic Deployments team that combines philanthropic investment, strategy, institution-building, and operations.

Program Officers support the strategy and execution of major areas of the Catalytic Deployments portfolio, working closely with the Head of Catalytic Deployments to set overall team priorities. As part of this work, Program Officers will support the development of large philanthropic investments, from grants to ambitious multi-year initiatives, and potentially new institutions.

Ideal Program Officers have experience in at least one social sector domain, such as public health, education, poverty alleviation, and economic mobility. This role requires strong judgment, high ownership, and the ability to operate with meaningful autonomy.

This role reports to the Head of Catalytic Deployments, Civil Society and Philanthropy.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We currently use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. Some travel to the U.S. and to other countries will be required.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Contribute to the strategy, prioritization, and the Foundation’s approach to Catalytic Deployments; over time, own specific areas within Catalytic Deployments

 - Source, evaluate, and recommend grants and other funding opportunities. Conduct diligence on organizations, projects, and leaders, including execution capability and potential for scaling the benefit of AI-enabled approaches

 - Support a growing portfolio of grants, ensuring strong judgment, clear prioritization, and high-quality follow-through

 - Engage deeply with the external ecosystem, including researchers, nonprofits, academic centers, public-interest organizations, data platforms, funders, and other potential grantee organizations

 - Identify gaps in the current ecosystem and develop ideas for how the Foundation can support new efforts, partnerships, or field-building initiatives

 - Develop and launch new initiatives from zero-to-one, including helping shape concepts, convene stakeholders, and stand up new efforts where needed

 - Represent the Foundation in external conversations, helping to build credibility, source opportunities, and strengthen the broader field

 - Write clear internal recommendations and strategy memos to support decision-making




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - 5+ years of leadership experience in nonprofits, philanthropy, or government

 - Subject matter expertise in at least one social sector domain, such as public health, education, poverty alleviation, and economic mobility

 - Ability to reason clearly about AI capabilities, implementation constraints, organizational readiness and the risks of deploying AI systems in civil society contexts. (Strongly preferred: Direct experience deploying or scaling AI-enabled approaches in at least one social-sector domain. Demonstrated out-of-the-box and original thinking about AI-for-good.)

 - Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical or organizational opportunities and make strong recommendations

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities may evolve over time

 - Experience engaging credibly with external experts, institutions, and senior stakeholders

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information clearly and persuasively

 - Strong strategic judgment combined with a bias toward execution

 - High degree of ownership, discretion, and accountability

 - Deep motivation to accelerate AI’s impact in civil society and contribute to the Foundation’s mission




COMPENSATION

The annual base salary range for this role is $220,000 to $300,000 USD.

This range reflects our good-faith estimate of the base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this position upon hire. Actual base salary will be determined based on job-related factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, skills, expertise, the scope of the role, and work location, as applicable.

This salary range does not include benefits or any other compensation for which the role may be eligible.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Louma Country Hotel is a unique destination committed to delivering exceptional culinary and hospitality experiences rooted in our Farm-to-Fork ethos. We pride ourselves on creating unforgettable moments for our guests through outstanding food, beverage, and immersive experiences.

The Role
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Head of Food & Beverage to lead our service team and oversee the planning and delivery of market-leading culinary and beverage offerings. description_plain:
BOLT FARM is building America's most iconic romantic luxury retreat brand: nature-immersed, high-experience, and emotionally transformative. Backed by 3,300+ five-star reviews, 1M+ followers, and features across Forbes, Travel + Leisure, and Netflix, we're scaling from a high-performing flagship into a national portfolio. If you want to operate at the ground floor of a brand with real momentum, high standards, and a team obsessed with doing it right, this is your seat. 🚀

From Seth, our CEO: I can make one couple say "that was the best experience of my life." I cannot yet make it happen for every couple, every night, at full occupancy, and that gap is the most expensive problem we have.




THE MANDATE

We're looking for ONE person to own the entire emotional arc of a Bolt Farm stay, from the moment a couple books to the check-in message ninety days after they leave.

 

This is not a department to caretake. It is not a role where you write briefs and hand them to someone else. It is not a seat with a middle-management layer beneath you to absorb the work. You own the outcome across Dreamweavers, Hosts, Guest Communications, Spa, Housekeeping, and Maintenance, and none of them report up through a buffer.




THE ARCHETYPE: THE COMPOSER

We call this seat the Composer, because a stay is a score, not a checklist.

 

They hear the whole piece, not the notes. They can take a guest's intake answers and name the three moments in a 48-hour stay that will actually be remembered, then cut the other nine.

 

They write parts other people can play. Something they designed is still running today, executed correctly by people they no longer supervise.

 

They rehearse in public. They have shipped a v1 that was visibly imperfect, watched real guests use it, and rewritten it inside two weeks.


THE ONLY THREE THINGS THAT MATTER

 1. Can you build the machine? You have designed a service system, not just run one. Passing looks like: you can walk us through a workflow, SOP set, or communication sequence you built from scratch, show what it replaced, and tell us what got measurably better.

 2. Can you make people run it without you? You have held a standard across a team you did not personally supervise every shift. Passing looks like: a specific example where quality held while you were off property.

 3. Do you already work with AI? You use AI daily, unprompted, and you can show us something real it helped you build. Passing looks like: you name the thing, the tool, and the result. Buzzwords score zero.
    
    


WHAT YOU OWN

 - The full guest journey: pre-arrival intake, arrival, in-stay, departure, and the T+24h / T+7d / T+90d follow-up cadence

 - The Dreamweaver, Host, and Guest Communications teams, and the standard all three hold

 - The wow framework in practice: four standardized wows plus one creative wow per stay, delivered at full occupancy

 - Every guest communication that goes out, and the system that sends it

 - Service recovery: the call, the fix, and the upstream change that stops the repeat

 - Guest feedback as an operating input, not a report: reviews, surveys, and service data turned into a weekly change

 - The guest data layer inside BoltOS, and the rule that if it isn't in BoltOS, it doesn't exist

 - Rebooking, loyalty, and enhancement revenue as a function of experience design
   
   


WHY THIS IS THE BEST SEAT ON EARTH

3,300+ five-star reviews already exist, so you are not fixing a broken product. You are systematizing one that works. We are scaling from a $32M flagship toward a $200M+ portfolio, which means the system you build here becomes the operating standard at every property that follows. You get BoltOS, an AI layer already running live guest operations, and a founder who will fund the build rather than ask you to justify it. Peak season is now.




NO GATES. ONLY SIGNAL.

No degree required. No minimum years required. We have hired people with nonlinear backgrounds who outperformed twenty-year résumés, and we will do it again.

 

The only criteria are the three above. A brand-name employer on your resume earns you nothing here. A guest-texting bot you built for your own Airbnb earns you a call.

description_plain:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.



What we do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.



That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.



About the Hospitality Solutions Consultant (Hotel Tech)



We are looking for a high-performing Hospitality Solutions Consultant to join our North America team in Irving, Texas. This is a client-facing, pre-sales role focused on supporting enterprise and mid-market hotel opportunities by bringing deep hospitality expertise into the sales process. You will partner closely with Account Executives to translate hotel operations, revenue strategy, and distribution needs and opportunities into clear, value-focused solutions powered by SiteMinder's platform.



What you'll do…



 - Partner with Account Executives on discovery calls to identify hotel operational pain points, revenue gaps, and distribution inefficiencies.

 - Act as a subject matter expert in hotel operations, revenue management, and hospitality technology throughout the sales cycle.

 - Support mid-to-late stage opportunities by clearly articulating business value, ROI, and measurable outcomes.

 - Deliver tailored product demonstrations aligned to each hotel's size, segment, and distribution strategy.

 - Translate platform capabilities into outcomes such as increased direct bookings, reduced OTA dependency, and improved operational efficiency.

 - Respond effectively to technical and operational questions from hotel stakeholders during the sales process.

 - Train and enable Sales teams on hospitality fundamentals including RevPAR, ADR, channel mix, and hotel tech ecosystems.

 - Contribute to sales playbooks and best practices across different hotel segments (privately owned, boutique, enterprise, multi-property groups).

 - Help elevate the overall consultative selling approach across the North America sales organization.



What you have…

 - Extensive experience in one or more of the following: hotel operations, revenue management, or hospitality technology (Solutions Consultant / Sales Engineer / Customer Success).

 - Strong understanding of hotel systems and ecosystem including PMS, channel managers, booking engines, CRS, and distribution platforms.

 - Proven ability to connect operational needs to measurable business outcomes and revenue impact.

 - Experience supporting or participating in complex B2B SaaS sales cycles in a pre-sales or consultative role.

 - Strong presentation and communication skills with the ability to engage both operational and executive-level stakeholders.

 - Ability to manage multiple opportunities in parallel with strong organization and prioritization skills.

 - Commercial mindset with the ability to contribute to deal strategy and support revenue outcomes.

 - Experience delivering product demonstrations or solution presentations in a client-facing environment.

 - Strong understanding of hospitality distribution and revenue management concepts (mandatory).

 - Familiarity with integration ecosystems across PMS, RMS, CRS, and booking engines (mandatory).

 - Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Marketing teams.

 - Irving, TX (Dallas-Fort Worth) - Hybrid
   
   

Our Perks & Benefits…

- Equity packages for you to be a part of the SiteMinder journey 

- Mental health and well-being initiatives

- Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy

- Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year

- Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations

- Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved 

- Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

 
 

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

 

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

description_plain:
The candidate must be able to work Eastern or Pacific Time business hours, with some flexibility on shift patterns.

 

We are making travel effortless. Join us.

 

Whether it’s to visit the people closest to us, starting an exciting adventure, or a career-defining business trip, travel is an essential part of our lives. Yet we've all experienced the aches and pains of getting to our destination. Today, more than 4 billion airline passengers rely on technology that hasn't kept up with the expectations of the modern connected traveller.

 

That’s why we’ve started to rebuild the infrastructure that underpins the travel industry. We’re on a mission to unravel travel — simplifying systems and building the tools that will make the future of travel effortless.

We were part of Y Combinator S18's cohort and we are backed by Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures and Kima Ventures. A fantastic set of investors that has helped build some of the world's largest companies.

 

Something to consider when reading this job advert

 

We know people engage with job adverts differently. Some will view it as a checklist that needs to be at 100% before applying; others will see 60% as good enough. If you think you have what it takes but don't necessarily meet all the requirements on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat, learn more about you and see if it could be a great fit.

 

Travel Operations at Duffel

 

The Travel Ops team is there to handle all types of queries related to bookings- whether that's voluntary changes requested by the passenger or involuntary changes initiated from the airline's side. We work with our customers to make sure that the travellers get great customer service.

 

This role is more than a typical customer support job. 

 

You may have experience of one or more of the following roles: Travel Advisor, Travel Agent, Travel Consultant, Travel Sales Consultant, Ticketing Agent, Travel Counsellor.



What we're looking for in you

 - Must be able to work Pacific Time business hours, with some flexibility on shift patterns.

 - At least 3 years worth of experience using a GDS (Travelport/Galileo or Sabre preferred)

 - Strong knowledge of air fares, ticketing, re-issues and refunds

 - Experience with NDC systems such as Farelogix SPRK, IAG TAP strongly preferred

 - Ability to think outside-the-box and willingness to go the extra mile

 - Customer obsessed, you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service

 - Experience using Zendesk for customer support queries is preferred (Voice, Chat & Email channels)

 - Previous experience with BSP Link or ARC knowledge is preferable



What you'll be doing

 - You’ll be the first point of contact for our customers, handling incoming emails, calls and live chat messages to assist with their queries

 - Bringing back client feedback and insights to help our team build better products and improve our customer journey

 - Supporting with other team functions such as but not limited to reconciliation, management of ADMs and training new team members

 - Building relationships with travellers & travel sellers using the Duffel platform

 - Acting as an escalation point when needed for the Outsource Team

 - May be required to work some weekends



What you can expect from us

 

We’re dedicated to your personal growth. Our environment is comfortable physically, but also in that our ears are always open to any ideas, concerns and questions. We believe that everyone should have pride in their work, taking full ownership of it and its impact. That’s why everyone who joins Duffel owns a share of the company.

 

We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that’s why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone – regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

 

Note to recruitment agencies

Duffel does not accept speculative CV's from external parties. Any unsolicited CV's sent to us will be treated as property of Duffel, and any attached terms and conditions associated with these CV's will be null and void.

description_plain:
🍿 ABOUT STAYCATION

For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

But we see something different.

Behind their doors, hotels hide some of the most extraordinary spaces cities have to offer: breathtaking rooftops with skyline views, world-class spas and pools, bars and restaurants led by visionary chefs, interiors that spark the imagination, and beds so perfect you never want to leave them.

Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away.

Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment.

Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment.

Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home.

Today, Staycation means:

 - 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland

 - 🏨 4,000 partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces

 - ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.




✨ THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team.

You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers.

Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability.

We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack.

You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin https://player.vimeo.com/video/1187602975?h=dc8d62cd06, our CTO & Head of Product.


📍 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend.

 - Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification.

 - Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change.

 - Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement.

 - Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt.

 - Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time.

 - Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop.


🧰 OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT

Four products running on a shared stack:

 - The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel.

 - The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes.

 - The hotel extranet, where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots.

 - The internal admin platform, the tool our teams use to run the marketplace.

On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform.


📌 KEY RESULTS


IN YOUR FIRST 3 MONTHS, YOU’LL BE EXPECTED TO:

 - Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows.

 - Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production.

 - Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production.

 - Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement.

 - Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design.


IN YOUR FIRST 12 MONTHS, YOU’LL BE EXPECTED TO:

 - Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad.

 - Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business.

 - Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility.

 - Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team.

 - At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others.


🌍 LOCATION

This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:

 - If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.

 - If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).


🚀 WHY JOIN US?

 - Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience.

 - Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey.

 - Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design.

 - Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma.

 - Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working.

 - Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris.


🎯 YOU’RE THE IDEAL CANDIDATE IF YOU:


MUST-HAVES

 - Have already shipped and owned meaningful product features in a professional environment. We care more about the scope you have handled than an exact number of years or a specific degree.

 - Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger.

 - Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.

 - Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.

 - Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way.

 - Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact.

 - Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design.

 - Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience with React Native.

 - Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey.

 - Previous experience working remotely.

 - Comfortable working in English in a professional environment.


⚙️ HIRING PROCESS

 - Recruiter interview with Mathieu https://www.linkedin.com/in/mathieu-fernandez8/, our Talent Acquisition Manager (30–45 min)

 - Manager interview with Robin https://www.linkedin.com/in/robin-biondi-02921a85/, our CTO & Head of Product, and Charlie https://www.linkedin.com/in/charles-alexis-hayes-955092131/, one of our Lead Developers (60 min)

 - Technical interview with Corentin https://www.linkedin.com/in/corentin-lefevre/ and Joachim https://www.linkedin.com/in/joachimwestphal/, our Tech Leads (60 min)

 - Final meetings with members of our Leadership team (60 min) and your potential future teammates (30 min)




IN THE MEANTIME, MEET ROBIN, OUR CTO & HEAD OF PRODUCT:

description_plain:
ABOUT MARBLE

Marble https://marble.studio/ is a climate tech venture studio. We partner with scientists, engineers, and operators to create companies solving hard climate problems in the world's largest industries.

Our first 15 companies https://marble.studio/companies are building transformative products across energy, industry, agriculture, and climate resilience. 100% have been successful in raising follow-on to date. We are looking to partner with exceptional individuals to create our next venture.

The opportunity below is a founding role in our next company creation, which we think will be absolutely massive!




MAKING PROCESS PLANTS INTELLIGENT & EFFICIENT



Process industries - food & beverage, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, metals, and materials - form the backbone of the global economy. In the EU alone, they generate €5T in annual revenue and consume 75-80% of all industrial energy. But inside these plants, critical decisions are still driven by conservative operating conditions, fragmented data, and operator intuition.

As a result, 15-25% of plant revenue (~€1T annually) is lost to inefficiencies from over-cleaning, undetected fouling, suboptimal process conditions, and siloed optimisation. We want to support industrial competitiveness by focusing on addressing these process inefficiencies.

These problems aren’t caused by a lack of data. Most plants produce continuous data from thousands of sensors, but that data sits locked in silos. Integration is slow, contextualisation is poor, analysis models are bespoke, and replication across sites takes months. We are building a new platform using AI and innovative modelling to solve these challenges, creating better decisions based on existing data and enabling it to scale across plants, faster.




THE OPPORTUNITY



We are building the physical AI for process plants: a system that combines physics-based models, live sensor data, and machine learning to make equipment behaviour observable and provide real-time recommendations across operations.

We have identified a key entry point that has previously been overlooked. Where customer pain is high, and deployment is fast. Solving it delivers immediate savings across energy, water, chemicals, and downtime. And we’re already signing paid pilots. This early use case allows us to build the foundations of our platform.

From there, our approach extends to adjacent unit operations within the plant and across industries, with the long-term vision of a unified layer that optimises process plant operations in real time. At scale, we address a €300B market, reduce industrial energy spend by 15%, and tackle 4% of global CO₂ emissions.



We are looking for a CTO and Co-Founder with world-class ML engineering experience who wants to apply their talent to improving the physical world. You will take full ownership of the technical direction and execution, from early pilots to full-scale deployment. You will shape the platform models and architecture (data curation & contextualisation, physics models, ML pipelines, operator-facing apps), focused on building a robust, replicable product. As we scale, you will build the engineering team and set the bar for technical excellence.

You will join our current Founder in Residence and CEO: a PhD in process engineering from ETH Zurich, with experience working on the factory floor across pulp & paper, waste-to-energy, cement, and food production. He has developed hybrid physics-ML models and optimised production lines. He brings deep knowledge of both the physics and the customer, and an obsession with making the industry better.




REQUIREMENTS



We are looking for an entrepreneurial Applied AI/ML Engineer who can turn ambiguous problems into a technical vision and operational reality. You have a driving motivation to build the future of industrial process plant operations.

Must have:

 - Deep ML expertise across at least two of physics-informed models, time-series, reinforcement learning, or agentic systems; and the judgement to choose the right tool not the fanciest.

 - Comfortable turning dirty data into reliable training sets through sensor data curation, plant-graph contextualisation, and integration with semi-structured records.

 - AI-native by default, leveraging agents, automations, and AI workflows, and are ready to drive that culture as the company scales.

You can architect and build our platform MVP from the ground up. You have deployed ML products in messy, real-world environments. You understand commissioning, safety constraints, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

The ideal candidate will have prior experience working in or alongside process industries, and a hands-on understanding of industrial data stacks (OPC UA / SCADA / MES / ERP / historians), data compliance (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and industrial safety frameworks (IEC 61508, ATEX, GxP).

Above all, the candidate should have an entrepreneurial mindset and a clear willingness to take ownership in a co-founder role.



Location: We are primarily seeking candidates based in Europe, with a preference for France or Switzerland, with the ability to travel to project sites across the region when necessary.

Examples of relevant backgrounds.

 - Senior Applied AI/ML Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer who's deployed ML systems for industrial customers at a world-leading tech company or industrial AI startup

 - AI/ML Research engineer or scientist from an applied ML team with a track record of deploying and validating solutions in production, for example working on physical AI

 - Startup founder / operator with technical leadership experience in applied ML and production deployments in industrial environments

You’re encouraged to apply even if your background isn’t a perfect match. Above all, we value intelligence, creativity, and founder potential.




WHAT WE OFFER

You will, of course, have the opportunity to meet and work with them before making any big commitments!

We offer (among other things)

 - A €3,000 monthly allowance during your participation in the programme

 - €250,000 inception funding at incorporation, if you are successful. You and your team will own 80% of the company at incorporation.

 - Full-stack support in our venture creation programme
   
   - Mentorship and guidance at every step of the way
   
   - Hands-on support across technology and market research, landing interviews with experts and customers, techno-economic modelling, roadmap and scale-up strategy, sourcing your future co-founders and advisors, and more
   
   - Access to an unparalleled network across science, industry, talent, investors, mentors, and other climate deeptech founders
   
   - Access to our research insights, knowledge base, and curated resources
   
   - Weekly check-ins, work sessions in our Paris HQ (or remote), and continuous peer learning with other programme participants

 - Seed fundraising support after the programme. Introductions to the best seed investors and help with term sheet negotiation.

 - Founder visa sponsorship if you wish to relocate to France. Remote participation would be a challenge, but we're open to finding different partnership formats.



We believe that a diverse group of minds is key to solving the climate crisis. We encourage women and people of colour to apply. Studies have shown that underrepresented candidates are less likely to apply for an opportunity unless they feel they meet every single qualification. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and mission-driven cohort. If you’re excited about the programme but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with what you read on our website, we encourage you to apply anyway!



FAQS

For a full list of FAQs, please visit our website https://marble.studio/faq.

🌍 About Antai Ventures

Antai Ventures is a Barcelona-based venture studio with presence across Southern Europe and LatAm. We partner-up and invest in the best co-founders to build global companies willing to disrupt multi-billion dollar industries. Since 2012 we have co-founded +30 companies including Glovo, Wallapop, Piper and Juryo. Our ventures have raised more than $1.5B in funding, have generated more than $3B in shareholders value and currently employ more than 3,000 people.



🚀 Join the team building the AI Operating System for Real Estate Agencies

We are building the AI-native operating system for real estate agencies in Spain, one of the largest, most fragmented and least digitised industries in Southern Europe. We deploy specialized AI agents that run an agency's core operations 24/7: answering every lead in seconds, qualifying buyers and tenants, scheduling visits, and, over time, operating the entire transaction.

The product is live and in production with our first client. You won't be alone: there is already a co-founder on board, a senior operator who has built and scaled AI systems from zero to production at enterprise level, and the backing of Antai's full studio team. We are now looking for the co-founder who will own the commercial side of the company.



💼 About The Role

You are a builder at heart. This is not a sales job where you inherit a pipeline, a script and a quota someone else designed. You will create the commercial engine of a company from zero, with the ownership and equity of a founder.

You know how to build an AI-native sales pipeline, automating the grunt work of prospecting and enrichment so you can focus 100% on building relationships and closing deals. You are writing the playbook. High agency, total ownership, zero excuses - that is the job.



📝 Responsibilities

 - Hunt & Close: you own the full cycle: outreach, discovery, demo, close, with the agencies that matter. You'll close the first 50 accounts yourself, on the phone and in their offices.

 - Systematize Success: turn wins into a repeatable machine: CRM architecture, outbound sequences built AI-native from day one, sales assets, pricing playbook.

 - Own the Number: revenue, pricing and expansion are yours. Land & expand: accounts grow as agencies delegate more workflows to the platform.

 - Feedback Loop: you are the bridge between the market and the product. What agencies tell you decides the roadmap.

 - Build the Team: once the playbook is proven, hire and lead the commercial organisation.



📚 Requirements

 - Proven sales track record: you've carried a quota and closed deals yourself — SMBs or traditional, relationship-driven sectors in Spain are a strong plus (real estate, insurance, professional services).

 - Hunter mentality: relentless and competitive. You create opportunities instead of waiting for them, you hear "no" and come back with a better angle, and you'd rather lose a deal fighting than watch one pass by.

 - Zero-to-one experience: early-stage environment, or you built a territory, vertical or channel from nothing in a fast-paced company.

 - Founder commitment: full-time dedication, equity over salary, and full accountability for the number.

 - Native Spanish (you're selling to local agencies). Fluent English.



🤝 What We Offer

 - A true founding seat: co-founder equity aligned with the founding team, with the standard founder framework (vesting, full-time dedication).

 - A live product, a client in production, and a ~€1B market in Spain with no AI-native leader yet.

 - A co-founder already on board and a product that ships daily.

 - Antai's full-stack operator support: Product, Engineering, GTM, Legal, Fundraising.

 - A founder community and direct access to top-tier investors for the upcoming rounds.

 - Based in Barcelona, hybrid.

description_plain:
FOUNDER & CEO — NIGHTWATCH

One robot. One floor. One job. The automation layer for US senior living

Location: United States

Start date: ASAP

More about the concept here. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1dxl88PpSjoSBjW0ULKMfhiK7V0AHoY24g6z1BOlYrnE/edit?slide=id.g3f526014c3a_0_0#slide=id.g3f526014c3a_0_0

Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners.

Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with a leading global industrial technology partner, we are building a new portfolio of ventures.




ABOUT THE VENTURE

America's ~1,900 continuing-care retirement communities (CCRCs) are the only elder-care buyers whose model rewards keeping residents healthier for longer: residents join at 75–80, pay a large entry fee (avg. ~$402k) plus $12–30k a month, and the community carries the lifetime cost of care. These campuses staff their night shifts at roughly twice the regulatory minimum — comfort-driven cover that can't simply be cut — and once holidays, sickness and cover are loaded, each night position carries ~$160k of true annual cost. Worse, the status quo causes the harm it exists to prevent: around 80% of falls happen in the window right after a nurse's check wakes the resident. Existing tech — pull cords, wearables, fixed sensors — is safety kit that never changes the staffing model.

We are building NightWatch: a mobile UWB-radar robot that patrols the corridor at night, senses through doors and walls, and reports movement as fact — in bed, out of bed, in the bathroom, on the floor — never as clinical judgement. Data is monitored remotely, and staff are alerted only when a physical check is warranted. No cameras. No wearables. No per-room installation. Sold as robot-as-a-service, it delivers a two-to-three-month payback and is the easiest pilot in the category to say yes to: zero capex, zero installation, nothing entering residents' rooms, and fully reversible.




OUR OFFER

We don't just fund ideas — we co-build them. Join as Founder & CEO and get access to a full-stack venture studio offering designed to give you the best possible start:

 - The programme runs in two phases:
   
   Months 0–6 (Build)
   
   - $128k ring-fenced build budget to cover founder stipends and additional specialist resource at the founders' discretion
   
   - Founder stipends are $6,675 per founder per month, drawn from this budget
   
   - Embedded studio team throughout: a full time venture builder, with support from a broader team consisting of a studio lead and growth marketer. Founders build; the Studio supports.
   
   - On-demand access to specialist support across data science, applied AI, fundraising, legal, finance, PR and commercial partnerships
   
   - Dedicated network access from day one
   
   Months 6–12 (Accelerator / Spinout)
   
   - At incorporation, the founding team will receive 70% equity in a new company set up for the venture, and the Studio 15%, both subscribed at nominal value. The remaining 15% is reserved as an employee option pool.
   
   - $320k cash investment goes directly into the new venture's bank account at IC approval - full founder discretion over how funds are deployed
   
   - Accelerator support: a dedicated squad covering growth, product and fundraising, plus continued access to shared services


JOBS TO BE DONE

As Founder & CEO, you will be responsible for turning a strong thesis into a scaled, defensible business.

 - Define the wedge. Choose the operator profile and the 3-state cluster (consistent regulation) where you run concurrent pilots first.

 - Turn a thesis into a product. Work with our partner's robotics teams to take the night-patrol robot and its remote-monitoring layer from concept to a fleet operators can run.

 - Win the first pilots. Land 2–3 CCRC / senior-living operators and prove FTE substitution through the pilot sequence — service level held with one less night headcount.

 - Sell savings, not safety. Frame the buy as an ROI decision for the CFO/COO, positioned as redeployment, not redundancy.

 - Drive the economics. Push the robots-to-operator ratio toward the levels that make margins trend to software, working with our partner on a path to lower unit cost.

 - Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and establish the venture as the automation layer for senior living.


YOUR IDEAL EXPERIENCE

We are not looking for a traditional senior-living executive or a pure robotics researcher. The ideal candidate sits at the intersection.

 - Deep familiarity with at least one buyer segment: US senior living / CCRC operators, eldercare, or enterprise facilities operations.

 - Enterprise commercial instinct: you can navigate multi-site operator sales cycles and turn a pilot into a fleet rollout.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity: shaping the product, defining the buyer, and making irreversible calls with incomplete data.

 - Credibility with conservative care operators and forward-looking venture investors, and willingness to be on the ground in the US.

 - Experience integrating hardware / robotics products into healthcare and/or medical care is considered highly advantageous

Most importantly, you are motivated by category creation — building the operational backbone for how America ages, on robots you put there first.



This is your company. We're here to help.

description_plain:
🧑‍🚀 JOB TITLE: ENTREPRENEUR IN RESIDENCE (EIR)

Location: United States (flexible) or Brazil
Employment Type: Full Time
Location Type: Remote
Department: Sierra – EIR
Compensation: Cash & Equity





🏔️ ABOUT SIERRA STUDIO

Sierra is an AI First engineering studio and tech incubator. We turn our customers’ ideas into reality! We’re based in Los Angeles, but our teammates live all around the world.

We do everything with an AI First approach, including coding, building our own tooling, and exploring incubating ideas that get traction internally.




💼 ABOUT THE ROLE

An EIR is somebody who wants to start their own company and is actively experimenting to prepare.

The idea of an EIR has existed for a while. Mostly in the context of the venture studio model, in which traditional VC is combined with some sort of talent program to incubate businesses. Our version of the role is slightly different.

Sierra is a talent focused organization, but Sierra is self funded through revenue and not the traditional VC model. Our advantage is our team and the understanding we gain while building. Our engineering & hiring services work is a unique opportunity to explore different domains and technologies in a short time to inspire your future startup’s vision.

Sierra EIRs are responsible for leading client projects AND encouraged to start a new business leveraging our resources & ecosystem. EIRs are also involved with building our company AI First. Our environment uniquely evolves our people’s understanding, ideas, and skills to build next-gen companies.




🧠 WHAT MAKES A GREAT EIR?

We’re looking for entrepreneurial minds with a bias to action and a systems-thinking lens. You might be an engineer, a product thinker, or a domain expert who’s felt the itch to build something of your own.



🧬 Core Skills

 - High curiosity and fast learning ability
   

 - Strong systems thinking
   

 - Clear communicator across ideas and execution
   

 - Emotionally intelligent and low ego
   

 - Background in engineering, product, or an industry domain
   

 - Deep understanding of (or excitement about) AI-first thinking
   

🎁 Bonus Points

 - Strong product sense or design chops
   

 - Solid coding or architecture experience
   

 - Experience with ML, LLMs, or data science
   

 - A personal brand or strong professional network
   

 - Experience as a 2nd+ time founder




🔧 DAY IN THE LIFE OF AN EIR

If you’re coming from a product or engineering background, this version of the EIR experience is for you.

It’s geared toward builders who think in systems, tools, and products.

Through client work and internal initiatives, you’ll:

 - Gain rapid exposure to a variety of domains and technologies
   

 - Identify recurring patterns and unmet needs across industries
   

 - Develop Sierra’s internal AI Roadmap (internal tools, research, experiments)
   

 - Contribute to the design and iteration of early-stage AI products
   

Over time, you’ll chart your own path:

 - 🚀 Found a new company
   

 - 🤝 Join another Sierra incubation as a co-founder
   

 - 🧭 Step into a technical leadership role within Sierra




🌱 WHAT ARE THE OUTCOMES OF BECOMING AN EIR?

As an EIR, many of the fundamental pain points are removed from the early days of starting a company:

 - You don’t have to stealthily moonlight your startup while juggling another job to pay the bills.
   

 - Your entrepreneurship is institutionally encouraged and fostered.
   

 - You work with a high-agency and low-ego team of potential co-founders / founding engineers.
   

 - You can openly collaborate on your incubation and use our environment as a playground to explore new ideas.
   

 - You work in a system that is rapidly surfacing needs, roadmapping, and iterating on new AI tools/products.
   

 - You serve our clients and company. You grow and learn faster than you have before.
   

After some time, you found your own company, and Sierra does everything we can to set up a great team and support your journey.



You own a founding stake in your business. Through your equity in Sierra, you also own a stake in our services business and a small amount of every company we incubate. This gives you high upside AND diversification as the ecosystem grows.




💖 OUR CULTURE

 - Growth mindset: We take risks, learn fast, and build with curiosity.
   

 - Supportive: No egos here — just people helping people build.
   

 - AI-native: We live and breathe tooling, experimentation, and speed.
   

 - Ownership: Everyone acts like a founder, because many of us are.

Our founding team has backgrounds at BCG, Bain, Harvard, Stanford, Oxford, the White House, and Congress, and has previously built startups backed by Sequoia, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Coatue, and NFX.




THE ROLE

You'd be one of the first engineers at Clipbook — joining a small but mighty engineering team with engineers from Meta, Stripe, and AWS. You'll have real influence over architecture and technical direction, and what you build will ship to 200+ customers quickly.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Architect & build across the stack. Make architectural decisions and implement solutions across the stack (Next.js, TypeScript, React, Python, Node, SQL/NoSQL). You have the conviction to quickly build from concept to deployment to seeing clients love our product.

 - Collaborate with customers. Work directly with users to understand pain points, join calls, hear what's working and what isn't, and rapidly iterate to deliver solutions that matter.

 - Tackle a wide breadth of engineering challenges. Our work spans AI, data engineering, backend, frontend, and more — so there's plenty of opportunity to find projects that match your strengths and interests. Some examples include:
   
   - AI/ML Integration: Productionize LLMs and classical ML models for real-world, high-uptime applications — including prompt execution, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and agentic systems. Leverage the latest in generative AI tooling and frameworks.
   
   - Data Engineering: Build pipelines and infrastructure for ingesting, normalizing, and querying massive, multi-modal datasets (text, audio, video).

 - Shape Clipbook's engineering culture. As one of the first engineers, you'll influence everything — code quality, system design principles, documentation standards, testing, deployment, and how we build as a team. You'll mentor future hires and drive best practices. We believe leaders stay hands-on: even as we grow, everyone (including managers) continues to ship.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2–10+ years of relevant engineering experience at tech and product-driven companies. You've taken systems from zero to production and owned the full lifecycle.

 - Proficiency with web technologies (Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, etc.)

 - Genuine excitement to build quickly & ship fast. We care about getting things into users' hands and iterating from there.

 - Deep knowledge and practical experience with cloud-based services, containerization, and API development.

 - Experience optimizing data architectures for performance and cost.

 - You take ownership. When something is broken or unclear, you fix it or flag it without waiting to be asked.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity. You make reasonable calls with incomplete information, communicate them clearly, and adjust as you learn more.

 - Strong product sense and bias for action. We're a small team and can't afford analysis paralysis — we make decisions with incomplete information and learn from real customer feedback.

 - A future leader. You'll help shape our engineering culture and can quickly grow into engineering leadership as the company scales.




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience with any of the following:
   
   - LLM fine-tuning, RAG, RLHF, or eval pipelines
   
   - Computer vision or multimodal model experience (audio, video, image)
   
   - Semantic search, vector databases, or meaning-aware retrieval
   
   - Familiarity with web scraping frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer) and different types of API integrations (REST, GraphQL)
   
   - Comfort with asynchronous workflows, rate-limiting, and distributed systems

 - Startup founder or early-stage experience is a huge plus.




WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

We're hiring across the full stack with a focus on building product. This probably isn't the right fit if your background is primarily in firmware, embedded systems, hardware engineering, networking, or infrastructure/DevOps.




A FEW THINGS WORTH KNOWING

 - We care more about what you ship than when or where you work, but this is an early-stage company growing fast. The pace reflects that. Our culture is intense and driven by H&H (hunger and hustle).

 - As one of the first engineers, you'll wear a lot of hats. There's no platform team to hand things off to yet.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $150K–$220K

 - Equity: Early-stage grant with significant upside

 - Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k), unlimited PTO

Growth: A clear path to engineering leadership as we scale

description_plain:
🏛️ ABOUT GOVWELL

We the people — and the taxpayers — deserve good government. Yet today, interacting with government services is often frustrating and inefficient. GovWell is building the AI operating system transforming how governments serve communities, starting with local agencies.

GovWell replaces legacy software for municipalities and counties, empowering public servants to radically streamline public services and cut internal processing time for permits and licenses by up to 95%.

Founded in 2023, GovWell powers 5,000+ mission-critical processes for agencies in 35+ states serving millions of residents. The company has raised $35M in funding from Insight Partners, Work-Bench, and Bienville Capital, and the team works in person at GovWell HQ in New York City. Read more about our founding story in TechCrunch https://techcrunch.com/2024/07/29/govwell-is-bringing-automation-and-efficiency-to-local-governments/.



🌟 ROLE OVERVIEW

Government software has historically forced users to choose between two bad options: outdated systems that are painful to use, or newer tools that look better but can’t handle the complexity of how government actually works. We believe the next generation of government software should do neither. It should make extraordinarily complex workflows feel simple, intuitive, and even delightful.

GovWell is hiring a Founding Product Designer to define what that future looks like.

You’ll be our first design leader and will build the Design function from the ground up. You’ll establish the principles, systems, and standards that shape every GovWell product—while remaining deeply hands-on in the work. You’ll redesign the look and feel of our core platform, help us create AI experiences that feel integral rather than bolted on, and give engineers the tools to build polished, consistent products without design becoming a bottleneck.

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a mature team or spend most of their time reviewing other people’s work. Initially, you’ll be a full-time individual contributor and thought leader. Over time, you’ll hire and lead the team needed to make design a lasting competitive advantage for GovWell.

This role reports directly to our CTO and Co-Founder, Ben Cohen.

We have a hybrid work culture that combines regular in-person collaboration at our New York City office (3+ days per week) with flexibility to work remotely.





☀️ WHY GOVWELL?

 - A mission that matters: Building AI-powered products to fix outdated government systems isn’t just a design challenge—it’s a historic opportunity to improve our foundational relationship with government and ensure trillions of tax dollars result in high-quality services. WATCH: Mission & Vision with CEO & Co-Founder Troy LeCaire https://www.loom.com/share/3d733b22ca0d4fa6be241e0cdd36311a

 - A rare design problem: Local governments run some of the most complex workflows in the economy. Your job will be to make that complexity feel simple without stripping away the power that public servants need.

 - Real-world impact: GovWell is the system of record for government services affecting millions of Americans. From helping a small business open sooner to accelerating the construction of affordable housing, your work will make an immediate difference.

 - The chance to define the standard: Our product is established and growing, but our design language is still taking shape. You won’t be maintaining someone else’s system—you’ll define what exceptional government software looks and feels like.

 - Join a startup in hyper-growth: We’ve found product-market fit and are scaling quickly, with 4X ARR growth in the last year. You’ll work closely with the founders and have exceptional autonomy, ownership, and influence over the company’s direction.




🎨 WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Set the design vision for GovWell. Define the principles that make our products intuitive, differentiated, and unmistakably GovWell.

 - Reimagine the core product experience. Lead a significant evolution of our platform’s visual design and interaction patterns without losing sight of the complex workflows our customers depend on.

 - Design AI-native experiences. Shape how AI helps government staff complete work—not as a chatbot bolted onto existing software, but as a cohesive part of the product.

 - Build our design system. Create the components, patterns, and guidance that let product and engineering teams move quickly while maintaining a consistently high bar.

 - Stay close to customers. Develop a deep understanding of government staff, residents, contractors, and business owners, then turn their needs into simple and thoughtful product experiences.

 - Raise the quality of everything we ship. Partner closely with our Head of Product (Will Fisher https://www.linkedin.com/in/wafisher/ - former Head of Digital at the MTA and builder of the MTA TrainTime mobile app https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mta-traintime/id1104885987) and software engineers from early exploration through implementation, sweating the details that separate functional software from a truly great product.

 - Build the Design function from 0 to 1. Define how design operates at GovWell, then hire and develop a world-class team as the company grows.




🧠 WHO YOU ARE

 - Complexity, made simple: You have a track record of designing intuitive, beautiful products for complex use cases.

 - A player, not just a coach: You’re an exceptional hands-on product designer who can take an ambiguous problem through to a polished experience—and you’re excited to do the work yourself.

 - More than a pair of hands: You have strong product judgment. You challenge assumptions, simplify workflows, and help determine what should be built—not just how requirements should look.

 - AI-native, not AI-curious: You’re an active user of AI and have thoughtful, evolving opinions about how it should reshape software experiences.

 - Systems without bureaucracy: You can establish a design system that helps teams move faster without letting the system become more important than the product.

 - Clarity creates momentum: You communicate clearly and can bring founders, product managers, engineers, and customers along with your thinking.

 - Vision down to the last pixel: You move comfortably between articulating a multi-year product vision and debating the right label, state, or interaction.

 - A builder of teams: You want to create a Design function and eventually lead a team, but you’re energized by starting as a hands-on individual contributor.

 - Empathy without prerequisites: You can deeply understand the needs of government staff and residents without prior govtech experience.

 - Values are how you operate: You align closely with our Core Values https://govwell.com/careers#core-values.



🖥️ DESIGN TOOLING

 - Lovable

 - Cursor

 - Figma




💸 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Compensation within the posted salary band will be commensurate with experience. All offers will include:

 - Competitive base salary.

 - Equity / stock options.

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 - 401(k) program.

 - Flexible PTO.

 


➡️ CLICK HERE TO MEET THE ENGINEERING TEAM https://govwell.com/team?departments_equal=Product

Below: a picture of the entire GovWell team celebrating our Series A with a boat cruise on the Hudson!

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/f93a714e-af55-4014-821f-383f2b9c1799/1331038d-1296-4569-b066-631f359d7eb3/Screenshot%202026-07-29%20at%2011.14.55%E2%80%AFAM.png]

description_plain:
At Orchard, we’re securing America’s food supply by building the AI Farmer that automates our nation’s farms. We are the industry leader, growing rapidly, and backed by more than $25 million from leading investors, including Quiet Capital, Shine Capital, and General Catalyst.



Every year, hundreds of billions of dollars in crop value are lost because critical farming decisions are made using incomplete and imprecise data. We’re building the technology to change that.



Our AI-powered camera systems mount to tractors and scan millions of trees, vines, and plants, capturing precise data on yield estimates, fruit size, crop health, disease, and more. We train edge vision AI models that analyze every plant and determine exactly what interventions and treatments it needs. That intelligence flows into FruitScope OS, our farm-management platform, where growers can understand their crops, make better decisions, and direct operations in the field.



Today, Orchard’s technology is trusted by some of our nation’s largest farms. They use our products to grow higher-quality crops while reducing chemical use and operating costs, helping them farm more profitably and sustainably than ever before.




OUR CULTURE:

 - Unshakeable Resilience – Our customers feed millions of people, and our customers depend on us. We are ultra-hardworking, never give up, and we do whatever it takes.

 - Always Keep Moving – We move fast, waste no time, and have an extreme bias towards action. Progress compounds every day, and our impact is measured in decades.

 - Improve Everything – At 1% success, we save millions of pounds of food from going to waste. If we are 100% successful we will impact the lives of billions of people across the world.

 - Farmers First – Every team member spends at least a few days in the fields with our farmers each month.

 - No Job Beneath Us – We’re low ego, own every outcome, and are all working towards the same goal.




THE ROLE:

Orchard is entering its most ambitious period of growth yet. The quality and pace of our hiring will determine how quickly we can serve more farmers, and the systems we build now will shape the company for years.



You will be Orchard’s first dedicated recruiting and people hire. Reporting directly to our CEO, you will personally recruit critical hires while building a durable talent engine: sourcing, interview design, closing, onboarding, HR systems, benefits, compliance, and culture.



This is a builder role. You will spend roughly 2/3-rds of your time recruiting and 1/3-rd building and running our internal people operations. You should be equally comfortable sourcing an exceptional engineer, improving an onboarding process, handling a benefits question in our HRIS, and preparing Orchard for our next stage of growth.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Lead full-cycle recruiting for critical technical and operations roles.

 - Build repeatable sourcing channels and an exceptional recruiting brand.

 - Create and own an exceptional candidate experience.

 - Partner with leaders to define roles precisely, calibrate talent bars, move candidates quickly, and close exceptional hires.

 - Own the employee lifecycle, including new hire onboarding, HRIS, benefits, leave administration, and day-to-day people operations.

 - Maintain practical, compliant employment policies.

 - Protect and strengthen Orchard’s culture as the company scales.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 3-7+ years of experience recruiting, with real ownership in a fast-growing startup or high-performance environment.

 - A track record of personally recruiting and closing exceptional technical talent.

 - Experience helping an organization scale from 10's of employees to 100+.

 - Strong sourcing instincts and the creativity to reach candidates who are not actively applying.

 - Strong operating rigor across recruiting funnels, headcount plans, and people systems.

 - Comfort owning all processes around creating a stellar work environment for our team.

 - Hands-on experience with HRIS, benefits, onboarding, and other core people operations.




ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Full-time role, five days a week at our San Francisco office.

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% of employee premiums covered.

 - The opportunity to build Orchard’s Recruiting and People function from the ground up.

 - Our team is close-knit and highly driven. You’ll work directly with our CEO and every functional leader.

 - We move fast, and sometimes this means staying late or working weekends.

 - We’re deeply motivated by the impact we’re making – every system we build and deploy means less food that goes to waste, and more people who are fed.
